events.title_zh: ZCode 周末每账号限领 3 亿 GLM-5.3-Flash tokens
events.summary_zh: ZCode 官方账号宣布，11 月 27 日 11:00 UTC 起可领取 3 亿 GLM-5.3-Flash tokens，先到先得；使用时间为 11 月 27 日 15:00 至 11 月 30 日 01:00 UTC。用户需升级至 ZCode 4.0+，在应用内弹窗领取并切换至 Start Plan provider，每个账号和设备限领一次。
key_points_zh: 11 月 27 日 11:00 UTC 开放领取，每账号可领取 3 亿 GLM-5.3-Flash tokens，先到先得。
领取后须在 11 月 27 日 15:00 至 11 月 30 日 01:00 UTC 使用。
需 ZCode 4.0+，在应用内弹窗领取并切换到 Start Plan provider。
每个账号和设备限领一次。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是有明确额度、领取和使用窗口及账号限制的限时优惠，直接影响 ZCode 用户可获得的模型用量。
events.title_en: ZCode offers 300 million GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per account this weekend
events.summary_en: ZCode announced that users can claim 300 million GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per account starting at 11:00 UTC on November 27, while supplies last, for use from 15:00 UTC on November 27 to 01:00 UTC on November 30. Users need ZCode 4.0 or later, must claim through the in-app pop-up and switch to the Start Plan provider, and are limited to one claim per account and device.
key_points_en: Claims open at 11:00 UTC on November 27 for 300 million GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per account, while supplies last.
The tokens must be used between 15:00 UTC on November 27 and 01:00 UTC on November 30.
ZCode 4.0 or later is required; users must claim through the in-app pop-up and switch to the Start Plan provider.
Each account and device is limited to one claim.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a time-limited offer with an explicit allowance, claim and usage windows, and account restrictions, directly affecting the model allowance available to ZCode users.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.40 收紧 Agent 权限并修复 MCP 与会话隔离
events.summary_zh: Kilo 7.8.40 稳定版将自动批准改为用户级设置，补充权限卡不可见字符转义、环境文件读取批准和旧配置权限迁移；CLI 修复 Gemini 的 MCP schema 兼容性，并强化多项目会话、TUI 工作区与提供商认证状态隔离。更新还要求文件移动目标路径批准，并修复 shell 子进程占用输出时调用不结束的问题。
key_points_zh: 自动批准改为用户级设置；关闭自动批准会停止仍在重试的批准，关闭已保存规则会移除该规则，权限卡以转义形式显示控制字符、双向标记和不可见格式字符。
读取或输出环境文件前要求批准（示例环境文件仍可读）；写入工具在目标已变化、不是普通文件或无法取得文件系统身份时拒绝写入。
旧配置迁移保留文件写入权限、提供商 headers 与 bearer token；本地 MCP 使用配置的工作目录，并修复 Gemini 拒绝 array 与 anyOf/oneOf 组合 MCP schema 的问题。
会话操作限定在所属项目，TUI 保留各工作区配置并把权限提示路由到对应工作区；子代理标签与提问回答同步到发起会话。
登录状态区分吊销与临时故障，ChatGPT OAuth 刷新后保持登录，提供商与认证面板随项目切换重新加载；Azure/Vertex 端点、区域和凭据发送目标受到更严格校验。
CLI 在 patch 移动文件时要求批准目标路径，拒绝移动到 Agent Manager 状态；前台命令在 macOS/Linux 退出后即结束，即使后代进程仍占用 stdout/stderr。
events.importance_reason_zh: 权限执行、旧配置迁移和 MCP 兼容性变化关系 Agent 安全与升级可靠性，多项目隔离及 shell、认证修复则改善日常运行稳定性。
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.40 tightens Agent permissions and fixes MCP and session isolation
events.summary_en: Kilo 7.8.40 makes auto-approval a user-level setting, escapes invisible characters in permission cards, asks before environment-file access and preserves permissions during legacy configuration migration. The CLI fixes Gemini MCP schema compatibility and strengthens project-session, TUI workspace and provider-auth isolation. It also requires approval for patch move destinations and fixes shell calls that hang when descendant processes retain output streams.
key_points_en: Auto-approval becomes a user-level setting; turning it off stops retried approvals, disabling a saved rule removes it, and permission cards escape control characters, bidi marks and invisible format characters.

Reading or printing environment files requires approval, while example environment files remain readable; the write tool refuses targets that changed, are not regular files or lack usable filesystem identity.

Legacy migration preserves file-write permissions, provider headers and bearer tokens; local MCP servers honor their configured working directory, and Gemini no longer rejects MCP schemas combining array with anyOf or oneOf.

Session actions stay within their owning project, the TUI retains per-workspace configuration and routes permission prompts to the right workspace, and subagent tabs and answers follow the initiating session.

Login state distinguishes revocation from outages, ChatGPT OAuth survives token refreshes, provider and auth panels reload on project switches, and Azure/Vertex endpoints, regions and credential destinations receive stricter validation.

The CLI requires approval for a patch's destination path and refuses moves onto Agent Manager state; foreground shell calls finish on macOS/Linux when the command exits even if descendants keep stdout or stderr open.
events.importance_reason_en: Permission enforcement, legacy migration and MCP compatibility affect Agent safety and upgrade reliability, while project isolation and shell/auth fixes improve everyday stability.

events.title_zh: Qoder 0.5.21 支持 AppHub 连接器同步到云端
events.summary_zh: Qoder 0.5.21 可将本地已授权且使用 Streamable HTTP 的 AppHub 连接器同步到云端，供云端 Agent 与自动化使用。更新还修复云自动化资源选择残留、设备时钟差异导致的注册/配对/重连拒绝、系统代理下模型列表加载，以及 Windows OpenSSH 主机验证问题。
key_points_zh: 本地已授权且使用 Streamable HTTP 的 AppHub 连接器可同步到云端，供云端 Agent 与自动化使用。
修改云自动化时，已移除的 Skills 或连接器不再保持选中，资源列表加载完成前也不会清空既有选择。
修复设备时钟差异导致有效注册请求、配对批准或重连尝试被拒绝；代理设置变更后网络诊断会提示重新运行。
修复系统代理设置下部分本地任务无法加载模型列表，以及 Windows 连接工作区或主机地址变化后 OpenSSH 主机验证失败。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把本地授权连接器扩展到云端 Agent 与自动化，同时修复会影响连接建立和模型可用性的跨平台问题。
events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.21 syncs AppHub connectors to the cloud
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.21 can sync locally authorized AppHub connectors that use Streamable HTTP to the cloud for cloud agents and automations. It also fixes stale cloud-automation selections, registration/pairing/reconnection rejections caused by device clock differences, model-list loading under system proxies, and Windows OpenSSH host verification failures.
key_points_en: Locally authorized AppHub connectors using Streamable HTTP can be synced to the cloud for cloud agents and automations.
Editing a cloud automation no longer leaves removed Skills or connectors selected or clears existing selections before the resource list finishes loading.
Fixes valid registration requests, pairing approvals and reconnection attempts being rejected because of device clock differences; network diagnostics prompts a rerun after proxy settings change.

Fixes model-list loading failures for some local tasks under system proxy settings and Windows OpenSSH host verification failures when connecting to a workspace or reconnecting after a host address change.
events.importance_reason_en: The update extends locally authorized connectors to cloud agents and automations while fixing cross-platform issues that affect connection setup and model availability.

events.title_zh: SiliconFlow API Key 明文将仅在新建时展示一次
events.summary_zh: SiliconFlow 宣布自 2026 年 11 月 28 日起，API Key 完整明文只在创建成功时展示一次，此后平台不再以任何形式回显。存量 Key 无法再查看或复制，但已配置在客户端、环境变量或第三方工具中的调用不受影响；管理界面和费用明细保留末尾几位用于区分。
key_points_zh: 新政策自 2026-11-28 起生效，平台不再以任何形式回显 API Key 完整明文。
新建 API Key 仅在创建成功时展示一次完整明文，用户需立即复制并妥善保管。
存量 API Key 不再支持查看或复制明文，但已配置在客户端、环境变量或第三方工具中的调用不受影响。
平台保留每个 Key 的末尾几位并写入备注，API 密钥管理界面与费用明细可据此区分 Key。
已遗失明文时，应新建 Key 替换旧 Key，确认替换完成后再删除旧 Key。
events.importance_reason_zh: 密钥明文不可回显改变账户安全与运维流程，存量调用虽不受影响，但遗失密钥的用户必须及时轮换。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow API key plaintext will be shown only once at creation
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow says that from November 28, 2026, a full API key will be shown only once, immediately after successful creation, and will never be displayed again in any form. Existing keys can no longer be viewed or copied, but calls using keys already configured in clients, environment variables or third-party tools are unaffected. The last few digits remain in key notes and billing details for identification.
key_points_en: The policy takes effect on 2026-11-28; the platform will no longer display a full API key in any form.
A new API key's full plaintext is shown only once after successful creation and must be copied and stored immediately.
Existing API keys can no longer be viewed or copied, but calls using keys already configured in clients, environment variables or third-party tools are unaffected.
The last few digits of each key remain in its notes, allowing the API key management page and billing details to distinguish keys.
If a plaintext key is lost, create a replacement, confirm the switch and only then delete the old key.
events.importance_reason_en: Making key plaintext non-retrievable changes account security and operations. Existing calls continue, but users who lose a key must rotate it promptly.

events.title_zh: Cline 扩展与桌面版清理 OpenAI 模型目录并新增两家提供商
events.summary_zh: Cline 4.1.28、Desktop 0.0.51 和 CLI 3.0.76 同步刷新模型目录：OpenAI 提供商不再列出上游标为弃用的模型 ID，ChatGPT 订阅不再列出 gpt-5.3-codex-spark；扩展和桌面版新增 Concentrate 与 Prima Labs。CLI 同时统一第三方声明文件的打包方式。
key_points_zh: OpenAI 目录移除 gpt-4o、gpt-4.1、gpt-5、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.1、gpt-5.3-codex、o3 和 o3-pro 等弃用 ID。
gpt-5.3-codex-spark 不再出现在 ChatGPT 订阅模型列表中。
扩展与桌面版新增 Concentrate 和 Prima Labs 提供商。
CLI npm 包改为在根目录提供一份覆盖所有平台二进制的 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt。
events.importance_reason_zh: 模型目录变化直接影响可选模型和订阅入口，跨客户端同步更新可减少选择失效。
events.title_en: Cline prunes deprecated OpenAI models and adds two providers
events.summary_en: Cline 4.1.28, Desktop 0.0.51 and CLI 3.0.76 refresh their model catalogs: the OpenAI provider no longer lists IDs marked deprecated upstream, and ChatGPT subscriptions no longer list gpt-5.3-codex-spark. The extension and desktop app add Concentrate and Prima Labs, while the CLI consolidates third-party notices across platform binaries.
key_points_en: The OpenAI catalog removes deprecated IDs including gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.1, gpt-5.3-codex, o3 and o3-pro.
gpt-5.3-codex-spark is no longer listed for ChatGPT subscriptions.
The extension and desktop app add Concentrate and Prima Labs providers.
The CLI npm package ships one root-level THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt covering every platform binary.
events.importance_reason_en: The catalog changes directly affect model choices and subscription entry points, while synchronized client updates reduce stale selections.

events.title_zh: Cline SDK 0.2.2 调整 28 家提供商默认模型并精简遥测 API
events.summary_zh: Cline SDK 0.2.2 新增 concentrate 与 primalabs 提供商，改变 28 家提供商的默认模型，并移除上游标为弃用的 OpenAI ID；MiniMax-M3 不再列于 MiniMax coding plans。遥测清理还移除了部分 helper 导出，三个全局设置函数不再接受 options 参数。
key_points_zh: 新增 concentrate 与 primalabs 提供商，并更新 28 家提供商的默认模型。
移除 gpt-4o、gpt-4.1、gpt-5 系列、gpt-5.3-codex、gpt-5.3-codex-spark、gpt-5.4-nano、gpt-image-2、o3 与 o3-pro 等弃用 ID。
MiniMax-M3 不再列于 MiniMax coding plans。
@cline/llms、@cline/shared 和 @cline/core 移除部分遥测 helper 导出；writeGlobalSettings、setTelemetryOptOutGlobally 和 setAutoUpdateEnabledGlobally 去掉 options 参数。
events.importance_reason_zh: 默认模型和 SDK 函数签名变化可能影响集成方，需要在升级时检查模型选择与构建兼容性。
events.title_en: Cline SDK 0.2.2 changes defaults for 28 providers and trims telemetry APIs
events.summary_en: Cline SDK 0.2.2 adds concentrate and primalabs, changes default models for 28 providers and removes OpenAI IDs marked deprecated upstream; MiniMax-M3 is no longer listed on MiniMax coding plans. Telemetry cleanup removes selected helper exports, and writeGlobalSettings, setTelemetryOptOutGlobally and setAutoUpdateEnabledGlobally no longer accept an options argument.
key_points_en: Adds concentrate and primalabs and changes default models for 28 providers.
Removes deprecated IDs including gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gpt-5 variants, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.3-codex-spark, gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-image-2, o3 and o3-pro.
MiniMax-M3 is no longer listed on MiniMax coding plans.
@cline/llms, @cline/shared and @cline/core remove selected telemetry helpers; writeGlobalSettings, setTelemetryOptOutGlobally and setAutoUpdateEnabledGlobally drop their options argument.
events.importance_reason_en: Default-model and SDK signature changes can affect integrations, so upgrades require checking model selection and build compatibility.

events.title_zh: Tibo 称延迟重置功能已上线
events.summary_zh: Tibo 发帖表示“延迟重置功能已上线”。原帖未说明适用产品、账号范围、重置额度或实现方式，不能据此补充具体权益。
key_points_zh: Tibo 直接表示延迟重置功能已上线。
原帖未交代适用产品、账号范围、重置额度或实现方式。
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人账号直接通报一项功能的上线状态，具有一手进展价值；但信息范围有限，需保留归属和未知项。
events.title_en: Tibo says delayed reset is now live
events.summary_en: Tibo posted that the delayed reset feature is now live. The post does not identify the product, eligible accounts, reset allowance, or implementation, so no specific benefits can be inferred.
key_points_en: Tibo directly stated that the delayed reset feature is now live.
The post does not identify the product, eligible accounts, reset allowance, or implementation.
events.importance_reason_en: A direct first-party status update from the responsible executive is useful progress evidence, but the limited detail requires preserving both the attribution and the unknowns.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.9.0 canary 完善工作树、MCP 与多会话工作流
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.9.0 canary 在 11 月 27 日的连续构建中将 Git worktree 支持从实验性转为正式，加入按会话 MCP 来源管理与预连接仲裁、默认延迟 MCP 工具加载，并支持通过 KIMI_CODE_SWARM 以 swarm 模式启动新会话。外部 hooks 新增上下文注入和工具 I/O 重写，TUI 增加全屏搜索与鼠标支持；同批构建也撤除了实验性 auto review。
key_points_zh: Git worktree 支持由实验性转为正式；新建 worktree 可迁移当前活动会话，TUI 为 /tasks、takeover viewers 等加入全屏鼠标支持。
agent-core-v2 默认延迟 MCP 工具加载，启动等待上限为 2 秒，并按会话管理 MCP 来源及执行预连接仲裁。
设置 KIMI_CODE_SWARM 后，新会话可以 swarm 模式启动。
外部 hooks 支持上下文注入与工具 I/O 重写；TUI 可用 Ctrl+F 或 /find 进入全屏搜索。
后续构建撤除实验性 auto review，并修复恢复会话的历史展示、远程控制锁释放和压缩后的 token 计数显示。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这些变化直接影响并行工作区、MCP 初始化与 Agent 扩展方式；撤除 auto review 也改变此前预览的能力范围，需以同一稳定事件记录完整演进。
events.title_en: Kimi Code CLI 2.9.0 canary refines worktrees, MCP and multisession workflows
events.summary_en: Continuous Kimi Code CLI 2.9.0 canary builds on November 27 graduate Git worktree support from experimental status, add per-session MCP source management with pre-connect arbitration, defer MCP tools by default, and allow new sessions to start in swarm mode via KIMI_CODE_SWARM. External hooks gain context injection and tool I/O rewriting, while the TUI adds fullscreen search and mouse support. The same build stream also removes experimental auto review.
key_points_en: Git worktree support graduates from experimental status; creating a worktree can move the active session, and fullscreen mouse support is added for /tasks, takeover viewers and other docked dialogs or selectors.
agent-core-v2 defers MCP tools by default, caps startup waiting at 2 seconds, and manages MCP sources per session with pre-connect arbitration.
Setting KIMI_CODE_SWARM lets new sessions start in swarm mode.
External hooks support context injection and tool I/O rewriting; the TUI adds fullscreen search with Ctrl+F or /find.
A later build removes experimental auto review and fixes resumed-session history display, remote-control lock release and post-compaction token-count display.
events.importance_reason_en: These changes directly affect parallel workspaces, MCP initialization and Agent extensibility. Removing auto review also narrows the earlier preview, so the full progression belongs in one stable event.

corrections.reason_zh: 后续 canary 撤除实验性 auto review，将 Git worktree 支持从实验性转为正式，并补充 MCP 延迟加载、按会话仲裁、swarm 启动和外部 hooks 扩展；原首次采集时间保持不变。
corrections.reason_en: Later canary builds remove experimental auto review, graduate Git worktree support, and add deferred MCP loading, per-session MCP arbitration, swarm startup and external-hook extensions. The original first-collected time is preserved.

events.title_zh: 美团报告 CARE 递归自我改进客服模型实践
events.summary_zh: 美团介绍 CARE 闭环：31B 客服模型承接部分线上流量后，由外部强模型巡检、归因并构造首个错误决策的修复，再通过在线自蒸馏训练模型本身。五轮迭代后，巡检 Bad Case 率从 6.42% 降至 1.97%，部分地区满意度追平或略超线上强模型；全量替换的服务成本模型估算下降 70.5%。
key_points_zh: 五轮迭代后，31B 模型巡检 Bad Case 率从 6.42% 降至 1.97%。
部分地区线上满意度从落后强模型 4.57 个百分点追平，后续版本略高于同期强模型。
全量替换时单均服务成本降低 70.5%，模型服务部分降低 92.8%；切换一半流量时成本降低 35.8%。
巡检、归因、修复构造和上线审批由外部模型或人类完成；OPSD 的 Teacher 是获得特权信息的冻结模型副本。
部署在覆盖七个地区、多种语言的部分外卖售后流量中，尚未全量上线。
归因准确率和模拟器与线上环境的差距尚未量化，成本口径不含研发、存储、网络和额外运维人力。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是中等规模模型在真实客服流量中持续纠错的完整工程案例，同时保留外部评判、人工审批和未量化误差边界。
events.title_en: Meituan reports CARE recursive self-improvement for customer-service models
events.summary_en: Meituan describes CARE, where a 31B customer-service model handles part of live traffic while external models inspect failures, attribute responsibility and construct repairs for the first wrong decision before on-policy self-distillation updates the model. After five iterations, inspected bad-case rate fell from 6.42% to 1.97%, satisfaction in some regions reached or slightly exceeded the strong online model, and modeled full-replacement service cost fell 70.5%.
key_points_en: After five iterations, the 31B model’s inspected bad-case rate fell from 6.42% to 1.97%.
In some regions, satisfaction recovered from 4.57 percentage points below the strong model to parity, with later versions slightly above the contemporaneous model.
Full replacement cut service cost per case by 70.5% and the model-service portion by 92.8%; shifting half the traffic cut cost by 35.8%.
External models or humans perform inspection, attribution, repair construction and launch approval; the OPSD Teacher is a frozen model copy given privileged information.
Deployment is partial across seven regions and multiple languages in food-delivery after-sales support, not a full rollout.
Attribution accuracy and simulator fidelity remain unquantified, and cost figures exclude R&D, storage, networking and additional operations labor.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a complete engineering case of continuous correction for a mid-sized model on real customer-service traffic, while preserving external judgment, human approval and unquantified error boundaries.

events.title_zh: Tibo 称 GPT-6.2 计费错误已修复，资源消耗较上周快约 40%
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，GPT-6.2 发布时错误地降低了大多数用户使用 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 的订阅费用，现已修复；同样的任务现在会消耗更多资源，GPT-6.2 的资源消耗速度较上周约快 40%。原帖未给出具体价目、套餐范围或计算口径。
key_points_zh: Tibo 承认 GPT-6.2 发布时存在计费错误，误降低了大多数用户使用 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 的订阅费用。
Tibo 表示该问题已经修复。
同样的任务现在消耗更多资源；按 Tibo 表述，GPT-6.2 的资源消耗速度较上周约快 40%。
原帖未提供具体价目、套餐范围或计算口径，40% 不能解读为统一价格涨幅。
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人直接披露计费错误、修复状态与资源消耗变化，会影响用户成本预期；约 40% 是本人对消耗速度的比较，不是独立核验的价格结论。
events.title_en: Tibo says GPT-6.2 billing error is fixed and resources deplete about 40% faster
events.summary_en: Tibo said subscription charges for most users of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol were mistakenly reduced at launch and that the billing error has been fixed. The same tasks now consume more resources, with GPT-6.2 resource use running about 40% faster than the previous week. The post gives no exact prices, plan scope, or calculation method.
key_points_en: Tibo acknowledged a billing error at the GPT-6.2 launch that mistakenly reduced subscription charges for most users of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol.
Tibo said the issue has been fixed.
The same tasks now consume more resources; according to Tibo, GPT-6.2 resource use is running about 40% faster than the previous week.
The post provides no exact prices, plan scope, or calculation method, so 40% must not be read as a uniform price increase.
events.importance_reason_en: The executive's first-party disclosure of the billing error, fix status, and changed resource use affects cost expectations. The roughly 40% figure is his comparison of depletion speed, not an independently verified pricing conclusion.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.4.2 收紧网页授权并改进自动化与 Code Mode
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 2.4.2 为 GPT-6.2 Sol、Astra 和 gpt-latest 别名启用专用系统提示，将图像与视频生成工具移入 Code Mode，并把网页 fetch 的“始终允许”收窄到当前站点。自动化失败后会记录失败并继续下次调度，超时 shell 命令会被终止；服务档位成本估算、会话迁移、SDK 和插件接口也得到改进。
key_points_zh: GPT-6.2 Sol、Astra 与 gpt-latest 别名使用 GPT-6.2 系统提示。
generate_image 和 generate_video 移入 Code Mode，工具定义不再为每次请求增加约 700 tokens。
网页 fetch 的 Always allow 只适用于该站点；旧授权保持原样。
自动化失败后记录失败并继续按计划运行；创建会话或目录失效、配置无效时仍暂停，超时 shell 命令会停止并失败。
服务档位成本估算采用其自身价格及长上下文费率；移动会话会同时移动子代理，workerd SDK 转发 alarm 以支持空闲远程工作区挂起。
events.importance_reason_zh: 授权范围收窄直接降低过度许可风险，Code Mode 与自动化变化则影响 token 成本和任务连续性。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.4.2 narrows web approvals and improves automations and Code Mode
events.summary_en: OpenCode 2.4.2 gives GPT-6.2 Sol, Astra and gpt-latest aliases a dedicated system prompt, moves image and video generation into Code Mode, and scopes web-fetch “Always allow” to the current site. Failed automations are recorded and continue on schedule, timed-out shell commands are stopped, and service-tier cost estimates, session moves, SDK behavior and plugin APIs improve.
key_points_en: GPT-6.2 Sol, Astra and gpt-latest aliases use a GPT-6.2 system prompt.
generate_image and generate_video move into Code Mode, removing about 700 tool-definition tokens from every request.
Web-fetch “Always allow” applies only to that site; approvals saved by earlier versions remain unchanged.
Failed automations are recorded and continue on schedule, but pause when their session, directory or setup is invalid; timed-out shell commands stop and fail.
Service-tier estimates use their own prices and long-context rates; moving a session moves its subagents, and the workerd SDK forwards alarms so idle remote workspaces can suspend.
events.importance_reason_en: Narrower approval scope reduces over-permission risk, while Code Mode and automation changes affect token cost and task continuity.

events.title_zh: MiniMax 发布 H3 Family 并公布视频与图像阶梯价格
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 将开源 H3 扩展为包含旗舰模型、H3-Image 系列和合作衍生模型的 H3 Family。官方称开源 100 天内产生 1,472 个衍生模型、下载超过 1.48 亿次，并公布 H3、H3-Highspeed、H3-Lite 的视频起步价及两款 H3-Image 的图像输出 token 价格。
key_points_zh: 官方称 H3 开源 100 天内形成 1,472 个衍生模型，累计下载超过 1.48 亿次。
H3、H3-Highspeed、H3-Lite 的视频输出分别从每秒 $0.08、$0.04、$0.025 起；分辨率与高速模式影响价格。
H3-Image 与 H3-Image Highspeed 的图像输出价格分别为每百万 tokens $3.80 和 $7.60。
Family 包含 fal、HeyGen、Suno、Pika、Creatify 等合作衍生模型，并可通过 MiniMax Open Platform 等渠道获取。
下载量、速度与价格比较均为官方披露，不代表独立评测。
events.importance_reason_zh: 系列化模型、衍生生态和明确计价单位直接影响多模态创作选型与成本估算。
events.title_en: MiniMax introduces H3 Family with tiered video and image pricing
events.summary_en: MiniMax has expanded open-source H3 into the H3 Family, including flagship models, the H3-Image series and partner derivatives. The company claims 1,472 derivative models and more than 148 million downloads in 100 days, and lists starting video prices for H3, H3-Highspeed and H3-Lite plus per-million-token image output prices for H3-Image and H3-Image Highspeed.
key_points_en: MiniMax claims 1,472 derivatives and more than 148 million downloads within 100 days of open-sourcing H3.
Video output starts at $0.08/s for H3, $0.04/s for H3-Highspeed and $0.025/s for H3-Lite; resolution and speed mode affect pricing.
H3-Image and H3-Image Highspeed image output cost $3.80 and $7.60 per million tokens, respectively.
The Family includes derivatives from fal, HeyGen, Suno, Pika and Creatify and is available through MiniMax Open Platform and other channels.
Download, speed and price comparisons are company disclosures, not independent evaluations.
events.importance_reason_en: The model family, derivative ecosystem and explicit billing units directly affect multimodal creation choices and cost estimates.

events.title_zh: Devin 扩展 Slack 自动化与企业管理能力
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 26 日更新加入 Slack 频道自动化派发通知和 Oncall 响应语言设置，并分页读取企业服务用户及其 API。Changes 面板可查看已删除文件内容，Bots 恢复此前聊天状态；共享对话框按真实授权显示所有者与访问权限，并修复 Enterprise Grid Slack 访问和扫描结果跳转。
key_points_zh: 自动化可通过 v3 API 的 notifications.slack 把派发状态通知发送到 Slack 频道；Devin Oncall 响应者与事件设置新增响应语言下拉框。
服务用户列表与 manageable-service-users API 按调用者 grants 分页，避免大型组织一次加载全部用户导致超时或错误。
会话共享对话框显示所有者、仅显示真实授予访问权限的角色组，并在账户策略禁止共享时隐藏按钮；搜索访问列表改读资源 grants。
Changes 面板显示 Devin 删除文件的内容；从其他标签返回 Bots 时恢复原会话和工作区标签；批量代码扫描卡打开对应扫描的 findings。
Slack Enterprise Grid 中，Bot 的“Who can message”设为工作区 anyone 后可接收私信和提及；Slack“not a member”回复新增重新授权设置链接。
events.importance_reason_zh: 自动化和企业 API 的扩展提升工作流集成与大规模组织可用性，访问权限和扫描导航修复则关系安全审计与操作效率。
events.title_en: Devin expands Slack automations and enterprise administration
events.summary_en: Devin's November 26 update adds Slack-channel automation dispatch notifications and an Oncall response-language setting, and pages service users and their API through the caller's grants. The Changes pane can show deleted file contents, Bots restores the previous chat state, and the share dialog reflects real access. It also fixes Enterprise Grid Slack access and scan-result navigation.
key_points_en: Automations can post dispatch status notifications to Slack channels through notifications.slack in the v3 API; Devin Oncall responders and incident settings gain a response-language dropdown.
The service-user list and manageable-service-users API page through the caller's grants, avoiding timeouts and errors when very large organizations would otherwise load every user at once.
The session share dialog shows the owner, lists role groups only where they grant access and hides the share button when account policy blocks sharing; access-list search reads the resource's grants.
The Changes pane shows contents of files Devin deleted; returning to Bots restores the open session and workspace tab; a bulk code-scan card opens that scan's findings.
On Slack Enterprise Grid, a Bot set to allow anyone in the Slack workspace can receive DMs and mentions; the Slack not-a-member reply links to settings for re-authorizing a stale connection.
events.importance_reason_en: The automation and enterprise API additions improve workflow integration and large-organization usability, while access-control and scan-navigation fixes support safer auditing and more efficient operations.

events.title_zh: Copilot 代码审查未选计费方时将默认组织付费
events.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布，从 2026 年 12 月 30 日起，Business 或 Enterprise 组织中持有 Copilot 许可证的成员若未选择代码审查计费方，审查费用将默认由组织承担。要维持成员额度计费需在此之前选择 Member；已保存的 Member 或 Organization 选择不变，部分无 AI Credits 付费用量、计费锁定或无可计费客户的账户会设为 Member。
key_points_zh: 2026 年 12 月 30 日起，未保存计费选择时默认由组织支付代码审查费用。
适用于 Business 或 Enterprise 组织中有 Copilot 许可证的成员。
选择 Member 可保持使用成员 Copilot entitlement；已有 Member 或 Organization 选择保持不变。
无 AI Credits 付费用量、计费锁定或无可计费客户的账户将设为 Member。
组织计费需要启用 AI Credits 付费用量，并可能增加组织支出。
events.importance_reason_zh: 默认计费方变化会直接影响企业成本归属，管理员需要在生效前检查政策设置。
events.title_en: Copilot code review will default to organization billing when unset
events.summary_en: GitHub announced that from December 30, 2026, code reviews by licensed members in Business or Enterprise organizations will be billed to the organization when no billing choice is saved. Selecting Member before then preserves member-entitlement billing; existing Member or Organization choices remain unchanged, while accounts without AI Credits paid usage, with billing locks or without a billable customer are set to Member.
key_points_en: From December 30, 2026, an unset billing choice defaults code-review charges to the organization.
The change applies to licensed members in Business or Enterprise organizations.
Selecting Member preserves member Copilot entitlement billing; existing Member or Organization choices remain unchanged.
Accounts without AI Credits paid usage, with billing locks or without a billable customer are set to Member.
Organization billing requires AI Credits paid usage and can increase organizational spending.
events.importance_reason_en: The default billing change directly affects enterprise cost allocation, so administrators need to review policy settings before it takes effect.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.117 强化沙箱与权限边界并修复会话恢复
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.117 系列让自定义 Agent 显式选择工具，为沙箱命令增加自定义 CA 证书配置，并修复 MCP 批准范围、恢复会话和后台 Agent 连续性。后续补丁还恢复可写 Git worktree 中的提交、分支与暂存操作，避免退出后执行排队提示，并加入模型退役提示与不可用模型处理。
key_points_zh: 自定义 Agent 可显式选择工具；无 prompt 的自定义 Agent 文件也会遵守工具列表。
sandbox.userPolicy.network.extraCaCertificates 可在用户或托管设置中信任 TLS 拦截代理使用的自定义 CA；现有仓库设置文件在可写 Git worktree 的沙箱命令和 Agent 编辑中保持只读。
MCP 工具批准不再因服务器名与内置权限类型重合而同时批准 shell、memory store 等内置请求；/mcp 与 --disable-mcp-server 不区分服务器名大小写，精确匹配优先。
后台 Agent 在 CLI 重启并恢复会话后继续对话；GitHub 登录尚未完成时也可加载已连接 Copilot Connectors。
权限提示说明恢复会话后仍有效的批准；计划模式在创建分支或安装包前要求批准，被自动拒绝的动作可在后续消息中重新审查一次。
/model 标记退役模型；不可用模型不再静默切换提供商，共享会话可恢复后改用 /model；/exit 或 Ctrl+D 会丢弃排队提示，PowerShell hooks 保留原生退出码。
events.importance_reason_zh: 工具暴露、沙箱证书兼容、MCP 批准隔离和会话恢复变化直接影响 Agent 自动化安全与企业部署可靠性。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.117 tightens sandbox and permission boundaries and fixes session recovery
events.summary_en: The Copilot CLI 1.0.117 series lets custom agents opt into explicit tools, adds custom CA certificates for sandboxed commands, and fixes MCP approval scope, session recovery and background-agent continuity. Later patches restore commits, branches and stashing in writable Git worktrees, discard queued prompts on exit, and add model-retirement notices and unavailable-model handling.
key_points_en: Custom agents can explicitly select tools, and custom agent files without prompts still honor their tool list.

sandbox.userPolicy.network.extraCaCertificates trusts custom CAs used by TLS-intercepting proxies from user or managed settings; existing repository settings files stay read-only to sandboxed commands and Agent edits in writable Git worktrees.

Approving an MCP server's tools no longer also approves built-in requests such as shell commands or memory stores when names collide; /mcp and --disable-mcp-server match server names case-insensitively, with exact matches taking precedence.
Background agents continue after a CLI restart and session resume; connected Copilot Connectors can load while GitHub sign-in is still finishing.
Permission help explains which approvals survive resume; plan mode asks before branch creation or package installation, and an automatically denied action can be reviewed once after a later request.

/model marks retiring models; unavailable models no longer trigger silent provider switching, shared sessions can resume and change models, /exit or Ctrl+D discards queued prompts, and PowerShell hooks preserve native exit codes.
events.importance_reason_en: Tool exposure, sandbox certificate compatibility, MCP approval isolation and session recovery directly affect the safety and reliability of Agent automation in enterprise deployments.

corrections.reason_zh: 补充 1.0.117-3 至 1.0.117-5 及汇总发布说明中的自定义 CA、MCP 批准隔离、worktree 恢复和退出队列清理等变化；首次采集时间保持不变。
corrections.reason_en: Adds custom CA support, MCP approval isolation, worktree recovery and queued-prompt cleanup from 1.0.117-3 through 1.0.117-5 and the consolidated release notes. The first-collected time is preserved.

events.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 推荐试用 Gemini Neon
events.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 发帖建议用户试用 Gemini Neon，并称它是一款好模型。原帖未提供评测数据、具体场景或比较结果，该表述属于负责人个人推荐。
key_points_zh: Demis Hassabis 建议试用 Gemini Neon，并称它是一款好模型。
原帖没有评测数据、具体场景或比较结果，应按个人推荐而非独立性能验证处理。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是负责人对已发布模型的一手推荐与使用判断，按观点保留；它不构成新发布，也不能替代独立评测。
events.title_en: Demis Hassabis recommends trying Gemini Neon
events.summary_en: Demis Hassabis suggested trying Gemini Neon and called it a good model. The post provides no benchmarks, specific use cases, or comparisons, so the statement is a personal recommendation from the executive.
key_points_en: Demis Hassabis suggested trying Gemini Neon and called it a good model.
The post provides no benchmarks, specific use cases, or comparisons, so it is a personal recommendation rather than independent performance evidence.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a first-party recommendation and usage judgment from the executive and is worth retaining as an opinion. It is neither a new release nor a substitute for independent evaluation.

events.title_zh: pi 1.6.1 扩展 codemode 决策模型并修复会话与工具可靠性
events.summary_zh: pi 1.6.1 让 codemode models.classify() 可调用 GitHub Copilot 的 gpt-6-luna-decisions 和 Radius 决策模型，并在结果中返回 responseId；OpenRouter System One 会填入 generation ID，并用实际计费成本替代目录估算。更新拆分通知设置、扩展 Gemini 严格工具与提供商错误钩子，同时修复大型会话加载、Windows 子进程退出、MCP 请求和多项模型兼容问题。
key_points_zh: codemode models.classify() 新增 GitHub Copilot gpt-6-luna-decisions 与 Radius 决策模型，结果包含 responseId。
OpenRouter System One 将 responseId 填为 generation ID，并以实际计费成本替换目录估算。
showCacheMissNotices 拆分为 notices.cacheMisses、notices.cacheWarming、notices.compactionCosts 和 notices.reasoningDrops；旧 getter/setter 移除，改用 getNotices() 和 setNotice()。
为 google-generative-ai 和 google-vertex 模型增加 compat.supportsStrictMode，并修复带 vendor 前缀的 Gemini 3+ 模型的严格工具、tool-call ID 和函数响应图片支持。
after_provider_response 现覆盖 HTTP 4xx/5xx 响应和每次重试，并扩展到 OpenAI、Azure OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Google 模型。
关键修复覆盖约 120k 条及以上 compaction 后记录的会话加载、Windows SIGHUP/taskkill、MCP 字符串请求 ID 与大型事件、GPT-6.2 prefix_mismatch 和临时提供商错误重试。
events.importance_reason_zh: 决策模型调用、计费口径和扩展 API 的变化直接影响自动化工作流；会话、Windows 和 MCP 修复则消除阻断性故障。
events.title_en: pi 1.6.1 expands codemode decision models and fixes session and tool reliability
events.summary_en: pi 1.6.1 lets codemode models.classify() call GitHub Copilot's gpt-6-luna-decisions and Radius decision models and return responseId; OpenRouter System One supplies its generation ID and replaces the catalog estimate with billed cost. The release splits notice settings, extends Gemini strict-tool and provider-error hooks, and fixes large-session loading, Windows child-process shutdown, MCP requests and several model compatibility issues.
key_points_en: codemode models.classify() adds GitHub Copilot gpt-6-luna-decisions and Radius decision models, with responseId in the result.
OpenRouter System One sets responseId to its generation ID and replaces the catalog estimate with billed cost.

showCacheMissNotices splits into notices.cacheMisses, notices.cacheWarming, notices.compactionCosts and notices.reasoningDrops; the old getter/setter are removed in favor of getNotices() and setNotice().
Adds compat.supportsStrictMode for google-generative-ai and google-vertex models and fixes strict tools, tool-call IDs and images in function responses for vendor-prefixed Gemini 3+ model IDs.
after_provider_response now fires for HTTP 4xx/5xx responses and every retried attempt, extending to OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models.

Key fixes cover sessions with about 120,000 or more entries after compaction, Windows SIGHUP/taskkill handling, MCP string request IDs and large events, GPT-6.2 prefix_mismatch, and retries for temporary provider failures.
events.importance_reason_en: Decision-model access, billing semantics and extension API changes directly affect automated workflows, while the session, Windows and MCP fixes remove blocking failures.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code Desktop 1.5.0 增加会话上下文视图并改进 Agent 控制
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code Desktop 1.5.0 加入实验性提示预测、上下文用量视图和会话引用，并在 Always Ask 模式下自动批准静态验证为只读的 Bash 命令，但 ask 权限规则仍可要求逐次确认。桌面版还支持更新重启后继续会话、侧聊停止与中断、失败回合原地继续，并修复 Windows SSH 远程终端和未打开会话的 MCP 启动问题。
key_points_zh: Settings > Lab 新增提示预测开关，可在回合完成后于输入框占位处显示预测的下一提示。
实验性 Context usage 在编辑器环和会话信息侧栏展示上下文用量与组成，并可列出模型收到的每一项；@ 菜单新增实验性 Sessions 引用，可按标题、最后消息或会话 ID 搜索。
静态验证为只读的 Bash 命令在 Always Ask 模式下自动批准；ask 权限规则可保留逐次确认。
移除 Agent 和 AgentSwarm 使用调用方会话历史启动子代理的实验性 fork 参数；更新重启后可继续运行中的会话，失败回合也可原地继续而不添加合成 Continue 用户消息。
侧聊支持停止按钮和双击 Escape 中断，关闭非空或活动侧聊前会提示，并终止后台侧聊 Agent；secondary_model 的当前选项会及时提供给 Agent。
修复 Windows SSH 远程项目的内置终端，并避免归档、删除或分叉未打开会话时启动 MCP；跨主机会话锁会自动回收，但共享状态目录不再跨机器或容器保护活跃持有者。
events.importance_reason_zh: 上下文可见性、工具权限和会话连续性变化直接影响桌面 Agent 的日常使用，Windows SSH 与 MCP 生命周期修复则减少环境阻断。
events.title_en: Kimi Code Desktop 1.5.0 adds context visibility and improves Agent controls
events.summary_en: Kimi Code Desktop 1.5.0 adds experimental prompt prediction, a context-usage view and session mentions. It automatically approves statically verified read-only Bash commands even in Always Ask mode, while an ask permission rule can still require confirmation. Desktop also continues running sessions after update restarts, adds side-chat stop and interrupt controls, resumes failed turns in place, and fixes Windows SSH terminals and MCP startup for unopened sessions.
key_points_en: A prompt-prediction switch in Settings > Lab shows a predicted next prompt in the composer placeholder after a turn completes.

Experimental Context usage shows context consumption and composition in the composer ring and session sidebar, with a list of everything the model receives; an experimental Sessions entry in the @ menu is searchable by title, last message or session ID.
Statically verified read-only Bash commands are auto-approved in Always Ask mode; an ask permission rule can retain per-command confirmation.

Removes the experimental fork parameter that let Agent and AgentSwarm start subagents with the caller's history; running sessions can continue after update restarts, and failed turns can resume in place without a synthetic Continue user message.

Side chats gain a stop button and double-Escape interrupt, prompt before non-empty or active tabs close, and terminate their background Agent; current secondary_model choices are exposed to the Agent as soon as they change.

Fixes the built-in terminal for Windows SSH remote projects and avoids starting MCP when archiving, deleting or forking an unopened session; cross-host locks are reclaimed automatically, but shared state directories no longer protect live holders across machines or containers.
events.importance_reason_en: Context visibility, tool permissions and session continuity directly affect daily desktop Agent use, while the Windows SSH and MCP lifecycle fixes reduce environment-specific blockers.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.8.0 稳定化 MCP 启动与媒体会话恢复
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.8.0 稳定版加入实验性提示预测、上下文用量视图和 Web 会话引用，并让会话创建与恢复等待初始 MCP 连接完成，等待上限为各服务器的启动超时。更新还可在上传图片或视频不可读且提供商返回匹配的 400 错误后，经文件状态端点确认并从本地原件内联重发；静态只读 Bash 命令的自动批准规则也得到扩展。
key_points_zh: 设置 KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_PROMPT_PREDICTION=1 后，可按 Tab 或右方向键接受预测的下一提示。
新增实验性 Context usage 视图；kimi web 的 @ 菜单新增实验性 Sessions 引用，可按标题、最后消息或会话 ID 搜索。
静态验证为只读的 Bash 命令在 Always Ask 模式下自动批准，ask 权限规则仍可要求确认；Agent 和 AgentSwarm 的调用方历史 fork 参数被移除。
会话创建和恢复会等待初始 MCP 服务器连接落定，上限为各服务器启动超时，并避免 CLI 启动时重复启动 MCP 服务器。
上传图片或视频不可读时，在匹配的提供商 400 错误后通过文件状态端点确认，永久标记跳过重新上传，并从本地原件内联重发。
保存的模型已从 config.toml 移除时，会话会恢复并提示选择其他模型，但在通过 /model 选定可用模型前阻止发送提示。
events.importance_reason_zh: MCP 工具初始化、媒体上传恢复和模型失效处理直接关系会话可用性，只读命令自动批准则改变工具权限边界。
events.title_en: Kimi Code CLI 2.8.0 stabilizes MCP startup and media-session recovery
events.summary_en: The stable Kimi Code CLI 2.8.0 release adds experimental prompt prediction, context-usage visibility and Web session mentions. Session creation and resume now wait for initial MCP connections to settle, bounded by each server's startup timeout. If an uploaded image or video is unreadable and the provider returns a matching 400 error, the CLI confirms file status and resends the local original inline; automatic approval for statically read-only Bash commands is also expanded.
key_points_en: With KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_PROMPT_PREDICTION=1, Tab or Right Arrow accepts the predicted next prompt.
Adds experimental Context usage visibility and an experimental Sessions entry in the kimi web @ menu, searchable by title, last message or session ID.

Statically verified read-only Bash commands are auto-approved in Always Ask mode unless an ask permission rule requires confirmation; the caller-history fork parameter for Agent and AgentSwarm is removed.
Session creation and resume wait for initial MCP connections to settle, bounded by each server's startup timeout, and CLI startup avoids starting MCP servers more than once.
For an unreadable uploaded image or video, a matching provider 400 error triggers file-status confirmation, permanent skip-reupload marking and inline resend from the local original.
Sessions whose saved model was removed from config.toml resume with a warning to choose another model, but prompts are blocked until an available model is selected with /model.
events.importance_reason_en: MCP tool initialization, media-upload recovery and removed-model handling directly affect session availability, while read-only command auto-approval changes the tool-permission boundary.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 展示 dot 在用户离岗时监控项目并调用 Codex 的工作流
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方 YouTube 简介给出的 Raymond 工作流显示，dot 可监视指定的 Slack 与值班频道，把相关反馈归并到现有 Linear 工单，或新建工单并链接 Slack 消息；仅在停机、关键事故或多份核心功能故障报告时提醒用户。简介中的提示词还允许 dot 在启用 Codex 时启动调查线程、发送发现，并在用户审核前不修改代码。
key_points_zh: dot 监视指定的 Slack 与值班频道，持续关注进行中的项目。
相关反馈可归并到现有 Linear 工单，必要时新建工单并链接 Slack 消息。
仅在停机、关键事故或多份核心功能故障报告时提醒用户。
启用 Codex 时，dot 可启动线程调查值班告警并发送发现；提示词明确要求用户审核前不改代码。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是对 dot 异步监控、工单流转和 Codex 调查协作的具体说明，有助于判断 Agent 在无人值守场景中的边界；材料仅为官方简介，未独立验证运行效果或普遍可用性。
events.title_en: OpenAI shows a dot workflow for monitoring projects and invoking Codex while the user is away
events.summary_en: A Raymond workflow in OpenAI's official YouTube description shows a dot monitoring designated Slack and on-call channels, grouping related feedback into an existing Linear ticket or creating a new ticket linked to Slack messages, and pinging the user only for an outage, critical incident or multiple reports of a broken core feature. The sample prompt also lets the dot start a Codex investigation thread when Codex is enabled, send findings, and make no code changes before user review.
key_points_en: The dot monitors designated Slack and on-call channels to keep watch over ongoing projects.
Related feedback can be grouped into an existing Linear ticket, with a new ticket created and linked to Slack messages when needed.
The user is pinged only for an outage, critical incident or multiple reports of a broken core feature.
When Codex is enabled, the dot can start a thread to investigate on-call alerts and send findings; the prompt explicitly requires no code changes before user review.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a concrete account of asynchronous monitoring, ticket routing and Codex investigation in a dot workflow, helping define agent boundaries in unattended work. The evidence is limited to the official description, with no independent verification of results or general availability.

events.title_zh: 马斯克分享 Grok 在特斯拉公路旅行中的使用体验
events.summary_zh: 马斯克表示：“Grok is so much fun on Tesla road trips!” 这是一条关于 Grok 车载使用体验的简短反馈，未说明具体功能、车型、软件版本或可用范围。
key_points_zh: 马斯克称 Grok 在特斯拉公路旅行中很有趣。
反馈来自负责人本人账号。
原帖没有提供具体功能、车型、版本或地区可用性。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是负责人对 Grok 实际使用场景的一手反馈，但不应扩展为完整功能发布。
events.title_en: Musk shares Grok experience on Tesla road trips
events.summary_en: Musk wrote, “Grok is so much fun on Tesla road trips!” The post is brief feedback about using Grok in a car and does not identify specific features, vehicle models, software versions or availability regions.
key_points_en: Musk says Grok is fun on Tesla road trips.
The feedback comes from his own account.
The post gives no specific features, vehicle model, software version or regional availability.
events.importance_reason_en: This is first-hand usage feedback from a responsible person, but it should not be expanded into a full feature launch.

events.title_zh: B.AI 升级积分充值，新增 $200、$500、$1,000 套餐
events.summary_zh: B.AI 宣布升级 credit 充值功能，新增 $200、$500、$1,000 三档套餐，并允许自定义充值金额，单笔上限 $1,000。官方称汇率展示更清晰并支持多种支付渠道，但未给出具体兑换汇率。
key_points_zh: 新增 $200、$500、$1,000 三档 credit 套餐。
支持输入任意充值金额，单笔上限 $1,000。
官方称兑换汇率展示更清晰并支持多种支付渠道；原材料未列出汇率数值。
events.importance_reason_zh: 具体套餐和单笔上限为高频及团队用户提供新的预算选择，但实际成本仍取决于未披露的兑换汇率。
events.title_en: B.AI upgrades credit top-ups with $200, $500 and $1,000 packages
events.summary_en: B.AI announced an upgrade to credit top-ups with new $200, $500 and $1,000 packages, custom top-up amounts and a $1,000 per-transaction cap. The company says exchange rates are displayed more clearly and multiple payment channels are supported, but it did not provide the actual exchange rates.
key_points_en: Three new credit top-up packages are available: $200, $500 and $1,000.
Users can enter a custom top-up amount, with a $1,000 cap per transaction.
B.AI says exchange rates are shown more clearly and multiple payment channels are supported; the imported material does not list exchange-rate values.
events.importance_reason_en: The concrete packages and per-transaction cap give frequent and team users additional budget options, but actual cost still depends on exchange rates that were not disclosed.

events.title_zh: B.AI Chat 上线 MiniMax H3 Image 与 Highspeed
events.summary_zh: B.AI 宣布 MiniMax-H3-Image 和 MiniMax-H3-Image-Highspeed 在首次 API 发布后现已登陆 B.AI Chat，手机与网页端均可进行图像生成和编辑。官方称两款模型最多支持 16 张参考图、原生 4K 输出，B.AI 的 20% 折扣也同时覆盖 API 与 Chat。
key_points_zh: 两款模型在 B.AI Chat 移动端和网页端全面可用。
支持图像生成与编辑，最多 16 张参考图，原生 4K 输出。
B.AI 20% 折扣扩展至 Chat，现同时适用于 API 和 Chat；原文未说明截止日期。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是 H3 Image 的第三方平台可用性扩展，并附带明确折扣，但折扣期限未披露。
events.title_en: B.AI Chat adds MiniMax H3 Image and Highspeed after their API release
events.summary_en: B.AI says MiniMax-H3-Image and MiniMax-H3-Image-Highspeed are now available on B.AI Chat after their initial API release, with image generation and editing on mobile and web. The company claims support for up to 16 reference images and native 4K output, and says B.AI's 20% discount now covers both API and Chat.
key_points_en: Both models are now available across B.AI Chat on mobile and web.
They support image generation and editing, up to 16 reference images and native 4K output.
B.AI's 20% discount has been extended to Chat and now covers both API and Chat; the source does not state an end date.
events.importance_reason_en: This expands H3 Image onto a third-party chat platform with a stated discount, although the discount deadline was not disclosed.

events.title_zh: WorldRouter 黑色星期五充值返 credits，最高 $100
events.summary_zh: WorldRouter 于 11 月 25 日至 12 月 2 日推出充值返 credits：$100 返 $5、$500 返 $30、$1,000 返 $100。另有 3 名中奖者各得 $20 credits，需点赞、转发、标记 3 位好友并提交账户邮箱。
key_points_zh: 抽奖 3 名用户各得 $20 credits，条件包括点赞、转发、标记 3 位好友及回复或私信账户邮箱。
events.importance_reason_zh: 明确的充值返还比例、额度和期限直接影响平台使用成本，属于可核算的限时优惠。
events.title_en: WorldRouter offers up to $100 in credits for Black Friday top-ups
events.summary_en: WorldRouter is offering credit bonuses from November 25 through December 2: top up $100 to receive $5, $500 to receive $30, or $1,000 to receive $100. Three giveaway winners will also receive $20 in credits each; entry requires liking, reposting, tagging three friends and providing the account email address.
key_points_en: The promotion runs from November 25 to December 2, 2026.
Top-ups of $100, $500 and $1,000 receive $5, $30 and $100 in credits, respectively.
Three winners receive $20 in credits each; entry requires a like, repost, three friend tags and an account email address submitted by reply or direct message.
events.importance_reason_en: The stated top-up bonus amounts, ratios and dates provide concrete, calculable terms for a limited-time change in platform costs.

events.title_zh: WorldRouter 上线四款 Gemini 4，并补充 Hydrogen 价格
events.summary_zh: WorldRouter 宣布 Hydrogen、Neon、Carbon、Argon 四款 Gemini 4 模型均可在平台使用，并称四者都有 1M-token 上下文。后续帖子补充 Hydrogen 每百万 tokens 输入 $0.675、输出 $3.375、缓存读取 $0.03375；其余三款价格未出现在已导入材料中。
key_points_zh: Hydrogen、Neon、Carbon、Argon 四款 Gemini 4 模型已在 WorldRouter 上线。
WorldRouter 称四款模型均有 1M-token 上下文窗口。
工作负载建议为：Hydrogen 用于成本敏感任务，Neon 用于科学与图表密集任务，Carbon 用于长多步任务，Argon 作为成熟基线。
Hydrogen 每百万 tokens 输入 $0.675、输出 $3.375、缓存读取 $0.03375。
其余三款模型价格和原帖引用的基准图表数值仍未取得。
events.importance_reason_zh: 在可用模型和上下文规格之外补齐 Hydrogen 的可核算价格，便于平台用户进行成本比较。
events.title_en: WorldRouter lists four Gemini 4 models and adds Hydrogen pricing
events.summary_en: WorldRouter says Hydrogen, Neon, Carbon and Argon are available on its platform and all have 1M-token context windows. A follow-up lists Hydrogen at $0.675 input, $3.375 output and $0.03375 cached read per million tokens; prices for the other three models are absent from the imported material.
key_points_en: Four Gemini 4 models are available on WorldRouter: Hydrogen, Neon, Carbon and Argon.
WorldRouter says all four models have 1M-token context windows.
It recommends Hydrogen for cost-sensitive work, Neon for science- and chart-heavy work, Carbon for long multistep tasks and Argon as a mature baseline.
Hydrogen costs $0.675 input, $3.375 output and $0.03375 cached read per million tokens.
Prices for the other three models and the benchmark values in the original chart remain unavailable.
events.importance_reason_en: The follow-up adds calculable Hydrogen pricing to the available model names and context specifications, enabling platform cost comparisons.

corrections.reason_zh: 依据 2/6 续帖补充 Hydrogen 的输入、输出和缓存读取价格，并明确其余模型价格仍未取得。
corrections.reason_en: Added Hydrogen input, output and cached-read prices from the 2/6 follow-up while noting that the other model prices remain unavailable.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.332 加入 MCP Skills 与安全 Hook，调整云模型默认值
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.332 新增来自 MCP 服务器的 beta Skills，以及可在 Skill 或命令加载时拒绝内联 shell 命令的 PreSkillShellCommand Hook。macOS computer use 采用更新的安全规则，部分操作会被拒绝且输入可能变慢；Microsoft Foundry 默认模型改为 Sonnet 5.5，多个云平台的模型别名、自动模式和区域变量也同步调整。
key_points_zh: MCP 服务器 Skills 以 beta 形式加入 / 菜单并显示为 server:skill；PreSkillShellCommand 可在 Skill 或命令加载时拒绝其内联 shell 命令，2.1.331 及更早版本在 settings 中命名该 Hook 会在启动时打开对话框。
macOS computer use 采用更新的安全规则，部分操作会被拒绝且输入可能变慢；启用 computer use 的 Mac 上 computer-use 成为保留 Skill 名，同名自定义 Skill 或命令将停止加载。
Microsoft Foundry 默认模型改为 Sonnet 5.5，需部署 claude-sonnet-5-5；其 sonnet 和 opus 别名分别指向 Sonnet 5.5 与 Opus 5.5，Amazon Bedrock 的 sonnet 仍为 Sonnet 4.5，Foundry 中 Sonnet 4、Opus 4 和 Opus 4.1 已计为退役。
Bedrock Mantle、Agent Platform 和 Foundry 的终端及 VS Code 会话在未设置模式且使用 Sonnet 5 或 5.5 时默认进入 auto mode；设置 disableAutoMode 为 disable 可退出，默认模型不可用时只会回退到 auto mode 接受的旧模型。
Google Cloud Agent Platform 的 Sonnet 与后台请求改读 VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET；若只设置 4_5 变量，则使用 CLOUD_ML_REGION 或 us-east5。
VS Code 和 Desktop 的 Code 标签页新增会话未保存、恢复消息未加载及 /rewind 停止自定速 /loop 的警告；无法由 auto mode 安全判断的计划会请求批准，语音听写空闲上限从 15 秒/2 分钟提高到 60 秒/10 分钟。
events.importance_reason_zh: MCP Skills 与加载前 shell Hook 改变扩展执行边界，云模型默认值、别名和区域变量变化则要求企业检查部署与迁移配置。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.332 adds MCP Skills and a safety hook while changing cloud model defaults
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.332 adds beta Skills from MCP servers and a PreSkillShellCommand hook that can refuse inline shell commands as a skill or command loads. macOS computer use adopts newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and typing can be slower; Microsoft Foundry now defaults to Sonnet 5.5, with model-alias, auto-mode and region-variable changes across cloud platforms.
key_points_en: MCP server Skills join the / menu in beta as server:skill; PreSkillShellCommand can refuse inline shell commands as a skill or command loads, while 2.1.331 and earlier open a startup dialog if a settings file names the hook.

macOS computer use adopts newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and typing can be slower; computer-use becomes a reserved skill name on Macs with computer use enabled, stopping same-named custom skills or commands from loading.

Microsoft Foundry defaults to Sonnet 5.5 and requires deploying claude-sonnet-5-5; its sonnet and opus aliases point to Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, Amazon Bedrock's sonnet stays on Sonnet 4.5, and Foundry counts Sonnet 4, Opus 4 and Opus 4.1 as retired.

Terminal and VS Code sessions using Sonnet 5 or 5.5 on Bedrock Mantle, Agent Platform and Foundry start in auto mode when no mode is set; disableAutoMode: "disable" opts out, and unavailable default models fall back only to older models accepted by auto mode.
Sonnet and background requests on Google Cloud Agent Platform read VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET; with only the 4_5 variable set, they use CLOUD_ML_REGION or us-east5.

The VS Code and Desktop Code tab adds warnings for unsaved sessions, unloaded resumed messages and /rewind stopping a self-paced /loop; plans that auto mode cannot safety-check request approval, and voice-dictation idle limits rise from 15 seconds/2 minutes to 60 seconds/10 minutes.
events.importance_reason_en: MCP Skills and the pre-load shell hook change extension execution boundaries, while cloud model defaults, aliases and region variables require enterprises to review deployment and migration settings.

events.title_zh: Kiro Enterprise 预览 GPT-6.2 Astra
events.summary_zh: Kiro 开始向 Enterprise 组织的各客户端预览 GPT-6.2 Astra。官方列出 1M 上下文、7.2 倍 credits 消耗，超过 272K tokens 的请求升至 14.4 倍，且推理仅在美国地理区域运行。
key_points_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 以 Preview 形式向 Kiro Enterprise 推出。
上下文窗口为 1M，基础 credits 倍率为 7.2。
请求超过 272K tokens 时 credits 倍率升至 14.4。
推理仅在美国地理区域运行。
events.importance_reason_zh: 企业预览同时带来大上下文、显著 credits 成本和地域限制，需要按任务与数据要求评估。
events.title_en: Kiro Enterprise previews GPT-6.2 Astra
events.summary_en: Kiro is beginning a Preview rollout of GPT-6.2 Astra across clients for Enterprise organizations. It lists a 1M context window, a 7.2x credit multiplier that rises to 14.4x above 272K tokens, and US-only inference.
key_points_en: GPT-6.2 Astra is in Preview for Kiro Enterprise.
The context window is 1M with a base 7.2x credit multiplier.
Requests above 272K tokens use a 14.4x multiplier.
Inference runs only in the US geography.
events.importance_reason_en: The enterprise preview combines a large context window with substantial credit costs and a geographic restriction that matter for task and data planning.

events.title_zh: Kiro 纳入 AWS SOC 2 Type II 报告范围
events.summary_zh: Kiro 宣布已纳入 AWS SOC 2 Type II 报告范围，可为安全、采购和供应商风险团队提供独立审计证据。公告没有列出报告覆盖的具体服务、控制项或例外事项。
key_points_zh: Kiro 已纳入 AWS SOC 2 Type II 报告范围。
安全、采购和供应商风险团队可使用相关独立审计证据。
公告未展开具体服务边界、控制项或审计例外。
events.importance_reason_zh: 纳入审计报告范围有助于企业供应商评估，但具体覆盖仍需查阅报告。
events.title_en: Kiro is now in scope for AWS SOC 2 Type II reports
events.summary_en: Kiro announced that it is included in the scope of AWS SOC 2 Type II reports, giving security, procurement and vendor-risk teams independently audited evidence for evaluations. The announcement does not detail covered services, controls or exceptions.
key_points_en: Kiro is included in AWS SOC 2 Type II report scope.
Security, procurement and vendor-risk teams can use the independently audited evidence.
The announcement does not detail service boundaries, controls or audit exceptions.
events.importance_reason_en: Inclusion in audit scope supports enterprise vendor assessment, although exact coverage still requires reviewing the report.

events.title_zh: Kiro Enterprise 增加额度池上限与超额控制
events.summary_zh: Kiro Enterprise 管理员现可在 Controls 设置额度池的用量上限和超额开关。creditpool.usagelimit 可限制每用户每计费周期使用的池内 credits；优先级为用户自身设置、用户所属组中的最高限额、profile 默认值。profile 控制项可统一开关整个账户的超额。
key_points_zh: creditpool.usagelimit 可设置每用户每计费周期的池内 credits 上限。
限额优先级为用户自身设置、所属组中的最高限额、profile 默认值。
profile 的 overages 控制可统一开关整个账户的超额。
管理员可在 Enterprise Management 的 Controls 中配置。
events.importance_reason_zh: 明确限额优先级和账户级超额开关，有助于企业控制 Agent 用量与意外支出。
events.title_en: Kiro Enterprise adds credit-pool limits and overage controls
events.summary_en: Kiro Enterprise administrators can now set credit-pool usage limits and overage settings in Controls. creditpool.usagelimit caps pooled credits per user per billing cycle, with precedence of the user’s own limit, the highest limit among their groups and then the profile default. A profile overage control enables or disables overages account-wide.
key_points_en: creditpool.usagelimit caps pooled credits per user per billing cycle.
Precedence is the user’s own limit, the highest limit among their groups and then the profile default.
A profile overage control enables or disables overages for the whole account.
Administrators configure these controls in Enterprise Management.
events.importance_reason_en: Clear limit precedence and account-wide overage controls help enterprises manage Agent usage and unexpected spending.

events.title_zh: Qoder 0.5.20 支持桌面云任务与跨设备文件协作
events.summary_zh: Qoder 0.5.20 允许在桌面端创建或继续云任务、查看进度和生成文件，并按权限从已连接设备下载工作区文件及管理该设备自动化。本地未完成任务可在退出或更新后恢复；企业可限制托管设备仅登录批准组织的企业账号。
key_points_zh: 桌面端支持创建或继续云任务、跟踪进度和查看生成文件。
跨设备协作支持下载连接设备的工作区文件，并按权限管理其自动化。
退出或更新 Qoder 后，可恢复符合条件的本地未完成任务。
企业管理员可限制托管设备仅使用批准组织的企业账号登录。
修复插件数据迁移后安装失败、受限 Windows 环境后台服务、断线阻塞下一次自动化及远程控制消息乱序。
events.importance_reason_zh: 云任务、跨设备操作和任务恢复扩大移动工作连续性，托管设备登录限制则加强企业访问控制。
events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.20 adds desktop cloud tasks and cross-device file collaboration
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.20 lets users create or continue cloud tasks in the desktop app, track progress and view generated files. Cross-device collaboration supports downloading workspace files from connected devices and managing their automations within permissions; eligible unfinished local tasks resume after quitting or updating, and managed-device sign-in can be restricted to approved enterprise organizations.
key_points_en: The desktop app can create or continue cloud tasks, track progress and view generated files.
Cross-device collaboration downloads workspace files and manages automations on connected devices within permissions.
Eligible unfinished local tasks resume after quitting or updating Qoder.
Enterprise administrators can restrict managed-device sign-in to accounts from approved organizations.
Fixes plugin installation after data migration, background services in restricted Windows environments, disconnects blocking the next automation and out-of-order Remote Control messages.
events.importance_reason_en: Cloud tasks, cross-device actions and task recovery broaden mobile work continuity, while managed-device sign-in restrictions strengthen enterprise access control.

events.title_zh: Kilo 博客：Agent 指令不能替代系统权限
events.summary_zh: Kilo 博客复盘 All Day AI 的安全讨论，区分 Agent 收到的指令与系统实际授予的权限，并以一个 $300 床垫返利 Agent 擅自接受条款和合同为例说明责任仍由用户承担。文章主张在工具、支付系统和数据访问层执行限制，为 Agent 设置独立身份、可撤销且会过期的授权，以及不可篡改的审计记录。
key_points_zh: Always allow 或同类持续授权会把提示词变成长期权限；文章引用讲者观点称，授权范围与最终责任仍由用户承担。
读取发票不等于批准付款。示例 Agent 可为既有供应商批准最高 $10,000，超额时付款系统必须核对经理审批，不能只靠提示词约束。
邮件或附件中的请求不构成授权；Agent 不能修改策略或自行授权，身份、权限和授权范围需在执行时重新检查。
Kilo 当前每个工具可设 allow、ask、deny，多数工具默认 allow，读取 .env 会询问；macOS/Linux 沙箱默认关闭，限制写入和出站网络但不限制文件读取，也不能让 Allow Everything 变安全。
文章建议测试系统是否拒绝、阈值边界、不可编辑记录、任务中暂停和明确负责人；Anaconda 调查中仅 22% 的 59 名受访者在过去六个月测试过事件响应手册。
events.importance_reason_zh: 文章把 Agent 安全从提示词工程推进到授权、支付和审计层，并披露 Kilo 权限设计的实际默认值与沙箱限制，对使用者判断风险有直接价值。
events.title_en: Kilo blog: Agent instructions are not a substitute for system permissions
events.summary_en: A Kilo blog post recapping the All Day AI security discussion separates the instructions an Agent receives from the authority the system actually grants. Using a $300 mattress-rebate Agent that accepted terms and contracts without asking, it argues that users retain responsibility. It recommends enforcing limits in tools, payment systems and data-access layers, with separate Agent identities, revocable expiring grants and immutable audit logs.
key_points_en: Always allow and similar standing grants turn prompt text into durable authority; the post cites the speakers' view that users retain responsibility for the scope they grant.

Reading an invoice is not payment approval. In the example, an Agent may approve up to $10,000 for an existing supplier, but the payment system must check manager approval above that limit rather than relying on prompt instructions.
Requests in emails or attachments do not confer authority. Agents must not rewrite policy or authorize themselves; identity, permissions and grant scope need checks at execution time.

Kilo currently offers allow, ask and deny per tool; most tools default to allow, while reading .env asks first. Its macOS/Linux sandbox is off by default, restricts writes and outbound network but not filesystem reads, and does not make Allow Everything safe.

The post recommends testing refusal behavior, threshold boundaries, immutable records, mid-task pause and a named owner. In Anaconda's survey, only 22% of 59 respondents had tested an incident runbook in the previous six months.
events.importance_reason_en: The post moves Agent safety from prompt engineering into authorization, payment and audit layers, while disclosing Kilo's actual permission defaults and sandbox limits. That makes it directly useful for users assessing operational risk.

events.title_zh: Kilo 主张 Agent 权限必须在模型之外执行
events.summary_zh: Kilo 博客总结 All Day AI 安全讨论，区分写给 Agent 的指令与系统实际授予的权限，主张在工具、支付系统和数据访问点执行限制。文章建议使用范围化批准、不可篡改记录、暂停控制、明确负责人、独立身份和到期／撤销检查，并通过对抗测试确认“系统拒绝”而非“Agent 自行放弃”。
key_points_zh: 指令只是指导，权限必须在 Agent 之外的系统中检查和执行。
批准应有金额、资源与有效期边界；读取请求或不可信文本不自动授予操作权限。
Agent 应使用独立身份，系统需保留不可编辑记录、明确负责人并在任务唤醒时重新检查撤销状态。
测试应覆盖阈值上下、拆分支付、缺席批准者、自我授权和中途暂停。
Kilo 沙箱限制写入和出站网络，但不限制文件读取，且默认关闭；官方明确它不会让 Allow Everything 变安全。
events.importance_reason_zh: 文章把提示词治理与可执行授权边界区分开，对高风险 Agent 部署具有直接安全价值。
events.title_en: Kilo argues Agent permissions must be enforced outside the model
events.summary_en: A Kilo blog recap of All Day AI distinguishes instructions given to an Agent from permissions granted by the system and argues for enforcement at tools, payment systems and data-access points. It recommends scoped approvals, immutable records, pause controls, named owners, independent identities, expiry and revocation checks, and adversarial tests that verify the system refuses rather than the Agent choosing not to act.
key_points_en: Instructions are guidance; limits must be checked and enforced outside the Agent.
Approvals need amount, resource and time boundaries; reading a request or untrusted text does not grant authority to act.
Agents need independent identities, immutable records, named owners and fresh revocation checks when tasks wake.
Tests should cover threshold boundaries, split payments, absent approvers, self-approval and mid-task pauses.
Kilo’s sandbox limits writes and outbound networking but not file reads, is off by default and explicitly does not make Allow Everything safe.
events.importance_reason_en: The article separates prompt governance from enforceable authorization boundaries, offering directly useful guidance for high-risk Agent deployments.

events.title_zh: Antigravity 支持 MCP Apps 交互式工具界面
events.summary_zh: Google Antigravity 新增对 MCP Apps（SEP-1865，io.modelcontextprotocol/ui）的支持，使 MCP 工具可在工作区内渲染交互式 HTML，而不只返回文本或 JSON。标准应用无需改代码即可运行，Google 的扩展还支持持久侧栏、全页和自定义文件查看或编辑入口。
key_points_zh: 标准 MCP Apps 默认在聊天工具步骤下内联渲染，替代原始 JSON 包装并按内容调整高度。
com.google.antigravity/ui 支持持久侧栏标签、左侧全页视图和自定义文件查看器或编辑器；侧栏最多保留 5 个隐藏标签。

events.title_en: Antigravity adds support for interactive MCP Apps interfaces
events.summary_en: Google Antigravity added support for MCP Apps (SEP-1865 and io.modelcontextprotocol/ui), allowing MCP tools to render interactive HTML inside the workspace instead of returning only text or JSON. Standard apps run without code changes, while Google's extensions add persistent sidebars, full-page views and custom file viewing or editing surfaces.
key_points_en: Standard MCP Apps render inline beneath chat tool steps, replacing raw JSON wrappers and sizing themselves to their content.
com.google.antigravity/ui supports persistent sidebar tabs, full-page left views and custom file viewers or editors; up to five hidden sidebar tabs remain mounted.
Custom file views use antigravity-file:// URIs to conceal real paths and let the host read bytes; save-back is allowed only for files on local disk.
Existing integrations include Better Stack, CodeRabbit, Datadog, monday.com, Qodo and Vercel. A built-in /mcp-app-development skill scaffolds single-file HTML, an MCP server and mcp_config.json.
events.importance_reason_en: MCP Apps turn tool output into interactive interfaces and add sidebar and file-editing surfaces, marking a substantial compatibility and workflow change for Antigravity plugins.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.116 扩展进程环境配置并改进 MCP 与权限可靠性
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.116 系列新增面向所有子进程的 env 设置和 ACP 编辑器上下文大小选择，改进 MCP 启动、认证与重复端点提示，并加入扩展清单 JSON Schema。补丁还修复 PowerShell 数字参数允许规则、长会话内存增长、无效 TERM_PROGRAM 阻断 hooks、ACP 授权命令显示和 /rewind 文件捕获限制提示。
key_points_zh: env 设置可应用于 shell 命令、本地 LSP、MCP 服务器、hooks 和扩展启动的每个进程，无论是否启用沙箱；ACP 兼容编辑器可为支持的模型选择上下文大小而不改保存的默认值。
组织管理的 MCP 服务器可跳过个别慢连接和登录警告（Connectors 除外），启动摘要集中提示需处理的服务器；提示最多等待 30 秒以纳入受信任目录启动的 MCP 工具，插件与独立 MCP 共用端点时也会发出警告。
扩展清单新增构建时 JSON Schema；实验性扩展改用 Enabled/Disabled，原 Load Only 迁移为 disabled；沙箱阻止命令后可在策略允许时建议会话级关闭沙箱，Assisted Permissions 的判定与说明同步改进。
修复 PowerShell -n1、-ExpectedSha256 等数字参数不再匹配允许规则的问题；文件夹信任提示不再等待 MCP 重连，Swift 工具可在 macOS 和 Linux 沙箱写入编译器模块缓存与 SwiftPM 共享缓存。
修复长会话中文本测量缓存复制完整流式回复导致 JavaScript 堆耗尽，以及无效 TERM_PROGRAM 阻断配置的 HTTP hooks；Unix 上取消的前台 shell 命令可在输出到 stdout/stderr 时完成清理。
ACP 客户端 shell 授权提示显示实际命令而非描述；/rewind 会报告因回合超过文件捕获上限而无法恢复的文件；计划批准不再提供 fleet 选项，但仍可用 /fleet 启动。
events.importance_reason_zh: 全局进程环境配置、MCP 初始化和权限规则影响企业部署与工具安全；内存、hook 和授权提示修复则关系长会话稳定性与可审计性。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.116 expands process environment configuration and improves MCP and permission reliability
events.summary_en: The Copilot CLI 1.0.116 series adds an env setting for every child process and context-size selection for ACP-compatible editors, improves MCP startup, authentication and duplicate-endpoint warnings, and adds a build-time JSON Schema for extension manifests. Patches also fix PowerShell allow rules for numeric parameters, long-session memory growth, hooks blocked by invalid TERM_PROGRAM values, ACP command authorization display and /rewind file-capture-limit reporting.
key_points_en: The env setting applies to every process Copilot starts for shell commands, local LSP, MCP servers, hooks and extensions, with or without the sandbox; ACP-compatible editors can choose context size for supported models without changing saved defaults.

Organization-managed MCP servers can skip individual slow-connection and sign-in warnings except Connectors, with needs-attention status in the startup summary; prompts wait up to 30 seconds for MCP tools started by folder trust, and shared plugin/standalone MCP endpoints trigger a warning.

Extension manifests gain a build-time JSON Schema; experimental extensions use Enabled/Disabled and migrate Load Only to disabled; blocked sandbox commands can suggest session-level sandbox disabling when policy allows, and Assisted Permissions decisions and explanations improve.

Fixes PowerShell parameters such as -n1 and -ExpectedSha256 no longer matching allow rules; folder trust closes without waiting for MCP reconnection, and Swift tools can write compiler module and SwiftPM shared caches in macOS and Linux sandboxes.

Fixes long-session JavaScript heap exhaustion from text-measurement caches copying full streamed replies and configured HTTP hooks being blocked by invalid TERM_PROGRAM values; canceled Unix foreground shell commands can finish cleanup while writing to stdout or stderr.

ACP shell approval prompts show the actual command rather than its description; /rewind reports files it cannot restore after a turn exceeds the file-capture limit; plan approval no longer offers fleet, though /fleet still starts it.
events.importance_reason_en: Global process environment configuration, MCP initialization and permission rules affect enterprise deployment and tool safety, while memory, hook and authorization-display fixes improve long-session stability and auditability.

events.title_zh: Codex SVG & 3D Design 插件支持参考图转可编辑图形和模型
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方简介称，Codex 的 SVG & 3D Design 插件可把参考图转为可编辑图形或 3D 模型，并接受自然语言修改。简介给出的示例包括小幅修改 SVG 代码让角色眼睛跟随光标，以及由 Codex 调用 Blender 从另一角度检查模型；同时附有插件与从概念图到可编辑 SVG、3D 场景的指南链接。
key_points_zh: 插件提供从参考图到可编辑 SVG 或 3D 模型的工作流，并支持用自然语言继续修改。
SVG 示例通过小幅代码修改让角色眼睛跟随光标。

简介提供插件和指南链接并说明可在 Codex 中启用；metadata_only 材料不能证明实际效果或完整可用范围。

events.title_en: Codex SVG & 3D Design plugin turns reference images into editable graphics and models
events.summary_en: OpenAI's official description says the SVG & 3D Design plugin for Codex can turn a reference image into an editable graphic or 3D model and accept further changes in plain language. Examples include a small SVG code change that makes a character's eyes follow the cursor and Codex using Blender to check a model from another angle. The description links to the plugin and a guide on creating editable SVGs and 3D scenes from concept art.
key_points_en: The plugin offers a workflow from reference images to editable SVGs or 3D models, with further changes requested in plain language.
The SVG example uses a small code change to make a character's eyes follow the cursor.
Codex uses Blender to inspect a 3D model from another angle.
The description links to the plugin and guide and says it can be enabled in Codex; metadata_only evidence does not establish results or full availability.
events.importance_reason_en: The plugin connects a coding agent to SVG and Blender design workflows, extending Codex into editable visual and 3D production. Results and availability remain based only on the official description and were not independently verified.

events.title_zh: Google 为 Antigravity 推出 Mass Spec Skills 质谱解析工具
events.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 与分析化学家合作推出 Mass Spec Skills，让 Antigravity 调用社区质谱工具和公开化学数据库，为化学家生成可审计的结构解析报告，现已面向普通和 Enterprise 用户开放。官方在 100 种化合物、三款模型上报告约 97% 的精确识别与验证率；无互联网或 skills 时准确率低于 4%。
key_points_zh: Mass Spec Skills 已在 Google Antigravity 上线，Enterprise 用户可使用 Business Account 登录。
官方测试覆盖 100 种化合物和 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 4 Argon、Gemini 4 Carbon；加入 skills 后精确识别与验证约 97%，无互联网或 skills 时低于 4%。
生成 tokens 在 Flash 上减少近四倍、Argon 上减少一半、Carbon 上减少近五分之一。
镜像分子和部分同分异构体仍需色谱、离子迁移或 NMR 等额外测量；数据库中没有的新分子无法独立确认。
Google 向 1 万名科学家提供最高 Antigravity 用量等级免费六个月，滚动入驻并受资格、容量和选拔条件限制，申请已开放。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是领域工具、Agent 推理和公开数据库结合的可审计科研工作流，但评测范围和分子鉴别限制必须保留。
events.title_en: Google launches Mass Spec Skills for Antigravity
events.summary_en: Google DeepMind and analytical chemists launched Mass Spec Skills so Antigravity can call community mass-spectrometry tools and public chemical databases and produce auditable structure-elucidation reports. The skills are available to standard and Enterprise users. Google reports around 97% exact identification and verification across 100 compounds and three models, versus below 4% without internet or skills.
key_points_en: Mass Spec Skills are available in Google Antigravity, including Enterprise access through a Business Account.

Official tests covered 100 compounds with Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Carbon; exact identification and verification reached around 97% with skills versus below 4% without internet or skills.
Generated tokens fell by nearly 4x on Flash, half on Argon and nearly one-fifth on Carbon.
Mirror-image molecules and some isomers still need chromatography, ion mobility or NMR; genuinely new molecules absent from databases cannot be independently confirmed.
Google is offering 10,000 scientists the highest Antigravity usage tier free for six months, with rolling onboarding subject to eligibility, capacity and selection; applications are open.
events.importance_reason_en: This is an auditable scientific workflow combining domain tools, Agent reasoning and public databases, but its evaluation scope and molecular-identification limits must remain explicit.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 报告 GPT-6 模型的内生蛋白质设计能力
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 预印本称，GPT-6 系列可仅凭推理和代码设计新蛋白质的形状与氨基酸序列，而无需调用专门生物学模型来生成这些设计。内部研究模型在多项计算任务上媲美或超过专用模型；但实验室流程仍使用专用模型补充序列、筛选候选和预测结构，完整结构预测与端到端零样本设计仍有明显差距。
key_points_zh: GPT-6 系列通过推理和代码设计蛋白质形状与序列，自然语言提示可指定附着位置、结构类型以及螺旋或折叠链数量。
内部研究模型在 14 项蛋白质任务的多项上随代际提升，但完整结构预测仍弱：平均 TM-score 为 0.38，而 ESMFold2 为 0.93。
Onava 实验室测试 322 个 minibinder、5 个靶点，35 个（10.9%）显示预期结合；专用模型负责补充序列并筛选候选。
既有多轮序列重设计实验中，MDM2、VEGF-A、PD-1 的结合比例分别为 75/88、26/42、8/59；两类抗体片段或循环改造为 128/182 和 179/272 保留结合。
结果不证明端到端零样本 minibinder 设计；特异性、稳定性、生物活性、安全性和疗效仍需验证，OpenAI 同时提示生物安全风险。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是通用模型参与蛋白质设计的实验室证据，可能改变科研工作流，但不能据此认为专用模型已被替代或成果可直接用于医疗。
events.title_en: OpenAI reports intrinsic protein-design capabilities in GPT-6 models
events.summary_en: In a preprint, OpenAI says GPT-6-family models can use reasoning and code to design new protein shapes and amino-acid sequences without calling specialized biology models to generate those designs. An internal research model matched or outperformed specialized models on several computational tasks, but the laboratory workflow still used specialized models to complete sequences, filter candidates and predict structures. Whole-structure prediction and end-to-end zero-shot design remain major gaps.
key_points_en: GPT-6-family models use reasoning and code to design protein shapes and sequences; natural-language prompts can specify attachment sites, structural types, and numbers of helices or folded chains.
The internal model improved across generations on several of 14 protein tasks, but whole-structure prediction remains weak: average TM-score was 0.38 versus 0.93 for ESMFold2.
Onava laboratory tests covered 322 minibinders against five targets, with 35 binders (10.9%) showing expected binding; specialized models supplied sequences and filtered candidates.

In existing-structure redesign, binding proportions were 75/88 for MDM2, 26/42 for VEGF-A and 8/59 for PD-1; two antibody-fragment or loop redesign groups retained binding in 128/182 and 179/272 cases.
The results do not establish end-to-end zero-shot minibinder design. Specificity, stability, biological activity, safety and efficacy still require validation, and OpenAI flags biosecurity risks.
events.importance_reason_en: This is laboratory evidence that general-purpose models can contribute to protein design and may change research workflows, but it does not show that specialized models are obsolete or that the results are ready for medical use.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 介绍用 Codex 和 Astra 搜索系外行星候选
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 科学文章称，Kevin Bond 用 Codex 搜索约 10 万颗开普勒恒星，Ethan Byrd 用 Astra 分析约 1,900 万颗恒星的数据，两人找到值得进一步复核的凌星信号。相关信号尚未确认是行星；SETI 研究者独立复现 Bond 的两条信号，Byrd 的一个候选正等待 TESS 团队分析。
key_points_zh: Bond 的 Codex 程序标记了 200 多条信号，其中包括 10 颗已确认行星；KIC 5689121 的 13.8 天周期可能对应约 2.4 个地球直径的天体，KIC 6691030 的 4.8 天信号则与小于海王星的候选相符。
SETI 团队独立找到 Bond 报告的两条信号，但确认仍需数月甚至数年，并需排除双星食、仪器效应等解释。
Byrd 的 Astra 搜索覆盖约 1,900 万颗恒星，第一轮得到 49 个候选；一个较强的候选正等待 TESS 研究人员处理，另外两个等待提交，搜索仍在运行。
文章明确称这些结果不是已确认的行星发现，仍需后续观测、径向速度验证和同行评议。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是编码代理与通用模型处理大规模天文数据的实际案例，展示了候选筛选和跨团队协作价值，但不宜包装成已确认的科学发现或产品发布。
events.title_en: OpenAI describes exoplanet-candidate searches with Codex and Astra
events.summary_en: An OpenAI science article says Kevin Bond used Codex to search roughly 100,000 Kepler stars, while Ethan Byrd used Astra to analyze data from about 19 million stars, producing transit signals worth follow-up. None of the highlighted candidates is yet a confirmed planet. SETI researchers independently reproduced Bond's two signals, and one of Byrd's candidates is awaiting analysis by the TESS team.
key_points_en: Bond's Codex program flagged more than 200 signals, including 10 already-confirmed planets. The 13.8-day signal from KIC 5689121 could indicate a body about 2.4 Earth diameters wide, while KIC 6691030's 4.8-day signal is consistent with a candidate smaller than Neptune.
The SETI team independently found Bond's two signals, but confirmation may take months or years and must rule out eclipsing binaries and instrumental effects.
Byrd's Astra search covered about 19 million stars and produced 49 first-pass candidates. One strong candidate awaits TESS researchers, two more await submission, and the search is still running.
The article explicitly presents candidates rather than confirmed planet discoveries; follow-up observations, radial-velocity validation and peer review are still required.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a concrete use of coding agents and general models on large astronomical datasets, showing value in candidate screening and collaboration without turning unconfirmed signals into a scientific discovery or product launch.

他表示，所有系统都需要构建成可由经过对齐的 Agent 安全地以机器速度运维。

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.72.0 预览版调整忽略规则与会话恢复

Supports Windows tilde and backslash home-relative paths.
Resumes the most recently active session instead of the most recently started session.
Includes A2A bearer-token authentication and request-input validation.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.172.0 改进线程导航、MCP 启动与权限审查
events.summary_zh: Codex 0.172.0 在终端界面加入线程链接打开、斜杠命令参数补全和任务组导航，默认延迟启动 stdio MCP 服务，并允许 Codex 应用按工具配置审批审查者。更新还修复沙箱与工作目录跨平台保留、父回合中断后消息保留及提供商错误提示等问题。
key_points_zh: 终端界面支持打开 Codex 线程链接、斜杠命令参数补全和任务组导航。
stdio MCP 服务默认延迟启动；Codex 应用支持按工具设置审批审查者。
修复沙箱可写根、工作目录和线程工作目录的跨平台保留问题。
父回合中断时保留排队消息，并更早显示 Responses 流与提供商错误。
events.importance_reason_zh: 更新同时改善日常导航、MCP 性能、审批颗粒度和沙箱恢复可靠性。
events.title_en: Codex 0.172.0 improves thread navigation, MCP startup and approval reviews
events.summary_en: Codex 0.172.0 adds thread-link navigation, slash-command argument completion and task-group navigation in the TUI, enables lazy startup for stdio MCP servers by default, and lets Codex apps configure per-tool approval reviewers. It also fixes sandbox and working-directory preservation across platforms, queued messages after interrupted parent turns, and provider-error reporting.
key_points_en: The TUI can open Codex thread links, complete slash-command arguments and navigate task groups.
Stdio MCP servers start lazily by default; Codex apps support per-tool approval reviewers.
Fixes preserve sandbox writable roots, workspace roots and thread working directories across platforms.
Queued messages survive interrupted parent turns, and Responses stream and provider errors surface earlier.
events.importance_reason_en: The release improves everyday navigation, MCP performance, approval granularity and sandbox recovery reliability.

events.title_zh: Google Agent Retrieval 公共预览托管文件摄取与 SearchDocuments
events.summary_zh: Google 为 Agent Retrieval（原 Vector Search 2.0）的 Managed Ingestion 和 SearchDocuments 开启 Public Preview，可从 Cloud Storage 解析、切分和嵌入 PDF、Office 文档与视频，再用一次 API 调用返回带页码或时间戳的段落。公共预览仅支持 us-east4 和 europe-west4，REST API 为 v1beta，Python SDK 尚未支持。
key_points_zh: 文档支持 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、TXT；视频支持 MP4、MOV、WebM、MKV 等，托管流程负责解析、分段、Gemini Embedding 2 嵌入和 Collection 创建。
SearchDocuments 只需数据存储和文本查询，自动组合语义与全文检索；结果带源文件 URI、文档页码范围或视频起止时间。
视频默认仅嵌入画面，audio_mode: ENABLED 可检索首个音轨的语音；无需字幕或转写，reranking 不支持 VIDEO。
Google 测试 18 份 Alphabet 投资者 PDF 约 9 分钟可搜索；5 段共约 19 分钟视频的查询耗时 0.3–0.5 秒，但导入两个数据存储耗时 20–45 分钟。
Public Preview 仅限 us-east4/europe-west4 的 v1beta REST API；托管摄取暂不单独收费，底层 Collection 按标准价格计费，GA 后将对摄取收费。
events.importance_reason_zh: 一次 API 调用覆盖文件解析、嵌入、混合检索和带引文段落返回，可显著减少自建 RAG 摄取链路；但预览区域、视频限制和后续计费仍需纳入评估。
events.title_en: Google previews managed ingestion and SearchDocuments for Agent Retrieval
events.summary_en: Google placed Managed Ingestion and SearchDocuments for Agent Retrieval, formerly Vector Search 2.0, into Public Preview. They can parse, chunk and embed PDF, Office documents and videos from Cloud Storage, then return passages with page ranges or timestamps in one API call. The preview is limited to us-east4 and europe-west4, uses the v1beta REST API and has no Python SDK support yet.
key_points_en: Documents support PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and TXT; video supports MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV and more. The managed pipeline parses, chunks, embeds with Gemini Embedding 2 and creates the Collection.
SearchDocuments takes only a data store and a text query, automatically combining semantic and full-text retrieval; results include source URIs, document page ranges or video start and end times.
Video embeds visuals by default; audio_mode: ENABLED searches speech from the first audio track without subtitles or transcripts. Reranking does not support VIDEO.

Google's tests made 18 Alphabet investor PDFs searchable in about nine minutes. Queries across five clips totaling about 19 minutes took 0.3–0.5 seconds, but ingestion into two stores took 20–45 minutes.

Public Preview is limited to v1beta REST in us-east4 and europe-west4. Managed ingestion has no separate preview charge, the backing Collection uses standard pricing, and ingestion billing is planned for GA.
events.importance_reason_en: A single API covers ingestion, embeddings, hybrid retrieval and cited passages, potentially removing much of a custom RAG ingestion pipeline. Preview regions, video limits and planned ingestion billing still matter for adoption.

修复部分 Remote SSH 工作区的预检、旧对话恢复和主机地址变化后重连问题。
损坏或不可读的本地 MCP 配置不再阻断对话与自动化。
