events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.18 fixes remote-control and local MCP blockers
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.18 improves remote-device background-task progress and completion synchronization, fixes pairing failures caused by clock differences, and addresses Remote SSH preflight, old-conversation resume and reconnection issues. Corrupt or unreadable local MCP configurations no longer block conversations or automations.
key_points_en: Improves remote background-task synchronization and fixes clock-related pairing failures.
Fixes Remote SSH preflight, old-conversation resume and reconnection after host-address changes.
Corrupt or unreadable local MCP configurations no longer block conversations or automations.
Fixes cross-filesystem image attachments, plugin failure messages and mobile tool-progress display.
events.importance_reason_en: The update targets blockers in remote work and local configuration that interrupt everyday task continuity.

key_points_en: Kiro Enterprise is on the App Store as Kiro Mobile for organization accounts.

events.title_zh: Cognition 发布 SWE-2.1，并推出 Ultrafast 与 Cyber 版本
events.summary_zh: Cognition 发布 SWE-2.1，称其在 Kimi K3 上以纯强化学习训练，FrontierCode 2.0 得分 41.3，Terminal-Bench 4.1 得分 50.0，网络安全能力明显提升。同时推出经 Cerebras 提供 10 倍速度的 SWE-2.1 Ultrafast，并向 Devin Security 推出限制更宽松的 SWE-2.1 Cyber；两者定位与普通版不同。
key_points_zh: SWE-2.1 在 FrontierCode 2.0 得 41.3、Terminal-Bench 4.1 得 50.0；官方称其相比 SWE-2 显著提升，数字来自不同 harness 的上游或自报结果。
ExploitBench 为 80%，ExploitGym intended-exploit success 为 27.3%、flag capture 为 44.8%；评测在关闭 mitigations 下运行，不能直接等同真实环境表现。
训练加入沙箱红队、持续监控和逃逸 canary；训练期间模型四次发现沙箱漏洞，每次都触发研究人员响应。
SWE-2.1 Ultrafast 与 Cerebras 合作，以同模型提供 10 倍速度；示例吞吐为 600 tokens/s，而普通版为 60 tokens/s、SWE-2 Flash 为 200 tokens/s。
SWE-2.1 Cyber 限制更宽松，正 rollout 到 Devin Security；普通版 Desktop/CLI 免费至 12/8，Desktop/Cloud/CLI 折扣至 1/30，文章未给出具体价格。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是 SWE-2 之后的重要模型升级，并同时改变高性能服务与安全研究路径；官方基准和不同变体的限制需要一起呈现。
events.title_en: Cognition releases SWE-2.1 with Ultrafast and Cyber variants
events.summary_en: Cognition released SWE-2.1, saying it was trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3, scored 41.3 on FrontierCode 2.0 and 50.0 on Terminal-Bench 4.1, and improved substantially in cybersecurity. It also introduced SWE-2.1 Ultrafast with 10x speed through Cerebras and is rolling out the more permissive SWE-2.1 Cyber variant to Devin Security; both have distinct positions from the standard model.
key_points_en: SWE-2.1 scores 41.3 on FrontierCode 2.0 and 50.0 on Terminal-Bench 4.1. Cognition calls the gains over SWE-2 significant, while the numbers combine upstream results and self-reported results across harnesses.

SWE-2.1 reaches 80% on ExploitBench, with 27.3% intended-exploit success and 44.8% flag capture on ExploitGym. The evaluation runs with mitigations disabled and should not be treated as equivalent to real-world performance.
Training added sandbox red teams, continuous monitoring and escape canaries. The model discovered sandbox vulnerabilities four times during training, and researchers responded each time.
SWE-2.1 Ultrafast uses Cerebras to serve the same model at 10x speed; the example reaches 600 tokens/s versus 60 tokens/s for the standard model and 200 tokens/s for SWE-2 Flash.

SWE-2.1 Cyber has more permissive safeguards and is rolling out to Devin Security. The standard model is free on Desktop/CLI through 12/8 and discounted on Desktop/Cloud/CLI until 1/30; no exact prices are listed.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a major SWE-2 upgrade that also changes high-performance serving and security-research options. Official benchmark claims and the limits of each variant need to be presented together.

events.title_zh: Devin 加强 Bot 自动化审批与安全扫描工作流
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 24 日更新允许企业要求 Bot 保存自动化前获得人工批准，并为 Findings 增加可分享筛选视图、Pending 状态和逐次扫描标签。Split scan 会先构建威胁模型再按仓库扫描；MCP 头部支持引用已保存密钥，自动化列表筛选可写入分享链接。
key_points_zh: 企业 Trigger policies 可要求每个 Bot 保存自身自动化前获得人工批准。
Findings 支持分享并更新筛选视图、Pending 状态和每次扫描运行的独立标签。
Split scan 先建立威胁模型，再为每个仓库启动扫描。
MCP 头部输入 $ 时可建议并插入已保存密钥的引用。
自动化筛选条件保存在 URL，复制链接可打开相同筛选列表。
events.importance_reason_zh: 自动化人工审批、威胁模型优先和密钥引用直接改善企业 Agent 的变更控制与安全边界。
events.title_en: Devin strengthens Bot automation approvals and security-scan workflows
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 24 update lets enterprises require human approval before Bots save their own automations and adds shareable Findings filters, a Pending state and per-run scan tabs. Split scans build a threat model before scanning each repository; MCP headers can reference saved secrets, and automation filters are preserved in shareable URLs.
key_points_en: Enterprise Trigger policies can require human approval before each Bot saves its own automations.
Findings support shareable and updatable filtered views, a Pending state and separate tabs for each scan run.
Split scans build a threat model before launching one scan per repository.
Typing $ in an MCP header suggests and inserts saved-secret references.
Automation filters are stored in the URL so copied links reopen the same filtered list.
events.importance_reason_en: Human approval for automation changes, threat-model-first scanning and secret references directly improve enterprise Agent change control and security boundaries.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 Cyber 单次验证 948 个 Linux 内核漏洞
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，GPT-6 Cyber 在一次运行中验证了 948 个可能导致本地 root 权限的 Linux 内核漏洞，并生成可审查补丁；研究人员与内核维护者合作，将修复提交上游。现有帖子只有简短说明，未包含完整方法、漏洞分布或独立复核结果。
key_points_zh: 官方称单次运行验证 948 个 Linux 内核漏洞。
这些漏洞可能导致本地 root 权限，并生成了可供审查的补丁。
研究人员与维护者合作，将修复方案提交到上游代码。
导入材料为部分文本，不能据此确认完整测试方法、修复率或独立验证结论。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是模型用于真实内核安全审计与上游修复的一手进展，但重大安全结论仍需完整研究和社区复核。
events.title_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber validated 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities in one run
events.summary_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber validated 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities that could enable local root access in a single run and produced reviewable patches. Researchers worked with maintainers to submit fixes upstream. The available post is brief and does not provide the full method, vulnerability breakdown or independent verification.
key_points_en: OpenAI says one run validated 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities.
The vulnerabilities could enable local root access, and reviewable patches were generated.
Researchers worked with maintainers to submit fixes upstream.
The imported material is partial text, so it does not establish the full test method, fix rate or independent verification.
events.importance_reason_en: This is first-hand progress in applying the model to real kernel auditing and upstream fixes, but major security claims still need full research and community review.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.331 扩展 Code Mode 云平台并增强 IDE 工作流
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.331 让终端会话中的 Code Mode 支持 Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud Agent Platform、Microsoft Foundry 和 Claude Platform on AWS。VSCode 增加笔记本单元格加入对话、错误与失败测试的 Fix with Claude Code、变更文件加入对话和合并冲突解决入口；网关、遥测、插件依赖和代理压缩兼容性也得到扩展。
key_points_zh: Code Mode 终端会话新增四个云平台支持：Bedrock、Google Cloud Agent Platform、Microsoft Foundry 和 Claude Platform on AWS。
VSCode 支持把笔记本单元格、变更文件和失败测试直接加入对话或修复流程。
Claude apps gateway 增加 oidc.groups_jsonpath，并支持按 IdP 主机名连接代理。
插件可声明 optionalDependencies；新环境变量用于代理压缩兼容，遥测增加用量与模型字段。
2026 年 11 月 30 日或之后，托管 extraKnownMarketplaces 中的插件市场将默认自动更新，可设置 autoUpdate: false 退出。
events.importance_reason_zh: 更新扩大 Code Mode 的部署面，并减少开发者在 IDE、测试和身份网关之间切换的成本。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.331 expands Code Mode clouds and IDE workflows
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.331 brings Code Mode in terminal sessions to Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS. VSCode adds notebook-cell and changed-file chat actions, Fix with Claude Code for errors and failed tests, and merge-conflict resolution. The release also extends gateway identity, telemetry, plugin dependencies and proxy compression compatibility.
key_points_en: Code Mode terminal sessions add Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS.
VSCode can send notebook cells and changed files to chat and fix errors or failed tests.
Claude apps gateways add oidc.groups_jsonpath and hostname-based IdP proxy sign-in.
Plugins can declare optionalDependencies; new environment variables and telemetry fields improve proxy and usage compatibility.
On or after November 30, 2026, managed extraKnownMarketplaces entries auto-update by default unless autoUpdate is false.
events.importance_reason_en: The update broadens Code Mode deployment options and reduces context switching across IDE, test and identity-gateway workflows.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 发布开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo，用于帮助团队在滚动部署补丁时保护正在运行的系统。当前取得的公告只有简短说明，未包含架构、许可证或兼容性细节。
key_points_zh: Shirudo 是 OpenAI 与 Cisco 推出的开源 Linux 运行时。
目标是团队滚动部署补丁时保护运行中的系统。
现有材料只有公告简介，不能据此描述具体隔离机制或支持范围。
events.importance_reason_zh: 开源运行时面向补丁发布期间的系统保护，是与 AI 运维安全相关的基础工具更新。
events.title_en: OpenAI and Cisco open-source the Shirudo Linux runtime
events.summary_en: OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that helps teams protect running systems while rolling out patches. The available announcement is only a short description and does not provide architecture, licensing or compatibility details.
key_points_en: Shirudo is an open-source Linux runtime from OpenAI and Cisco.
It aims to protect running systems during patch rollouts.
The available announcement is only a short description, so specific isolation mechanisms and support scope are not established.
events.importance_reason_en: The open-source runtime targets system protection during patch deployment, making it a relevant AI-operations security tool update.

events.title_zh: Tibo 称 dots 正成为 OpenAI 内部主要工作方式
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，在 OpenAI 内部，dots 正迅速成为完成工作的主要方式，并出现“dots building the dots system”的现象。帖子没有给出采用范围、效率数据或具体功能，属于负责人对内部使用状态的一手描述。
key_points_zh: Tibo 表示 dots 正迅速成为 OpenAI 内部的主要工作方式。
他提到 dots 正在构建 dots 系统本身。
原帖未提供用户规模、效率指标或具体实现细节。
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人直接描述 AI 产品在研发组织内的使用变化，但不应补写未披露的采用数据。
events.title_en: Tibo says dots are becoming OpenAI’s primary internal way of working
events.summary_en: Tibo says dots are quickly becoming the primary way work gets done inside OpenAI and describes “dots building the dots system.” The post provides no adoption numbers, efficiency metrics or implementation details and is a first-hand account of internal product use.
key_points_en: Tibo says dots are quickly becoming the primary way work gets done inside OpenAI.
He says dots are building the dots system itself.
The post provides no adoption scale, efficiency metrics or implementation details.
events.importance_reason_en: A responsible person directly describes changing use of an AI product inside the development organization, without disclosing adoption data that can be quantified.

events.title_zh: Tibo 宣布新 ChatGPT Business 工作区可获双倍包含用量
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，11 月 30 日前创建的新 ChatGPT Business 工作区，其所有席位类型在 12 月 31 日前可获得双倍包含用量；已有 Business 用户也将获得后续礼物，但帖子没有说明形式、额度或资格细节。
key_points_zh: 11 月 30 日前创建的新 ChatGPT Business 工作区可参与。
所有席位类型在 12 月 31 日前获得双倍包含用量。
已有 Business 用户将获得后续礼物，但具体内容和时间未披露。
帖子没有给出时区、额度上限或更详细资格条件。
events.importance_reason_zh: 明确的席位范围和优惠窗口影响团队采购与用量规划，但完整条款仍待官方说明。
events.title_en: Tibo announces double included usage for new ChatGPT Business workspaces
events.summary_en: Tibo says new ChatGPT Business workspaces created by November 30 receive double included usage for every seat type through December 31. Existing Business users will also receive a later gift, but the post does not specify its form, amount or eligibility details.
key_points_en: New ChatGPT Business workspaces created by November 30 are eligible.
Every seat type receives double included usage through December 31.
Existing Business users will receive a later gift, but its content and timing are unspecified.
The post gives no timezone, usage cap or detailed eligibility terms.
events.importance_reason_en: The stated seat scope and promotion window affect team purchasing and usage planning, although full terms still need official clarification.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 OpenWorks，资助本地 AI 专家帮助小企业
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布通过新项目 OpenWorks 资助本地 AI 专家，免费帮助小企业发展业务所需的工具和技能，并邀请愿意教学的 AI 专家及希望学习应用 AI 的小企业主参与。帖子未提供资助金额、地区范围或申请时间。
key_points_zh: OpenWorks 由 OpenAI 资助本地 AI 专家。
受助小企业免费获得工具和技能支持。
项目同时邀请 AI 专家与希望学习实施 AI 的小企业主。
现有材料未说明资助金额、覆盖地区、选拔方式或截止日期。
events.importance_reason_zh: 项目把 AI 能力建设延伸到本地专家和小企业，但实际覆盖与申请条件仍待补充。
events.title_en: OpenAI launches OpenWorks to fund local AI experts for small businesses
events.summary_en: OpenAI announced OpenWorks, a program that funds local AI experts to help small businesses develop the tools and skills they need at no cost. It invites AI experts who enjoy teaching and small-business owners who want to learn to implement AI. The post does not state funding amounts, regions, selection criteria or deadlines.
key_points_en: OpenWorks funds local AI experts through OpenAI.
Small businesses receive tool and skills support at no cost.
The program invites both AI experts and small-business owners who want to learn AI implementation.
The available material does not state funding amounts, regions, selection criteria or deadlines.
events.importance_reason_en: The program extends AI capability-building to local experts and small businesses, although coverage and application terms remain unspecified.

events.title_zh: Google 用 Gemini 4 Agent 团队与 Lean 改进量子算法
events.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 与 Google Quantum AI 使用 Gemini 4 Agent 团队和 Lean 形式化验证改进量子算法，并开源 Lean 库、问题规格与已验证解。官方报告称，惯性约束聚变电路的计算成本降低 11.8 倍、内存从 5,650 降至 4,338 个纠错量子比特；部分分子模拟和算术例程也取得提升。
key_points_zh: Agent 团队提出算法改进，Lean 对每个结果作数学正确性证明。
官方称聚变电路成本降低 11.8 倍，内存从 5,650 降至 4,338 个纠错量子比特。
一个光敏分子模拟成本降低 8 倍；Cytochrome P450 改进 2.5 倍，内存从 481 降至 333 个量子比特。
Grover 特定实现加速 2.57 倍，arcsin 例程加速 290 倍；Lean 库、规格与验证解已开源。
这些电路仍受早期量子硬件资源限制，性能数字是官方研究结果。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是形式化验证与多 Agent 科学发现结合的可复现研究进展，但尚非可直接运行的应用。
events.title_en: Google uses Gemini 4 agent teams and Lean to improve quantum algorithms
events.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI used Gemini 4 agent teams and Lean formal verification to improve quantum algorithms, and open-sourced the Lean library, problem specifications and verified solutions. The official report claims an 11.8x reduction in computing cost for an inertial-confinement-fusion circuit, with memory falling from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits, plus improvements in molecule simulations and arithmetic routines.
key_points_en: Agent teams propose algorithm changes and Lean proves each result mathematically.
The official fusion-circuit result claims 11.8x lower cost and memory falling from 5,650 to 4,338 error-corrected qubits.
A light-sensitive molecule simulation is 8x cheaper; Cytochrome P450 improves 2.5x, with memory falling from 481 to 333 qubits.
A specific Grover implementation is 2.57x faster and arcsin is 290x faster; the Lean library, specifications and verified solutions are open source.
The circuits remain constrained by early quantum hardware, and the performance figures are official research results.
events.importance_reason_en: This is reproducible progress at the intersection of formal verification and multi-agent scientific discovery, though not yet a directly runnable application.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code 修复 MCP 授权与模型下线后的会话
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code Desktop 1.4.3 与 CLI 2.7.3 修复模型变为不可用后会话无法打开的问题，并加入回复评分或 /feedback 反馈。桌面版还在 MCP 需要浏览器登录时显示授权按钮，自动检测插件 MCP 的 OAuth 要求并展示正确授权状态。
key_points_zh: Desktop 1.4.3 与 CLI 2.7.3 均修复模型不可用后会话无法打开的问题。
两个版本均支持对回复评分或通过 /feedback 发送反馈。
桌面版在 MCP 需要浏览器登录时显示授权按钮。
桌面版自动检测插件 MCP 的 OAuth 要求并显示授权状态。
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复阻断会话恢复的问题，并降低 MCP 身份授权失败带来的使用障碍。
events.title_en: Kimi Code fixes MCP authorization and sessions after model unavailability
events.summary_en: Kimi Code Desktop 1.4.3 and CLI 2.7.3 fix sessions that could not open after their model became unavailable and add reply ratings or /feedback. Desktop also shows an authorization button when an MCP needs browser sign-in and detects plugin MCP OAuth requirements to display the correct authorization state.
key_points_en: Desktop 1.4.3 and CLI 2.7.3 fix sessions failing to open after model unavailability.
Both versions support rating replies or sending feedback with /feedback.
Desktop shows an authorization button when an MCP needs browser sign-in.
Desktop detects plugin MCP OAuth requirements and displays the authorization state.
events.importance_reason_en: The patches remove session-recovery blockers and reduce friction caused by MCP identity authorization failures.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.4.1 修复 macOS 12 保存并扩展模型速度层
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 2.4.1 修复 macOS 12 系统 SQLite 不支持 JSON 运算符导致助手消息无法保存的问题，并让仅配置的提供商模型无需 /connect 登录即可显示。实验性 model_speeds 将服务档位暴露为可记忆的速度选项，更新还修正压缩历史保留、长目标会话缓存成本和插件兼容性。
key_points_zh: 修复 macOS 12 上助手消息无法保存的问题。
仅配置的提供商模型无需 /connect 登录即可出现在 /models。
实验性 model_speeds 在模型选择器和 /speed、/fast 中展示服务档位及相对价格。
修复压缩后保留过多历史、长目标会话额外缓存成本及部分插件安装兼容问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复影响旧 macOS 用户的数据保存，并改进自定义模型与成本／速度档位的可操作性。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.4.1 fixes macOS 12 saving and exposes model speed tiers
events.summary_en: OpenCode 2.4.1 fixes assistant messages failing to save on macOS 12 because its system SQLite lacks the JSON operator, and shows models from config-only providers without a /connect login. Experimental model_speeds exposes service tiers as remembered speeds, while the release also fixes compaction history retention, extra cache costs in long goal sessions and plugin compatibility.
key_points_en: Fixes assistant messages failing to save on macOS 12.
Config-only provider models appear in /models without a /connect login.
Experimental model_speeds shows service tiers and relative prices in the model picker and /speed or /fast.
Fixes excessive history after compaction, extra cache costs in long goal sessions and plugin installation compatibility.
events.importance_reason_en: The release fixes data saving for older macOS users and improves custom-model and cost/speed-tier controls.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code 2.8.0 canary 预览独立回合状态与延迟工具
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.8.0 canary 将回合运行迁移到独立状态机，并在解析器中支持延迟工具。预览版还修复空文本历史后的压缩恢复、桌面更新重启后的会话继续、项目 MCP 按需启动和跨主机会话锁回收，并加入静态只读 Bash 命令自动批准。
key_points_zh: 回合运行改用独立状态机，工具解析器支持延迟工具。
修复空文本历史后的压缩恢复，并保留恢复时的原始工具参数字节。
桌面端更新重启后可继续运行会话，压缩排队与状态反馈得到改进。
项目 MCP 服务仅在需要时启动，并回收跨主机遗留会话锁。
新增静态只读 Bash 命令自动批准；移除实验性子代理上下文分叉。
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览版涉及 Agent 核心执行模型、上下文恢复和工具权限，值得在正式版前跟踪。
events.title_en: Kimi Code 2.8.0 canary previews independent turns and deferred tools
events.summary_en: The Kimi Code CLI 2.8.0 canary moves turn execution to an independent state machine and supports deferred tools in the resolver. It also fixes compaction recovery from empty text history, continues desktop sessions after update restarts, starts project MCP servers on demand, reclaims session locks across hosts and adds automatic approval for statically read-only Bash commands.
key_points_en: Turns use an independent state machine and the resolver supports deferred tools.
Fixes compaction recovery from empty text history and preserves raw tool arguments across resume.
Desktop sessions continue after update restarts, with improved compaction queue and status feedback.
Project MCP servers start only when needed and stale session locks are reclaimed across hosts.
Adds automatic approval for statically read-only Bash commands and removes experimental subagent context forking.
events.importance_reason_en: The preview changes core Agent execution, context recovery and tool permissions, making it important to track before stable release.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.4.0 内置桌面浏览器与 Automations 自动化
events.summary_zh: OpenCode v2.4.0 新增内置桌面浏览器与 Automations 自动化。浏览器可导入已有登录态与浏览历史，使用持久桌面配置，智能体可在同一应用内读取并操作页面；Automations 支持按定时器、cron 计划或 MCP 服务器事件运行提示词、脚本或 shell 命令。
key_points_zh: 内置桌面浏览器支持从 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari 导入登录态与浏览历史，并可从 Chromium 浏览器或 Chrome、Edge 商店添加扩展
浏览器使用持久桌面配置：聊天链接保持登录、标签页在重启后保留，智能体可读取并操作同一批页面
Automations 可按定时器、cron 计划或 MCP 服务器事件运行提示词、脚本或 shell 命令，用 /automation 管理，配置 "automations": false 可关闭
events.importance_reason_zh: 桌面内置浏览器与定时自动化显著扩展 OpenCode 作为桌面智能体的操作范围，浏览器登录态复用降低实际使用门槛。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.4.0 adds built-in desktop browser and Automations
events.summary_en: OpenCode v2.4.0 adds a built-in desktop browser and Automations. The browser can import existing sign-ins and browsing history, keeps everything in one persistent desktop profile, and lets the agent read and drive the same pages without switching apps; Automations runs prompts, scripts, or shell commands on a timer, a cron schedule, or MCP server events.
key_points_en: The built-in desktop browser imports sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari, and adds extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores
Everything stays in one persistent desktop profile: chat links open signed in, tabs survive restarts, and the agent can read and drive the same pages
Automations run a prompt, script, or shell command on a timer, on a cron schedule, or when an MCP server sends an event, managed with /automation and disabled with "automations": false
events.importance_reason_en: The desktop browser and scheduled automations materially widen what OpenCode can operate on as a desktop agent, and reusing browser sign-ins lowers the barrier to real use.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI 3.6 增加 SubagentStop Hook 与压缩指导
events.summary_zh: Kiro CLI 3.6 新增 SubagentStop hooks、完整保存的 Hook 输出和 /compact 摘要指导，并加入会话回顾、通知控制、managed V2 控制和面向所有用户的 Windows 安装器。

events.title_zh: 智谱发布 GLM-5.4：首个 Loop Transformer 旗舰模型，宣称达 2T–3T 参数模型水平
events.summary_zh: 智谱 Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.4，这是其首个基于 Loop Transformer 架构的旗舰模型：将 GLM-5 基座的 28 层循环执行两遍，在 750B 参数量下宣称达到 2T–3T 参数模型的智力水平。为控制部署成本，模型引入逐 token 门控渐进更新、混合 KV Cache（复用第一遍的稀疏 KV 并叠加独立滑动窗口）和稀疏注意力索引复用，官方称在 1M 上下文下额外循环只增加一个滑动窗口的 KV 开销。智谱表示已按 1B、4B、30B、750B 逐级验证循环架构；30B 等参对照实验在仅增加约 10% 训练算力时，数学、科学推理和长上下文任务收益最大，部分基准输出长度下降 10–14%。推理方面，非高峰可达 200 tokens/s，高峰维持 70–80 tokens/s。模型已可通过 GLM Coding Plan、ZCode 和 Z.ai Chat 使用，API 标注「即将推出」，权重计划在完成安全加固后开源。官方也承认模型存在陷入过长「马拉松思考」循环的已知局限。
key_points_zh: GLM-5.4 是首个采用 Loop Transformer 的旗舰模型：在 750B 的 GLM-5 基座上把 28 层循环两遍，官方宣称智力水平接近 2T–3T 参数模型。
架构改动包括逐 token 门控渐进更新、混合 KV Cache（复用第一遍稀疏 KV、叠加独立滑动窗口）和稀疏注意力索引复用；额外循环只需一个滑动窗口的 KV，1M 上下文下部署成本增幅受控。
循环架构按 1B、4B、30B、750B 逐级验证；30B 等参对照实验在约 10% 额外训练算力下，数学、科学推理与长上下文收益最大，GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro 等基准平均输出长度下降 10–14%。
非高峰推理速度可达 200 tokens/s，高峰负载下维持 70–80 tokens/s；「Generalized Coding」演示涵盖自动配乐音乐视频、FreeCAD 六轴机械臂建模、完整游戏和交互式 3D 观鸟场景。
已可通过 GLM Coding Plan、ZCode 与 Z.ai Chat 使用，API 标注即将推出，权重计划在安全加固后开源；官方承认仍存在过长「马拉松思考」循环的局限。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是智谱旗舰模型首次切换循环架构，直接参与与 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 旗舰模型的竞争；Coding Plan 用户可立即使用、API 与开源权重后续跟进，会影响开发者的模型选型与成本预期。
events.title_en: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.4, Its First Loop Transformer Flagship, Claiming 2T–3T-Class Intelligence
events.summary_en: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first flagship built on the Loop Transformer architecture: 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model run for two iterations, and the company claims 750B-scale GLM-5.4 matches the intelligence of 2T–3T parameter models. To control deployment cost it adds per-token gated progressive updates, a hybrid KV cache that reuses the first pass's sparse KV alongside an independent sliding window, and sparse attention index reuse; Z.ai says an extra loop costs only one sliding window of KV cache, keeping the deployment cost increase at 1M context under control relative to GLM-5.3. Z.ai reports validating the loop architecture progressively at 1B, 4B, 30B and 750B, with a 30B iso-parameter ablation showing the largest gains in math, scientific reasoning and long-context tasks at roughly 10% extra training compute, and 10–14% shorter average outputs on benchmarks such as GPQA-Diamond and MMLU-Pro. Inference reaches up to 200 tokens/s off-peak and 70–80 tokens/s at peak. The model is usable through GLM Coding Plan, ZCode and Z.ai Chat; the API is marked as coming soon, and weights are planned for release after safety hardening. Z.ai also acknowledges a known limitation: the model can get caught in overly long "marathon thinking" loops.
key_points_en: GLM-5.4 is the first flagship built on Loop Transformer: 28 layers of the 750B GLM-5 base run for two iterations, which Z.ai claims brings it to the intelligence level of 2T–3T parameter models.

Architecture changes include per-token gated progressive updates, a hybrid KV cache reusing first-pass sparse KV plus an independent sliding window, and sparse attention index reuse; an extra loop costs only one sliding window of KV, keeping 1M-context deployment cost growth controlled.

The loop architecture was validated at 1B, 4B, 30B and 750B; a 30B iso-parameter comparison with about 10% more training compute shows the largest gains in math, scientific reasoning and long-context tasks, with average output length down 10–14% on benchmarks such as GPQA-Diamond and MMLU-Pro.

Throughput reaches up to 200 tokens/s off-peak and 70–80 tokens/s at peak; "Generalized Coding" demos cover a self-narrated music video, a 6-axis robotic arm modeled in FreeCAD, a complete game and an interactive 3D bird-watching experience.

Available through GLM Coding Plan, ZCode and Z.ai Chat; the API is marked coming soon and weights are planned for open release after safety hardening; Z.ai acknowledges a known limitation of overly long "marathon thinking" loops.
events.importance_reason_en: Zhipu's flagship model switches to a looped architecture for the first time, directly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic and Google flagships; Coding Plan users can use it immediately while the API and open weights follow, affecting developer model selection and cost expectations.

events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.4 汇总稳定更新并迁移网关后端
events.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.4 将 v0.23.3 以来约 229 个合并 PR 打包为 GitHub、Microsoft Store、Docker 和 Hermes Cloud 的稳定版本。公告列出网关后端迁移、插件设置编辑、桌面审批卡、模型可用性和桌面流式性能改进；完整策划说明将在 v0.24.0 提供。
key_points_zh: 稳定版汇总 v0.23.3 以来约 229 个 PR；公告日期为 2026 年 11 月 23 日。
hermes gateway migrate --backends 可将旧 serve/dashboard 后端迁移到网关。
新增插件设置编辑、桌面文件夹与网站请求审批卡，以及网关客户端识别。
安装器版桌面应用本次不变，随下一捆绑版本更新；CLI 可使用 hermes update。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是 Hermes 本月首个稳定汇总版本，涉及网关架构、插件管理和桌面安全审批。
events.title_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.4 rolls up stable changes and migrates gateway backends
events.summary_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.4 packages about 229 merged PRs since v0.23.3 into stable releases for GitHub, Microsoft Store, Docker and Hermes Cloud. The announcement lists gateway-backend migration, plugin settings, desktop approval cards, model availability and desktop streaming performance work; full curated notes will ship with v0.24.0.
key_points_en: The stable release rolls up about 229 PRs since v0.23.3 and is dated November 23, 2026.
hermes gateway migrate --backends moves older serve/dashboard backends to the gateway.
Adds plugin settings, desktop folder and site approval cards, and gateway client identification.
Installer-based desktop apps are unchanged in this release; CLI users can run hermes update.
events.importance_reason_en: This is Hermes’s first stable rollup of the month and changes gateway architecture, plugin management and desktop security approvals.

events.title_zh: ZCode 4.0.0 接入 GLM-5.4 Coding Plan 与视觉能力
events.summary_zh: ZCode 4.0.0 在 Coding Plan 中预配置 GLM-5.4，并加入视觉能力和通用编程改进。插件商店按登录地区展示内容，配置服务不可用时工作流仍可按需启用；更新还修复会话启动卡死和切换模型或提供商后上下文丢失。
key_points_zh: GLM-5.4 在 Coding Plan 中可用并预配置，新增视觉能力。
插件商店按登录地区展示插件。
配置服务不可用时，工作流仍可默认按需启用。
Documents、Spreadsheets 和 Presentations 插件不再增加视觉验收步骤。
修复会话启动长时间卡死及切换模型或提供商后上下文偶尔丢失。
events.importance_reason_zh: 新模型与视觉能力直接改变 Coding Plan 可用面，可靠性修复则关系会话连续性。
events.title_en: ZCode 4.0.0 adds GLM-5.4 Coding Plan and vision
events.summary_en: ZCode 4.0.0 makes GLM-5.4 available and preconfigured on the Coding Plan, adding vision and stronger general coding capabilities. The plugin store reflects login region, workflows remain available on demand when the configuration service is down, and the release fixes long startup hangs and occasional context loss after model or provider switches.
key_points_en: GLM-5.4 is available and preconfigured on the Coding Plan, with vision capabilities.
The plugin store displays plugins based on login region.
Workflows remain available on demand when the configuration service is unavailable.
Documents, Spreadsheets and Presentations plugins skip an additional visual acceptance step.
Fixes long startup hangs and occasional context loss after switching models or providers.
events.importance_reason_en: The new model and vision capabilities change Coding Plan availability, while reliability fixes protect session continuity.

events.title_zh: Kiro Enterprise 预览 Claude Fable 5.2
events.summary_zh: Kiro 开始向 Enterprise 组织的各客户端预览 Claude Fable 5.2。Anthropic 称其适合大型、定义宽松的技术问题，可跨仓库工作、边执行边自测并协调子代理；Kiro 标明 1M 上下文、6 倍 credits 消耗，推理仅在美国区域运行。
key_points_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 以 Preview 形式向 Kiro Enterprise 推出。
提供 1M 上下文窗口，Kiro 计费为 6 倍 credits。
推理仅在美国地理区域运行。
官方强调大型技术任务、跨仓库工作、自测与子代理协调。
events.importance_reason_zh: 新模型的企业预览同时带来上下文、成本和推理地域限制，需要按账户与数据要求判断。
events.title_en: Kiro Enterprise previews Claude Fable 5.2
events.summary_en: Kiro is beginning a Preview rollout of Claude Fable 5.2 across clients for Enterprise organizations. Anthropic describes it for large, loosely defined technical work, including cross-repository tasks, self-testing and subagent coordination; Kiro lists a 1M context window, a 6x credit multiplier and US-only inference.
key_points_en: Claude Fable 5.2 is in Preview for Kiro Enterprise.
It has a 1M context window and a 6x Kiro credit multiplier.
Inference runs only in the US geography.
The official description emphasizes large technical tasks, cross-repository work, self-testing and subagent coordination.
events.importance_reason_en: The enterprise preview combines a larger context window with credit and inference-region constraints that matter for account and data planning.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动将于 12 月 4 日下线 Xing4.0-29B
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动公告称，为优化资源配置，平台将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日下线 XingChenAGI/Xing4.0-29B。正在使用该模型的用户应切换到其他模型；公告没有指定替代模型。
key_points_zh: XingChenAGI/Xing4.0-29B 计划于 2026 年 12 月 4 日下线。
公告建议现有用户尽快切换到其他模型。
公告未给出替代模型、迁移工具或数据保留说明。
events.importance_reason_zh: 明确的模型停运时间会影响依赖该端点的应用，需要提前规划迁移。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow will retire Xing4.0-29B on December 4
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow announced that it will retire XingChenAGI/Xing4.0-29B on December 4, 2026 to optimize resource allocation. Current users should switch to another model; the notice does not name a replacement.
key_points_en: XingChenAGI/Xing4.0-29B is scheduled to be retired on December 4, 2026.
The notice advises current users to switch to another model as soon as possible.
No replacement model, migration tool or data-retention terms are provided.
events.importance_reason_en: The explicit retirement date affects applications that depend on the endpoint and requires migration planning.

events.title_zh: Devin 增加会话级 MCP 授权与扫描取消审计
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 23 日更新支持分屏打开会话、用命令面板搜索会话，并在审计日志记录代码扫描取消者。MCP 审批卡新增 Allow for this session，管理员可将市场插件标记为 Offered 而非 Required，删除被 Preflight 使用的密钥前也会列出相关自动化。
key_points_zh: Option/Alt+点击会话链接可分屏打开，Cmd/Ctrl+K 搜索会话。
审计日志记录从网页或 v3 API 取消代码扫描的用户。
MCP 工具审批卡新增整个会话允许选项。
管理员可将市场插件设为 Offered；API-key MCP 空头部绑定到密钥并标记未使用密钥。
删除被 Preflight 检查使用的组织密钥前会提示受影响自动化。
events.importance_reason_zh: 更新增强 MCP 授权粒度、密钥依赖可见性和企业审计能力。
events.title_en: Devin adds session-wide MCP approval and scan-cancellation auditing
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 23 update adds split-pane sessions and command-palette session search, records who cancels code scans in audit logs, and adds Allow for this session to MCP approval cards. Admins can mark marketplace plugins Offered rather than Required, and secret deletion warns about automations whose Preflight checks depend on the secret.
key_points_en: Option/Alt-click opens a session in a split pane; Cmd/Ctrl+K searches sessions.
Audit logs identify users who cancel code scans from the web app or v3 API.
MCP approval cards add a whole-session allow option.
Admins can mark marketplace plugins Offered; blank API-key MCP headers bind to secrets and unused secrets are flagged.
Deleting an organization secret warns about automations whose Preflight checks use it.
events.importance_reason_en: The update strengthens MCP authorization granularity, secret-dependency visibility and enterprise auditing.

events.title_zh: Antigravity 插件市场扩展可观测性、基础设施与科学工具
events.summary_zh: Google 称 Antigravity Plugin Marketplace 新增一批第三方和 Google 插件，覆盖可观测性、事件响应、云基础设施、数据库、质量门禁、办公与媒体工作流。Google Workspace 补齐 Gmail，科学插件从单一 Science 扩展为 Chemistry、Genomics、Science Overview、Scientific Literature、Structural Biology 五个入口；文章所列插件已可在 App 和 CLI 安装。
key_points_zh: Better Stack、Grafana Cloud、incident.io 与 Arize AX 新增日志、指标、追踪、值班和 LLM 评估连接。
Cloudflare、Clerk、Neo4j、SonarQube、Scandit、TestMu AI、Spacefast 等覆盖部署、认证、图查询、质量与移动或浏览器测试；SonarQube 宣称支持 40 多种语言和 7,500 多种 issue 类型。
Google 新增 Gmail、Looker、Robotics 与 Elephant-Goldfish Model；Robotics 带 MuJoCo 仿真和实时 3D sidecar。
Science 扩展为五个插件：Chemistry（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）、Genomics（AlphaGenome 等）、Science Overview、Scientific Literature、Structural Biology（AlphaFold 等）；App 与 CLI 均可用 agy plugin install。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是市场上线后的具体可用性扩展，尤其把可观测性、部署、数据库和科研工作流接入 Agent；不是单纯宣传轮播。
events.title_en: Antigravity plugin marketplace expands observability, infrastructure and science tools
events.summary_en: Google says the Antigravity Plugin Marketplace has added third-party and Google plugins spanning observability, incident response, cloud infrastructure, databases, quality gates, office and media workflows. Google Workspace adds Gmail, while the single Science plugin becomes five specialized entries: Chemistry, Genomics, Science Overview, Scientific Literature and Structural Biology. The listed additions are installable in both the App and CLI.
key_points_en: Better Stack, Grafana Cloud, incident.io and Arize AX add connections for logs, metrics, traces, on-call work and LLM evaluation.

Cloudflare, Clerk, Neo4j, SonarQube, Scandit, TestMu AI and Spacefast cover deployment, authentication, graph queries, quality and mobile or browser testing. SonarQube claims support for more than 40 languages and 7,500 issue types.
Google adds Gmail, Looker, Robotics and Elephant-Goldfish Model; Robotics includes MuJoCo simulation and a live 3D sidecar.

Science becomes five plugins: Chemistry (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem), Genomics (AlphaGenome and others), Science Overview, Scientific Literature and Structural Biology (AlphaFold and others). Both App and CLI use agy plugin install.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a concrete availability expansion after the marketplace launch, connecting observability, deployment, databases and scientific workflows to Agents rather than offering only a promotional roundup.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.3-alpha.1：插件市场 Git 源、代码审阅页与连接器生态
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）v0.2.3-alpha.1 集中扩充插件与协作能力：插件市场支持 Git 仓库（含私有仓库）来源，新增实验性时间线插件与代码审阅页面，Web 连接模式支持远程登录，连接器账号统一管理并新增 Linear、Notion 等连接器；Computer Use 调整授权方式并可经 cua-mcp 对外提供。该版本为 alpha，界面与接口多项调整要求插件按升级指南迁移。
key_points_zh: 插件市场支持添加 Git 仓库（含私有仓库）作为插件来源
新增实验性时间线插件，可查看智能体任务树、阻塞事项和进展报告
新增代码审阅页面集中查看本人相关的 GitHub PR 并可在页内与智能体协作审阅；审阅插件扩展机制支持自定义视图与行注解，同时支持评审和合并 GitLab
Web 连接模式新增远程登录，可使用独立登录链接或设备配对访问，并提供标准化连接鉴权 API
插件页统一管理连接器账号，MCP 支持 OAuth 授权与凭据自动刷新；新增 Linear、Notion、腾讯文档、飞书、企业微信、腾讯会议和钉钉连接器插件
Computer Use 在 macOS 统一系统键鼠输入授权、新增实验性 Windows 支持，并可通过 cua-mcp 以 MCP 服务器形式对外提供
Node PTC 默认在调用间保留变量并支持重复声明，移除 Python PTC 支持
events.importance_reason_zh: 代码审阅、连接器生态与远程登录把 DSH 从单人桌面智能体向团队协作与外部服务集成推进，发布说明同时列出多项需要插件迁移的接口变更，实际升级成本可观。
events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.3-alpha.1: Git-sourced plugin market, code review page, and connector ecosystem
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) v0.2.3-alpha.1 expands plugin and collaboration features: the plugin market accepts Git repositories including private ones, an experimental Timeline plugin and a code review page arrive, web connection mode gains remote sign-in, connector accounts are managed in one place with new Linear, Notion, and other connectors; Computer Use changes its approval model and can be served through cua-mcp. This is an alpha release with several interface changes that require plugins to migrate per the upgrade guide.
key_points_en: The plugin market can add Git repositories, including private ones, as plugin sources
A new experimental Timeline plugin shows agent task trees, blockers, and progress reports

A new code review page centrally lists GitHub pull requests involving you with in-page agent collaboration; plugins can extend review with custom views and line annotations, and GitLab merge requests can be reviewed and merged
Web connection mode adds remote sign-in via a dedicated link or device pairing, with a standardized connection authentication API for plugins

Connector accounts are managed from the Plugins page with MCP OAuth authorization and automatic credential refresh; optional connector plugins arrive for Linear, Notion, Tencent Docs, Feishu, WeCom, Tencent Meeting, and DingTalk
Computer Use unifies system keyboard and mouse approval on macOS, adds experimental Windows support, and can be served externally as an MCP server through cua-mcp
Node PTC retains variables across calls by default and allows redeclaration; Python PTC support is removed
events.importance_reason_en: Code review, connectors, and remote sign-in push DSH from a single-user desktop agent toward team collaboration and external service integration, and the release notes list multiple interface changes requiring plugin migration, so the upgrade cost is real.

events.title_zh: OpenRouter 通报推理提供商数据处理事件
events.summary_zh: OpenRouter 发文通报：安全研究人员发现部分推理提供商未遵守其自身的数据政策；OpenRouter 称调查未显示其自身系统被突破，并说明已采取的措施与后续安排。本轮仅取得官方摘要，全文未入队。
key_points_zh: 安全研究人员发现部分推理提供商未遵守其自身数据政策
OpenRouter 称调查未显示 OpenRouter 本身被突破
OpenRouter 说明已采取的措施与后续步骤
events.importance_reason_zh: OpenRouter 聚合多家推理提供商，提供商层面的数据政策违约直接影响用户数据流向判断；平台对事件边界的澄清对依赖其路由的用户重要。
events.title_en: OpenRouter discloses data processing incidents on inference providers
events.summary_en: OpenRouter disclosed that security researchers found some inference providers did not uphold their own data policies; it states the findings did not show any breach of OpenRouter itself and describes what has been done and what comes next. Only the official summary was collected this round; the full article is not in the queue.
key_points_en: Security researchers found that some inference providers did not uphold their own data policies
OpenRouter states the findings did not show any breach of OpenRouter itself
OpenRouter describes what it has done and what comes next
events.importance_reason_en: OpenRouter aggregates many inference providers, so provider-level data policy violations directly affect where user data may flow; the platform's clarification of the incident boundary matters to users relying on its routing.

events.title_zh: ZCode 3.19.1 扩展后台任务并收紧工具安全校验
events.summary_zh: ZCode 3.19.1 加入回复语言、语音快捷键、内置文档工具和模型搜索，MCP 服务改为异步启动，子任务默认后台运行。内置设计插件加入图像生成，分享文件、adb、工作区 hooks 和插件选项的安全校验加强，并修复重启后子代理与活动记录丢失等问题。
key_points_zh: 新增回复语言、语音输入快捷键、模型搜索和内置 LibreOffice、Python、Poppler 工具。
MCP 服务异步启动，子任务默认后台运行，Send Now 可将前台 Agent 转入后台。
内置设计插件加入图像生成，文件链接支持行号与区间定位。
加强分享文件类型、adb、工作区 hooks 和插件选项的安全校验。
修复重启后子代理与活动记录丢失、登录失败、无限加载和速率限制重试不准。
events.importance_reason_zh: 版本同时扩展文档与设计工作流，并修复任务状态持久化和多项安全边界问题。
events.title_en: ZCode 3.19.1 expands background tasks and tightens tool security
events.summary_en: ZCode 3.19.1 adds reply-language and voice controls, bundled document tools and model search, starts MCP services asynchronously and runs subtasks in the background by default. The built-in design plugin adds image generation, security validation is tightened for shared files, adb, workspace hooks and plugin options, and several restart, login and rate-limit bugs are fixed.
key_points_en: Adds reply-language and voice controls, model search, and bundled LibreOffice, Python and Poppler tools.
MCP services start asynchronously, subtasks run in the background by default, and Send Now backgrounds the foreground Agent.
The built-in design plugin adds image generation, and file links support line and range locators.
Tightens security validation for shared-file types, adb, workspace hooks and plugin options.
Fixes lost subagents and activity records after restart, login failures, endless loading and inaccurate rate-limit retries.
events.importance_reason_en: The release expands document and design workflows while fixing task-state persistence and several security boundaries.

events.title_zh: Jeff Dean 称赞揭示词嵌入隐藏结构的论文分析
events.title_en: Jeff Dean praises a paper analysis revealing hidden structure in word embeddings
events.summary_zh: Jeff Dean 表示，他通过 Martin Casado 的帖子看到 arXiv:2602.15029，此前未注意到这篇最初于 2 月发布的论文；他称赞分析出色、图表让论文出彩，并点名 Dhruva Karkada、Daniel J. Korchinski、Andres Nava、Matthieu Wyart 和 @yasamanbb。他还表示，这类分析揭示了词嵌入中更多隐藏结构。
events.summary_en: Jeff Dean said he saw arXiv:2602.15029 through Martin Casado’s post and had not noticed the paper when it was originally posted in February. He praised the analysis and figures and named Dhruva Karkada, Daniel J. Korchinski, Andres Nava, Matthieu Wyart and @yasamanbb, saying analyses like this reveal more hidden structure in word embeddings.
key_points_zh: Jeff Dean 表示，他通过 Martin Casado 的帖子看到 arXiv:2602.15029，之前未注意到其 2 月的原始发布。
他称赞分析与图表，并点名 Dhruva Karkada、Daniel J. Korchinski、Andres Nava、Matthieu Wyart 和 @yasamanbb。
他表示，这类分析揭示了词嵌入中更多隐藏结构。
该帖是个人推荐与评价，没有提供独立基准测试或结果复核。
key_points_en: Jeff Dean said he saw arXiv:2602.15029 through Martin Casado’s post and had not noticed its original February release.
He praised the analysis and figures and named Dhruva Karkada, Daniel J. Korchinski, Andres Nava, Matthieu Wyart and @yasamanbb.
He said analyses like this reveal more hidden structure in word embeddings.
The post is a personal recommendation and evaluation, not an independent benchmark or verification of results.
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是 AI 研究者对词嵌入技术分析的一手推荐，有助于发现技术线索；但帖子本身不是论文结论，也不构成独立验证。
events.importance_reason_en: This is a first-hand recommendation of a word-embedding analysis from an AI researcher, useful as a technical lead but not a paper conclusion or independent verification.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.330：企业组织登录、内置 easel 图表与定时任务延长到 30 天
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.330 支持登录 Enterprise Admin Console 管理的组织，新增内置 easel mod 在对话与 MCP 指标结果下绘制图表，定时任务与 /loop 最长运行时间从 7 天延长到 30 天，并恢复 2.1.329 移除的 max_tokens 超限自动重试。
key_points_zh: 支持登录 Anthropic Enterprise Admin Console 管理的组织：claude auth login 后应用组织设置并使用其云提供商或网关
新增内置 easel mod：按请求及 MCP 指标结果绘制图表，覆盖 Pro、Max 及可用的 Team、Enterprise（macOS 与 Linux），可在 /config 关闭自动图表
定时任务与 /loop 最长可运行 30 天（原 7 天），旧任务仍按 7 天结束
更多针对根目录、主目录、顶层文件夹或工作目录的 rm 命令改为请求批准，无人应答时直接拒绝
恢复 2.1.329 移除的 max_tokens 超过模型或网关上限时的自动重试
VS Code 新增 /fork 会话分叉、/workflows 工作流地图及 escapeStopsClaude、pinPrompt、contextUsageThreshold 等设置
自托管 runner 新增 --start-dir 指定仓库内起始目录，spawn-runner 钩子默认可并发运行（上限 --hook-concurrency，默认 4）
events.importance_reason_zh: 组织级登录打通企业管理控制台，easel 让对话直接产出图表，30 天定时任务与 rm 审批调整影响长时自动化与安全默认值，均为可感知的使用变化。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.330: enterprise org sign-in, built-in easel charts, and 30-day scheduled tasks
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.330 adds sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console, a built-in easel mod that draws charts in conversations and under MCP metrics results, extends recurring tasks and /loop from 7 to up to 30 days, and restores the automatic retry for over-limit max_tokens that 2.1.329 removed.
key_points_en: Sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after claude auth login, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway
A built-in easel mod draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in /config
Recurring scheduled tasks and /loop run up to 30 days instead of 7 while the session keeps running; tasks made before this release still end at 7 days
More rm commands aimed at the root, home, a top-level folder or the working folder ask for approval, and are refused where nobody can answer
Restores 2.1.329's removal of the automatic retry when max_tokens exceeds a model's or gateway's limit
VS Code adds /fork to fork a conversation, /workflows for the agent map, and settings including escapeStopsClaude, pinPrompt, and contextUsageThreshold
The self-hosted runner adds --start-dir to start work in a repository folder, and spawn-runner hooks run concurrently by default up to --hook-concurrency (4)
events.importance_reason_en: Organization sign-in connects Claude Code to enterprise admin, easel turns conversations into charts directly, and the 30-day task window plus rm approval changes affect long-running automation and safety defaults in noticeable ways.

合作方包括 PerturbAI 和 Scripps Research，方向涉及脑研究。

events.title_en: OpenAI describes neurodegenerative-disease research with PerturbAI and Scripps Research
events.summary_en: OpenAI says AI is helping scientists find new leads for understanding and treating neurodegenerative diseases and describes brain research with PerturbAI and Scripps Research. key_points_en: OpenAI says AI is helping find new leads for neurodegenerative-disease research and treatment.
Collaborators include PerturbAI and Scripps Research, with work involving brain research.
The available partial text gives no disease name, experimental metrics, candidate results or clinical validation.
events.importance_reason_en: This is first-hand progress in AI-assisted brain research, but the evidence is limited to a collaboration description and does not establish a treatment breakthrough.

key_points_en: Demis Hassabis said Iso is working with Merck to design new cancer drugs.
He described this as evidence of rapid progress and an important breakthrough at Iso.
The post does not disclose a candidate drug, clinical-trial stage, technical method or timetable.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.32 弃用 Mercury Edit 2 自动补全，Codestral 成为默认补全模型
events.summary_zh: Kilo VS Code 7.8.32 稳定版（汇总 7.8.30-7.8.31 变更）退役 Mercury Edit 2 自动补全模型与 Next Edit 功能，原 Mercury 或 Inception 选择改用 Codestral，SDK 移除 client.kilo.edit，@kilocode/kilo-gateway 不再导出 ./edit 与 ./edit-prompt。遥测偏好改为从 VS Code About 页或核心遥测 API 设置，Kilo 配置、VS Code 或环境任一禁用时遥测保持关闭。另含 Agent Manager 工作树删除确认防误触修复。
key_points_zh: 退役 Mercury Edit 2 自动补全模型与 Next Edit，Codestral 成为默认补全模型。
原 Mercury 或 Inception 选择改用 Codestral；SDK 移除 client.kilo.edit。
遥测偏好改经 VS Code About 或核心遥测 API 设置，任一层禁用即保持关闭。
修复按住按键或重复关闭命令误确认工作树删除的问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 自动补全模型整体退役并更换默认模型，影响所有 Kilo 用户的补全行为与第三方模型依赖。
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.32 retires Mercury Edit 2 autocomplete; Codestral becomes the default
events.summary_en: Kilo VS Code 7.8.32 (rolling up 7.8.30-7.8.31) retires the Mercury Edit 2 autocomplete models and Next Edit. Saved Mercury or Inception selections move to Codestral, the SDK drops client.kilo.edit, and @kilocode/kilo-gateway no longer exports ./edit or ./edit-prompt. The telemetry preference moves to VS Code's About tab or the core telemetry API and stays off if Kilo config, VS Code, or the environment disables it. It also prevents held keys and repeated close commands from confirming worktree deletion in Agent Manager.
key_points_en: Mercury Edit 2 autocomplete models and Next Edit are retired; Codestral becomes the default autocomplete model.
Saved Mercury or Inception selections use Codestral; the SDK drops client.kilo.edit.
The telemetry preference moves to VS Code About or the core telemetry API, staying off when any layer disables it.
Held keys and repeated close commands can no longer confirm worktree deletion in Agent Manager.
events.importance_reason_en: Retiring an entire autocomplete model line and switching defaults changes completion behavior and third-party model dependencies for all Kilo users.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.115-2 接入 GPT-6.2 Astra、Gemini 4 Hydrogen 与 MAI-Code-2-Flash
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.115-2 在 /model 选择器加入 GPT-6.2 Astra、Gemini 4 Hydrogen（账号可用时支持 Extra High 推理力度）与 New models 分组下的 MAI-Code-2-Flash。Windows 沙箱默认启用包查询，macOS 沙箱可配置额外 Mach 服务查询；/model 支持直接管理自定义提供方模型（Ctrl+X 再按 A 添加并切换）；原生化扩展可在用户调用其声明的斜杠命令时延迟激活；Browser Use 升级到 0.2.1，提供会话级标签页；新增 showTimelineTimestamps 设置。
key_points_zh: /model 加入 GPT-6.2 Astra、Gemini 4 Hydrogen（可用时支持 Extra High）与 MAI-Code-2-Flash。
Windows 沙箱默认启用包查询，可用 sandbox.userPolicy.capabilities=[] 关闭。
macOS 沙箱支持通过 sandbox.userPolicy.seatbelt.extraMachLookups 放行特定 Mach 服务查询。
/model 可直接管理自定义提供方模型，Ctrl+X 再按 A 添加并可选切换。
原生化扩展按声明的斜杠命令延迟激活；Browser Use 0.2.1 提供会话级标签页；新增 showTimelineTimestamps。
events.importance_reason_zh: 一次更新同时接入三款模型并默认放开 Windows 沙箱包查询，改变模型可用面与沙箱默认行为。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.115-2 adds GPT-6.2 Astra, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, and MAI-Code-2-Flash
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.115-2 adds GPT-6.2 Astra, Gemini 4 Hydrogen (with Extra High reasoning when available for your account), and MAI-Code-2-Flash under New models to the /model picker. Windows sandbox enables package queries by default (opt out via sandbox.userPolicy.capabilities=[]); macOS sandbox supports extra Mach service lookups; /model manages custom provider models directly (Ctrl+X then A to add and switch); native extensions activate lazily when their slash commands are invoked; Browser Use updates to 0.2.1 with session-scoped tabs; a showTimelineTimestamps setting is added.
key_points_en: /model adds GPT-6.2 Astra, Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Extra High reasoning when available), and MAI-Code-2-Flash.
Windows sandbox enables package queries by default; opt out with sandbox.userPolicy.capabilities=[].
macOS sandbox supports specific Mach service lookups via sandbox.userPolicy.seatbelt.extraMachLookups.
/model manages custom provider models directly; Ctrl+X then A adds and optionally switches.
Native extensions activate lazily on their declared slash commands; Browser Use 0.2.1 adds session-scoped tabs; new showTimelineTimestamps setting.
events.importance_reason_en: One release adds three models and turns on Windows sandbox package queries by default, changing both model availability and sandbox defaults.

events.title_zh: DeepTutor 1.7.4 轮换运行时签名密钥：桌面发布凭据曾在 CI 产物中泄露
events.summary_zh: DeepTutor 发布 1.7.4 安全更新：11 月 20 日其桌面版发布凭据在 GitHub Actions 产物中暴露（相关产物已删除）。新版本改用新公钥校验运行时更新；发现以旧密钥签名的已存运行时时，安装随新版打包的已验证运行时并在启动前备份工作区。带标签的桌面构建现需维护者批准才能访问发布凭据。
key_points_zh: 11 月 20 日桌面版发布凭据在 GitHub Actions 产物中暴露，相关产物已删除。
桌面应用改用新公钥校验运行时更新。
发现旧密钥签名的运行时时，安装随新版打包的已验证运行时并在启动前备份工作区。
带标签的桌面构建需维护者批准才能访问发布凭据。
events.importance_reason_zh: 签名密钥轮换直接关系桌面更新链的可信性，凭据暴露属于真实供应链风险事件及其处置。
events.title_en: DeepTutor 1.7.4 rotates runtime signing keys after desktop release credentials leaked in CI artifacts
events.summary_en: DeepTutor shipped a 1.7.4 security update: on November 20, desktop release credentials were exposed in GitHub Actions artifacts (the artifacts have been removed). The desktop app now verifies runtime updates with a new public key; when it finds a saved runtime signed with the retired key, it installs the verified runtime bundled with the new app and backs up the existing workspace before starting it. Tagged desktop builds now require maintainer approval to access release credentials.
key_points_en: On November 20, desktop release credentials were exposed in GitHub Actions artifacts; the artifacts have been removed.
The desktop app verifies runtime updates with a new public key.
When a runtime signed with the retired key is found, the verified bundled runtime is installed and the workspace is backed up before starting.
Tagged desktop builds now require maintainer approval to access release credentials.
events.importance_reason_en: The signing-key rotation directly concerns trust in the desktop update chain, and the credential exposure is a real supply-chain incident plus its remediation.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.6.0 默认切换 GPT-6.2 Sol 并扩展 Qwen Token Plan 模型
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.6.0 在 openai、azure 与 openai-codex 三个提供方接入 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，Sol 成为三者默认模型。Azure 上下文窗口 1.05M；Codex 提供 Sol 500K、Astra 272K。两个模型都拒绝 none 与 minimal 推理力度，思考等级 off 不可用。Qwen Token Plan Individual 提供方加入 qwen4-max-preview 与 deepseek-v4.1-flash（含 1017 版本）及各套餐 API key 变量。扩展组件 render() 改为返回 readonly string[]，就地修改输出的扩展需先复制，属破坏性变更。
key_points_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 进入 openai、azure、openai-codex 提供方，Sol 为默认。
Azure 上下文窗口 1.05M；Codex 上 Sol 500K、Astra 272K。
两模型拒绝 none/minimal 推理力度，思考等级 off 不可用。
Qwen Token Plan Individual 加入 qwen4-max-preview 与 deepseek-v4.1-flash（含 1017 版）。
破坏性变更：扩展组件 render() 返回 readonly string[]，就地修改输出需先复制。
events.importance_reason_zh: Pi 的默认模型切换到 GPT-6.2 Sol 直接改变用户默认体验，Qwen Token Plan 扩展让该订阅用户可用 DeepSeek 模型。
events.title_en: Pi 1.6.0 makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default and expands Qwen Token Plan models
events.summary_en: Pi 1.6.0 adds GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to the openai, azure, and openai-codex providers, with Sol now the default for all three. Azure serves a 1.05M context window; Codex serves GPT-6.2 Sol with 500K and Astra with 272K. Both models reject reasoning effort none and minimal, so thinking level off is unavailable. The Qwen Token Plan Individual providers gain qwen4-max-preview and deepseek-v4.1-flash (plus the 1017 snapshot) with per-plan key variables. Extension components' render() now returns readonly string[], a breaking change requiring extensions to copy before mutating output.
key_points_en: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol join the openai, azure, and openai-codex providers, with Sol as the default.
Azure serves a 1.05M context window; Codex serves Sol with 500K and Astra with 272K.
Both models reject none/minimal reasoning effort; thinking level off is unavailable.
Qwen Token Plan Individual gains qwen4-max-preview and deepseek-v4.1-flash (plus the 1017 snapshot).
Breaking change: extension render() returns readonly string[]; in-place mutation requires copying first.
events.importance_reason_en: Pi's default model switch to GPT-6.2 Sol directly changes the default user experience, and the Qwen Token Plan expansion lets those subscribers use DeepSeek models.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 说明应对对抗性蒸馏的分层防御方法

key_points_zh: OpenAI 公布针对对抗性蒸馏的分层方法，覆盖模型训练、防护措施、检测与执法
该方法的目标是防止通过蒸馏提取模型能力
events.importance_reason_zh: 头部厂商公开描述防蒸馏的完整防御链条，反映模型保护与竞争边界的策略走向，对理解模型能力外流风险有参考价值。
events.title_en: OpenAI describes its layered defense against adversarial distillation
events.summary_en: OpenAI published "Combatting adversarial distillation", describing a layered approach that combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction. Only the official summary was collected this round; the full article is not in the queue.
key_points_en: OpenAI outlines a layered approach to adversarial distillation covering model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement
The approach aims to protect against capability extraction through distillation
events.importance_reason_en: A leading lab publicly describing its full anti-distillation defense chain signals how model protection and competitive boundaries are evolving, which is useful for understanding capability leakage risk.

events.title_zh: Codex CLI 0.171.0 默认接入 GPT-6.2 Sol 并默认启用 TUI 工作区
events.summary_zh: Codex CLI 0.171.0 把 GPT-6.2 Sol 与 Astra 加入模型目录，Sol 成为目录默认；TUI 工作区默认启用，支持可搜索的文档预览、图像预览与子代理转录。新增 codex exec --remote 在已有应用服务器上启动或恢复非交互会话，以及 /rc 与 /remote 本地远程控制和设备配对码。
key_points_zh: 模型目录加入 GPT-6.2 Sol 与 Astra，Sol 成为默认选择。
TUI 工作区默认启用：可搜索文档预览、图像预览与主会话旁的子代理转录。
新增 codex exec --remote <ADDR> 在已有应用服务器上启动或恢复非交互会话。
新增 /rc 与 /remote 管理本地远程控制并显示设备配对码。
修复会话切换丢失草稿与排队追问、切换工作目录丢权限配置，以及无刷新令牌的 IdP 企业 MCP 登录失败。
events.importance_reason_zh: 0.171.0 把 GPT-6.2 设为默认并默认开启 TUI 工作区，是 CLI 日常体验与默认模型行为的显著变化。
events.title_en: Codex CLI 0.171.0 makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default and enables the TUI workspace by default
events.summary_en: Codex CLI 0.171.0 adds GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to the model catalogs with Sol as the default selection, and enables the TUI workspace by default with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts. It adds codex exec --remote to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server, plus /rc and /remote for local remote control with device pairing codes.
key_points_en: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra join the model catalogs, with Sol as the default selection.
The TUI workspace is enabled by default: searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts beside the main conversation.
New codex exec --remote <ADDR> starts or resumes noninteractive sessions on an existing app server.
New /rc and /remote commands manage local remote control and display device pairing codes.

Fixes cover drafts and queued follow-ups lost when switching sessions, permission profiles dropped when changing working directories, and enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens.
events.importance_reason_en: 0.171.0 makes GPT-6.2 the default and turns on the TUI workspace by default, a notable change to daily CLI experience and default model behavior.

events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.3 稳定版上线：默认开启工具结果修剪并接入 GPT-6.2
events.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.3 把 0.23.2 以来约 370 个 PR 打包为面向 GitHub、Microsoft Store、Docker 与 Hermes Cloud 的稳定版。窗口内变化包括：提示缓存生命周期控制器（长工具运行期间的缓存预热、空闲会话在 1 小时缓存到期前压缩、cache_ttl 默认 auto）、压缩会归档被丢弃的工具结果、主动工具结果修剪默认开启、一次提问即可完成的首跑设置（含免费额度），以及 OpenRouter 与 Nous Portal 接入 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol（含 Pro）。
key_points_zh: 提示缓存生命周期控制器：长工具运行期间预热、空闲会话在 1 小时缓存到期前压缩，cache_ttl 默认 auto。
压缩归档被丢弃的工具结果，主动工具结果修剪默认开启。
首跑改为一次提问完成设置，包含免费额度。
OpenRouter 与 Nous Portal 提供 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol（含 Pro）。
events.importance_reason_zh: 0.23.3 是面向全渠道用户的稳定版，提示缓存与工具结果修剪默认值变化会影响所有会话的资源与上下文行为。
events.title_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.3 ships stable with default-on tool-result pruning and GPT-6.2 access
events.summary_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.3 rolls up about 370 PRs since 0.23.2 into a stable release for GitHub, the Microsoft Store, Docker, and Hermes Cloud. The window includes a prompt-cache lifecycle controller (warming through long tool runs, compacting idle chats before the 1h cache expires, cache_ttl defaulting to auto), compaction that archives dropped tool results, proactive tool-result pruning on by default, a one-question first-run setup that includes the free tier, and GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (+ Pro) on OpenRouter and Nous Portal.
key_points_en: Prompt-cache lifecycle controller: warming through long tool runs, idle chats compacted before the 1h cache expires, cache_ttl defaulting to auto.
Compaction archives the tool results it drops, and proactive tool-result pruning is on by default.
First-run setup now needs a single question and includes the free tier.
GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (+ Pro) are available on OpenRouter and Nous Portal.
events.importance_reason_en: 0.23.3 is the stable channel release for all users; the new prompt-cache and tool-result pruning defaults change resource and context behavior in every session.

events.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 在回复中称赞 Gemini 与 GDM 团队
events.title_en: Demis Hassabis praises Gemini and GDM teams in a reply
events.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 感谢对方的道歉，并与 @_sholtodouglas 开玩笑；他表示对方可能没有考虑到“低估了那个破解了谷歌 DeepMind 团队的团队”这一选项，随后称赞 Gemini 和 GDM 团队的工作，并称很高兴大家喜欢他们的烹饪作品。原帖的父帖语境未包含在材料中，不能据此判断具体争议或产品结论。
events.summary_en: Demis Hassabis thanked the person for an apology and joked with @_sholtodouglas. He said the person may not have considered the option of “underestimating the team that cracked the Google DeepMind team,” praised Gemini and GDM’s work, and said he was glad people enjoyed their cooking creations. The parent-thread context is not included in the material, so the specific dispute and any product implications cannot be established.
key_points_zh: Demis Hassabis 感谢对方道歉，并与 @_sholtodouglas 开玩笑。
他还以“低估了那个破解了谷歌 DeepMind 团队的团队”开玩笑，并称 Gemini 与 GDM 团队的工作了不起。
他表示很高兴大家喜欢团队的烹饪作品；材料缺少父帖语境，不能形成具体产品结论。
key_points_en: Demis Hassabis thanked the person for an apology and joked with @_sholtodouglas.
He also joked about “underestimating the team that cracked the Google DeepMind team” and called Gemini and GDM’s work amazing.
He said he was glad people liked the team’s cooking creations; without the parent-thread context, no specific product conclusion can be drawn.
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是负责人账号中的一手 AI 团队评价与互动，按个人观点保留；内容主要是社交回复，不构成发布或性能证据。
events.importance_reason_en: This is a first-hand AI-team evaluation and interaction from a responsible account, retained as a personal opinion; it is primarily a social reply and not release or performance evidence.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出药物发现评估基准 MedChemBench
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 MedChemBench，评估 AI 模型在早期药物发现中解读分子结构、基于实验证据推理以及选择候选化合物的能力。本轮仅取得官方摘要，全文未入队。
key_points_zh: OpenAI 推出 MedChemBench 基准
基准评估模型解读分子结构、从实验证据推理与选择候选化合物的能力
events.importance_reason_zh: 药物化学是 AI for Science 的重点方向，新基准为模型在真实科研任务上的表现提供了可比较的评估口径。
events.title_en: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench for drug discovery evaluation
events.summary_en: OpenAI released MedChemBench, a benchmark evaluating how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery. Only the official summary was collected this round; the full article is not in the queue.
key_points_en: OpenAI introduces the MedChemBench benchmark
It evaluates models on interpreting molecular structures, reasoning from experimental evidence, and selecting candidate compounds
events.importance_reason_en: Medicinal chemistry is a focal AI-for-science direction, and the new benchmark gives comparable evaluation for model performance on real research tasks.

events.title_zh: Google Agent Anomaly Detection 扩展支持 AWS、Azure 与本地部署智能体监控
events.summary_zh: Google Cloud 宣布 Agent Anomaly Detection 现可监控运行在 AWS、Azure 或本地环境中的 ADK 智能体：通过 Telemetry API 摄取 OpenTelemetry 格式的追踪与日志，在 Google Cloud 项目中评估完整对话的行为漂移，无需访问智能体底层运行时，可检测越权行为、工具滥用与资源耗尽等风险。
key_points_zh: Agent Anomaly Detection 现可监控运行在 AWS、Azure 或本地环境中的 ADK 智能体
通过 Telemetry API 摄取 OpenTelemetry 格式的追踪与日志，评估完整对话的行为漂移
无需访问智能体底层运行时，可检测越权行为、工具滥用与资源耗尽等风险
events.importance_reason_zh: 把智能体行为安全监控扩展到多云与本地环境，回应企业智能体跨云部署的真实安全需求，是 11 月 12 日产品介绍的实质能力扩展。
events.title_en: Google Agent Anomaly Detection extends monitoring to ADK agents on AWS, Azure, and on-premises
events.summary_en: Google Cloud announced that Agent Anomaly Detection now monitors ADK agents running across AWS, Azure, or on-premises: it ingests OpenTelemetry-formatted traces and logs through the Telemetry API and evaluates full conversations for behavioral drift in your Google Cloud project without access to the agent's underlying runtime, detecting risks like rogue behaviors, tool misuse, and resource exhaustion.
key_points_en: Agent Anomaly Detection now monitors ADK agents running across AWS, Azure, or on-premises
It ingests OpenTelemetry-formatted traces and logs through the Telemetry API and evaluates full conversations for behavioral drift
It needs no access to the agent's underlying runtime and detects risks like rogue behaviors, tool misuse, and resource exhaustion
events.importance_reason_en: Extending agent behavior monitoring to multi-cloud and on-premises deployments answers real security needs of enterprises running agents across clouds, a substantive capability expansion over the November 12 product introduction.

events.title_zh: Google Cloud 推出语义治理策略，工具调用执行前内联审查
events.summary_zh: Google Cloud 的后续实测显示，在 AgentDojo v1.2.2 上使用 gemini-2.5-flash 并仅开启默认用户意图检查时，攻击成功率从 48.7% 降至 0.9%，929 次需要工具调用的攻击在六轮中均未成功；正常任务效用平均下降 2.6 个百分点。该功能在 Gemini platform 预览，测试未覆盖针对策略判断器本身的自适应攻击。
key_points_zh: AgentDojo v1.2.2 共 97 个正常任务、949 次攻击运行，每种配置完整运行六次取平均。
仅启用默认用户意图检查时，攻击成功率从 48.7% 降至 0.9%。
929 次需要工具调用的攻击在六轮中均未成功；正常任务效用平均下降 2.6 个百分点。
策略判断器与不可信内容之间仍靠提示隔离，并非硬技术边界；固定攻击未测试自适应攻击。
功能在 Gemini platform 预览，可先通过 Agent Gateway dry run 查看 Cloud Logging 判决。
events.importance_reason_zh: 实测把意图劫持防护效果量化，同时保留效用损失、预览状态和自适应攻击未覆盖的限制。
events.title_en: Google Cloud introduces Semantic governance policies that vet tool calls before execution
events.summary_en: Google Cloud’s follow-up AgentDojo v1.2.2 tests with gemini-2.5-flash and only default user-intent matching report attack success falling from 48.7% to 0.9%, with none of 929 tool-call attacks succeeding across six runs; benign-task utility fell by 2.6 percentage points on average. The feature is in Preview in Gemini platform, and the fixed attacks did not cover adaptive attacks against the policy judge itself.
key_points_en: AgentDojo v1.2.2 used 97 benign tasks and 949 attacked runs, with six full runs per configuration averaged.
Default user-intent matching alone reduced attack success from 48.7% to 0.9%.
None of 929 tool-call attacks succeeded across six runs; benign-task utility fell by 2.6 percentage points on average.
The judge still relies on prompt-level separation from untrusted content, not a hard boundary, and fixed attacks did not test adaptive attacks.
The feature is in Preview in Gemini platform and can run behind Agent Gateway in dry run with verdicts in Cloud Logging.
events.importance_reason_en: The tests quantify protection against intent hijacking while preserving the utility cost, Preview status and untested adaptive-attack limitations.

corrections.reason_zh: 补全 11 月 20 日公告全文，并合并 11 月 23 日 AgentDojo 实测、效用损失与限制说明。
corrections.reason_en: Completed the November 20 article and merged the November 23 AgentDojo results, utility cost and limitations.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 宣布 IPO 收官：全额行使超额配售并完成同步私募配售
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布完成 IPO：以每股 83.00 美元发行合计 11.27 亿股 Class A 普通股，包含承销商全部行使额外 1.47 亿股期权，发行总募资约 935 亿美元，其中约 916 亿美元由 Anthropic 收取。同步完成约 260 亿美元的 Class N 私募配售，发行与私募配售合计约 1,195 亿美元。
key_points_zh: IPO 合计 11.27 亿股 Class A 普通股，发行价为每股 83.00 美元。
承销商额外购买 1.47 亿股的期权全部行使。
发行总募资约 935 亿美元，Anthropic 收到约 916 亿美元。
同步配售 313,253,007 股 Class N 普通股，金额约 260 亿美元。
发行与私募配售合计约 1,195 亿美元；Class A 股票已于 11 月 19 日以 ANT 交易。
events.importance_reason_zh: 完整正文确认 IPO 与私募配售的实际规模、公司所得和上市交易状态。
events.title_en: Anthropic announces closing of its IPO with full greenshoe exercise and concurrent private placement
events.summary_en: Anthropic closed its IPO of 1.127 billion Class A common shares at $83.00 per share, including full exercise of the underwriters’ option for 147 million additional shares. Gross offering proceeds were about $93.5 billion, of which Anthropic received about $91.6 billion. It also closed a roughly $26.0 billion private placement of Class N shares, bringing the combined total to about $119.5 billion.
key_points_en: The IPO totaled 1.127 billion Class A common shares at $83.00 per share.
The underwriters’ option for 147 million additional shares was exercised in full.
Gross offering proceeds were about $93.5 billion, of which Anthropic received about $91.6 billion.
The concurrent private placement sold 313,253,007 Class N shares for about $26.0 billion.
The combined total was about $119.5 billion; Class A shares began trading as ANT on November 19.
events.importance_reason_en: The full text confirms the actual IPO and private-placement scale, company proceeds and trading status.

corrections.reason_zh: 用完整公告补录发行募资、公司所得、私募配售股数与合计金额。
corrections.reason_en: Added offering proceeds, company proceeds, private-placement share count and combined amount from the full announcement.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 1.5 支持远程 SSH、Dev Containers 与 IDE 内云会话
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 1.5 让用户直接在 IDE 里进入远程环境：可经 SSH 连接自己的 Linux 机器、在 Dev Container 中打开项目，或在独立 Kiro 窗口中打开云会话。
key_points_zh: 支持 SSH 连接自有 Linux 机器进行远程开发。
支持在 Dev Container 中打开项目。
云会话可在独立 Kiro 窗口中打开。
events.importance_reason_zh: 远程 SSH 与 Dev Containers 是开发工具的关键基础设施能力，Kiro 由此补齐远程开发主路径。
events.title_en: Kiro IDE 1.5 adds Remote SSH, Dev Containers, and cloud sessions in the IDE
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE 1.5 lets you work in a remote environment from the IDE: connect to your own Linux machine over SSH, open a project in its Dev Container, or open a cloud session in its own Kiro window.
key_points_en: Connect to your own Linux machine over SSH.
Open a project in its Dev Container.
Open a cloud session in its own Kiro window.
events.importance_reason_en: Remote SSH and Dev Containers are core infrastructure capabilities for development tools, closing a major remote-development gap for Kiro.

events.title_zh: Qoder 0.5.17 修复 Windows 更新后启动与插件入口
events.summary_zh: Qoder 0.5.17 修复部分按用户安装的 Windows 环境在快速更新后无法启动的问题，以及市场插件安装和授权后没有应用入口的问题。插件置顶指南随界面语言和明暗主题调整，模型请求失败也显示更具体的错误。
key_points_zh: 修复部分 Windows 按用户安装环境快速更新后无法启动的问题。
修复市场插件安装与授权后缺少应用入口。
插件置顶指南匹配界面语言和明暗主题。
模型请求失败不再只显示通用错误。
events.importance_reason_zh: 版本重点在于恢复启动、插件入口和错误可诊断性。
events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.17 fixes Windows startup and plugin entry points
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.17 fixes startup failures after rapid updates in some per-user Windows installations and marketplace plugins missing an app entry point after installation and authorization. The plugin-pinning guide follows interface language and light/dark theme, and failed model requests show more specific errors.
key_points_en: Fixes startup failures after rapid updates in some per-user Windows installations.
Fixes marketplace plugins missing an app entry point after installation and authorization.
The plugin-pinning guide follows interface language and light/dark theme.
Failed model requests show more specific errors.
events.importance_reason_en: The release focuses on restoring startup, plugin entry points and error diagnosability.

events.title_zh: MiniMax 报告内部模型自动密码分析研究成果
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 称其内部研究模型 MIM 对历史密码标准候选、同行评审方案和公开挑战执行自动密码分析，取得多项实际攻击与求解结果。官方报告包括 Waterfall-256、Blender-256 碰撞，LOCKER、ROLLO-I 和 SBC-VOLE 密钥恢复，以及 McEliece 挑战中 94 个实例的求解；结果针对学术设计和公开参数，不影响已部署密码标准。
key_points_zh: MIM 是仅限研究的内部模型；MiniMax 称其可将理论攻击转化为可执行代码。
官方报告对 Waterfall-256、Blender-256、LOCKER、ROLLO-I 和 SBC-VOLE 等方案取得碰撞或密钥恢复结果。
在 TII McEliece 挑战中求解 94 个实例，包括 55 个此前未解的困难实例。
结果针对学术设计、历史候选和公开挑战参数，不影响已部署密码标准。
MiniMax 表示已向相关作者提前披露，并发布技术报告与概念验证代码；研究访问需申请。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是模型长程推理与可执行科学研究的官方进展，但重大安全结论仍须密码学界独立复核。
events.title_en: MiniMax reports automated cryptanalysis with its internal model
events.summary_en: MiniMax says its internal research model MIM performed automated cryptanalysis on historical standards candidates, peer-reviewed schemes and public challenges, producing practical attacks and solutions. The official report includes collisions for Waterfall-256 and Blender-256, key recovery for LOCKER, ROLLO-I and SBC-VOLE, and solutions for 94 TII McEliece challenge instances. The work targets academic designs and public parameters, not deployed cryptographic standards.
key_points_en: MIM is an internal research-only model that MiniMax says turns theoretical attacks into executable code.
The official report claims collision or key-recovery results for schemes including Waterfall-256, Blender-256, LOCKER, ROLLO-I and SBC-VOLE.
It solved 94 TII McEliece challenge instances, including 55 previously unsolved hard instances.
The work targets academic designs, historical candidates and public challenge parameters, not deployed standards.
MiniMax says it disclosed findings to authors in advance and released technical reports and proof-of-concept code; research access requires application.
events.importance_reason_en: This is official progress in long-horizon reasoning and executable research, but major security claims still require independent review by cryptographers.

events.title_zh: Devin 推出分用户组与分会话的访问共享
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 20 日推出 Access and Sharing，支持用户组、逐会话共享范围以及密钥、环境、插件、MCP 等资源的细粒度授权。新能力逐步推出且默认关闭，企业需联系 Cognition 启用；同时加入 SCM 权限差异检查和仓库同步。
key_points_zh: 新共享能力逐步推出、默认关闭，企业需联系 Cognition 启用。
用户组可替代个人或整个组织，会话可选择仅自己、用户组、组织或账户范围。
密钥、环境、插件、playbooks、skills、MCP、知识和自动化均可按用户组共享。
SCM 权限差异检查报告 Devin 与 GitHub/GitLab 访问不一致的仓库，并可同步仓库列表。
Slack 中无会话权限者不能下发指令，但可一键共享会话。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是企业访问模型的重要变化，兼顾协作共享与最小权限，但需要管理员启用和配置。
events.title_en: Devin introduces group-based and per-session access sharing
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 20 Access and Sharing update supports user groups, per-session sharing scopes and granular authorization for secrets, environments, plugins, MCP servers and other resources. The changes roll out gradually and are off by default for enterprises; it also adds an SCM access-mismatch checker and repository sync.
key_points_en: The sharing changes roll out gradually and are off by default; enterprises must contact Cognition to enable them.
User groups can replace individuals or the whole organization, and sessions can be limited to self, groups, the organization or the account.
Secrets, environments, plugins, playbooks, skills, MCP servers, knowledge and automations can be shared with groups.
An SCM checker reports repositories where Devin access differs from GitHub or GitLab, with optional repository sync.
Slack users without session access cannot issue instructions but can request one-click sharing.
events.importance_reason_en: This is a major enterprise access-model change that balances collaboration and least privilege, but requires administrator enablement and configuration.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.329 把定时任务与 loop 唤醒纳入 /tasks 并收紧 macOS 计算机使用规则
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.329 的 /tasks 新增显示本会话的定时任务、/loop 唤醒、goal 与会话分叉，x 可在询问后停止单项；/mcp 服务器页新增 JSON-RPC 错误行；/status 新增托管市场自动更新状态行。Code Mode 可在启用 OpenTelemetry 事件与指标时开启，工具调用会发送事件。macOS 计算机使用改用更严格安全规则：部分操作被拒绝、部分应用权限收窄，未完成的启动 30 秒后放弃。
key_points_zh: /tasks 汇总本会话定时任务、/loop 唤醒、goal 与会话分叉，x 经询问后停止。
Code Mode 与 OpenTelemetry 事件、指标可同时启用，工具调用发送事件。
/mcp 服务器页显示远端 HTTP 服务器拒绝连接的 JSON-RPC 错误；/status 显示托管市场自动更新状态。
macOS 计算机使用采用更严格安全规则：部分操作被拒、部分应用权限收窄、启动 30 秒未完成即放弃。
/code-review 不带目标时改为对照默认分支审查整个分支。
events.importance_reason_zh: 定时任务与 loop 进入统一管理面板并支持终止，补齐长周期自动化任务的可观测性；macOS 计算机使用规则收紧影响自动化操作面。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.329 brings scheduled tasks and loop wakeups into /tasks and tightens macOS computer use rules
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.329 adds this session's scheduled tasks, /loop wakeups, the goal, and conversation forks to /tasks, with x stopping one after asking; /mcp server pages gain a JSON-RPC error row; /status gains a marketplace auto-update row. Code Mode can now run while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled, with each tool call sending its events. Computer use on macOS switches to stricter safety rules: some actions are refused, some apps have less access, and an unfinished launch gives up after 30 seconds.
key_points_en: /tasks aggregates this session's scheduled tasks, /loop wakeups, the goal, and conversation forks, with x stopping one after asking.
Code Mode works alongside OpenTelemetry events and metrics, with tool calls sending their events.
/mcp server pages show the JSON-RPC error of a refusing remote HTTP server; /status shows managed marketplace auto-update status.
Computer use on macOS follows stricter safety rules: some actions refused, some apps with less access, launches abandoned after 30 seconds.
/code-review with no target now reviews the whole branch against the default branch.
events.importance_reason_en: Bringing scheduled tasks and loops into one manageable panel with stopping support closes a visibility gap for long-running automation, and tighter macOS computer-use rules shrink the blast radius of automated actions.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 介绍 ChatGPT Data Agent 的数据连接、分析与协作流程
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 的 Data Agent 系列视频简介介绍 ChatGPT 中的 Data 插件：连接文件与团队工具后，可提问、生成可视化、创建仪表盘并分享报告。系列还展示工作区管理员的 Snowflake 与自定义 MCP 配置、销售数据追问与来源检查、通过 Sites 分享连接数据的仪表盘，以及在 Space 中协作编辑和评论报告；插件可用性、数据连接与刷新选项取决于工作区和数据源。
key_points_zh: Data 插件支持连接文件与团队工具后提问、生成可视化、创建仪表盘和分享报告，并提供数据质量、KPI 定义与商业分析等技能。
工作区管理员可启用 Data 插件、控制成员安装方式，并配置 Snowflake 连接或自定义插件、MCP 服务器；连接消息、邮件和文件可增加回答上下文。
系列使用虚构 Acme 销售数据演示季度对比、客户跟进、来源检查、追问分析，并把结果整理成三页演示文稿。
仪表盘可检查图表底层数据、调整外观、刷新并通过 Sites 与连接数据一起分享；报告可转为 Space Page，设置访问权限、编辑标题、提问和评论。连接与刷新选项受工作区和数据源限制。
events.importance_reason_zh: Data Agent 将数据接入、分析、展示和团队协作串成具体流程，并明确管理员配置、来源检查与权限边界；简介未提供性能基准，且本包未取得字幕或画面。
events.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Data Agent workflows for connected data, analysis and collaboration
events.summary_en: Descriptions for OpenAI's Data Agent series introduce the Data plugin in ChatGPT for asking questions, creating visualizations and dashboards, and sharing reports using files and connected team tools. The series also covers Snowflake and custom MCP setup for workspace admins, follow-up sales analysis with source checks, dashboards shared through Sites with connected data, and collaborative report editing and comments in Space. Plugin availability, data connections and refresh options depend on workspace settings and the data source.
key_points_en: The Data plugin supports questions, visualizations, dashboards and report sharing with files and connected team tools, plus skills for data quality, KPI definition and business analysis.

Workspace admins can enable the plugin, control how teammates install it, and configure a Snowflake connection or a custom plugin or MCP server; connecting messages, email and files adds context to answers.
Using fictional Acme sales data, the series demonstrates quarterly comparisons, customer follow-ups, source checks, follow-up analysis and a concise three-slide presentation.

Dashboards can expose chart data, change appearance, refresh and be shared through Sites with connected data; reports can become Space Pages with access controls, editable headings, questions and comments. Connection and refresh options depend on the workspace and data source.
events.importance_reason_en: Data Agent connects data access, analysis, presentation and team collaboration in a concrete workflow while identifying admin setup, source-checking and permission boundaries. The descriptions provide no benchmarks, and this packet has no subtitles or video frames.

events.summary_en: Jeff Dean said he was glad to see his former colleague and friend David Patterson join Laude Institute. The post does not specify Patterson’s role, research plans or the institute’s upcoming projects.
