events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.2 引入可跨崩溃存活的持久子代理并修复高危漏洞
events.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.2 汇总 0.23.1 以来约 1,989 个 PR：子代理可在网关重启或崩溃后存活并在独立会话中继续；Gemini 3 及之后版本与 Gemini 4 Carbon 默认走 Gemini Interactions API；Claude Mythos 5.2 增加 fast 模式；新增插件 API（ctx.fork_session、ctx.redact_text()、ctx.register_idle_task）与按任务的 cron 选项。安全方面修复 GHSA-p22p-9ph6-gmrh（CVE-2026-130164，High）：Bot Desktop 在 docker 或 ssh 终端后端下对 screen 环境文件做白名单校验。
key_points_zh: 持久子代理可在网关重启或崩溃后存活，并在自己的会话中继续。
Gemini 3+ 与 Gemini 4 Carbon 默认改用 Gemini Interactions API。
Claude Mythos 5.2 支持 fast 模式。
新增插件 API：ctx.fork_session、ctx.redact_text()、ctx.register_idle_task，以及按任务 cron 选项。
修复 CVE-2026-130164（High）：Bot Desktop docker/ssh 后端的 screen 环境文件改为白名单校验。
events.importance_reason_zh: 持久子代理改变长时间任务的可靠性边界，High 级 CVE 修复直接影响 Bot Desktop 在容器与远程终端场景的安全。
events.title_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.2 adds durable subagents that survive crashes and fixes a high-severity CVE
events.summary_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.2 rolls up roughly 1,989 PRs since 0.23.1: durable subagents survive a gateway restart or crash and continue in their own conversation; the Gemini Interactions API becomes the default for Gemini 3 and later plus Gemini 4 Carbon; Claude Mythos 5.2 gains a fast mode; new plugin APIs (ctx.fork_session, ctx.redact_text(), ctx.register_idle_task) and per-job cron options land. Security: fixes GHSA-p22p-9ph6-gmrh (CVE-2026-130164, High) by allowlisting and validating the Bot Desktop screen env file under docker or ssh terminal backends.
key_points_en: Durable subagents survive a gateway restart or crash and can be continued on their own conversation.
The Gemini Interactions API is now the default for Gemini 3 and later plus Gemini 4 Carbon.
Claude Mythos 5.2 gains a fast mode.
New plugin APIs: ctx.fork_session, ctx.redact_text(), ctx.register_idle_task, plus per-job cron options.
Fixes CVE-2026-130164 (High): the Bot Desktop screen env file under docker/ssh backends is now allowlisted and validated.
events.importance_reason_en: Durable subagents change the reliability boundary for long-running tasks, and the High-severity CVE fix directly affects Bot Desktop safety in container and remote-terminal setups.

events.title_zh: Kilo 用同题 3D 场景实测 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，并确认 API 定价变化
events.summary_zh: Kilo 博客以同一提示让 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 各自构建埃及工人建造金字塔、船只沿河运石的交互式 3D 场景，并排对比输出。文中引用的标准 API 价：Astra 每百万输入 8 美元、输出 40 美元，较 GPT-6 Astra 下降 20%，缓存输入享 60% 折扣；Sol 每百万 2/10 美元，与 GPT-6.1 Sol 持平；输入超过 272K 后价格更高。两款模型面向 Plus、Pro、Enterprise、Edu 用户进入 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex，API 模型名为 gpt-6.2-astra 与 gpt-6.2-sol，上线即支持 Ultrafast。OpenAI 称 FrontierCode 2.0 上 Sol 在约五分之一成本下与 Astra 差距不足 0.5 分（均为 max 档）；其 Fable 5.2 在 Agents' Last Exam 的结果未包含 9 个使用回退模型的任务。
key_points_zh: 同题对比：两模型分别构建金字塔建造的交互式 3D 场景并排展示。
Astra 定价 $8/$40（每百万输入/输出），比 GPT-6 Astra 低 20%，缓存输入 60% 折扣；Sol 维持 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 $2/$10。
输入超 272K 后价格更高；两模型在 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 面向 Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu，API 为 gpt-6.2-astra 与 gpt-6.2-sol，上线支持 Ultrafast。
OpenAI 称 FrontierCode 2.0 上 Sol 以约 1/5 成本达到与 Astra 差距不足 0.5 分（均为 max）。
OpenAI 的 Fable 5.2 在 Agents' Last Exam 的结果未计入 9 个使用回退模型的任务。
events.importance_reason_zh: 该测试提供了 Astra 相对 GPT-6 Astra 降价 20% 的第三方确认与 Sol 的成本效率证据，价格信息与能力差距数字可直接用于选型。
events.title_en: Kilo tests GPT-6.2 Astra vs. Sol on an identical 3D scene prompt and confirms pricing changes
events.summary_en: Kilo's blog gave GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol the same prompt to build an interactive 3D scene of Egyptian workers building a pyramid with boats delivering stones along a river, comparing the results side by side. Cited standard API rates: Astra is $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra, with a 60% discount on cached input; Sol holds GPT-6.1 Sol's $2/$10; rates are higher above 272K input tokens. Both models are in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users and in the API as gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol, with Ultrafast available at launch. OpenAI says Sol comes within 0.5 points of Astra on FrontierCode 2.0 at about one-fifth the cost (both at max), and that its Fable 5.2 Agents' Last Exam results omit nine tasks that used a fallback model.
key_points_en: Identical-prompt comparison: each model built an interactive 3D pyramid-building scene, shown side by side.
Astra is priced $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra, with a 60% cached-input discount; Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's $2/$10.
Rates are higher above 272K input; both are in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu and the API as gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol, with Ultrafast at launch.
OpenAI says Sol comes within 0.5 points of Astra on FrontierCode 2.0 at about one-fifth the cost (both at max).
OpenAI's Fable 5.2 Agents' Last Exam results leave out nine tasks that used a fallback model.
events.importance_reason_en: The test offers third-party confirmation of Astra's 20% price drop versus GPT-6 Astra and cost-efficiency evidence for Sol; the pricing and capability-gap numbers are directly useful for model selection.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.7.0 支持 Amazon Bedrock 并实验提示预测
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code CLI 2.7.0 新增 Amazon Bedrock provider 支持，并在 TUI 提供实验性 next-prompt 预测等改进。
key_points_zh: 新增 Amazon Bedrock provider：以 type = "bedrock" 与 AWS_REGION 配置。
实验性 next-prompt 预测：设 KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_PROMPT_PREDICTION=1 后按 Tab 或右箭头接受预测。
反馈对话框支持多行输入；/settings 新增 Follow-up behavior 设置。
events.importance_reason_zh: Bedrock 支持扩大 Kimi Code 的云平台兼容面，提示预测改进 TUI 交互。
events.title_en: Kimi Code CLI 2.7.0 adds Amazon Bedrock and experimental prompt prediction
events.summary_en: Kimi Code CLI 2.7.0 adds Amazon Bedrock provider support and experimental next-prompt prediction in the TUI, among other changes.
key_points_en: New Amazon Bedrock provider, configured with type = "bedrock" and AWS_REGION.
Experimental next-prompt predictions: enable with KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_PROMPT_PREDICTION=1 and accept with Tab or Right Arrow.
The feedback dialog accepts multiple lines, and /settings gains a Follow-up behavior setting.
events.importance_reason_en: Bedrock support widens Kimi Code cloud compatibility, and prompt prediction improves TUI interaction.

events.summary_zh: Kimi Code Desktop 1.4.0 支持将 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等外部智能体连接到桌面应用，可交接会话、查看历史并跨回合协作。
key_points_zh: 支持连接 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等外部智能体，交接会话、审阅历史并跨回合协作。
后台任务通知以可折叠行展示，含任务时长与状态。
shell 工具子进程可使用 KIMI_CODE_SESSION_ID 与 KIMI_CODE_WORKSPACE_ID 环境变量。

events.title_en: Kimi Code Desktop 1.4.0 connects external coding agents
events.summary_en: Kimi Code Desktop 1.4.0 can connect external agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor to hand off sessions, review history, and collaborate across turns.
key_points_en: External agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can be connected to hand off sessions, review history, and collaborate across turns.
Background task notifications appear as collapsible rows styled like tool calls, with task duration and status.
KIMI_CODE_SESSION_ID and KIMI_CODE_WORKSPACE_ID are exposed to shell tool subprocesses.
events.importance_reason_en: Cross-tool agent handoff improves interoperability between Kimi Desktop and other coding agents.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 介绍以 Codex 工作流驱动的 Performance Factory 维持 ChatGPT 性能
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布工程文章，介绍其 Performance Factory：一套由 Codex 驱动的工作流系统，用于发现并修复性能问题，帮助 ChatGPT 保持快速响应。
key_points_zh: Performance Factory 是一套 Codex 驱动的工作流系统。
用于发现并修复性能问题。
目标是帮助 ChatGPT 保持快速响应。

events.title_en: OpenAI describes its Codex-powered Performance Factory that keeps ChatGPT fast
events.summary_en: OpenAI published an engineering post describing the Performance Factory: a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.
key_points_en: The Performance Factory is a system of Codex-powered workflows.
It finds and fixes performance issues.
The goal is helping ChatGPT stay fast.
events.importance_reason_en: Using coding agents for continuous performance engineering of its own product is a first-hand case of agents entering critical production operations.

events.summary_zh: WorldRouter 官方账号宣布成为 infiniflow 开源 RAGFlow 的内置模型提供商：添加 WorldRouter API key 后，RAGFlow 会列出其可用模型，可设为默认 LLM 直接对话数据集。帖文以 1/2 开头，续篇未抓取。

添加 WorldRouter API key 后，RAGFlow 列出其可用模型并可设为默认 LLM。
原帖标注 1/2，续篇未被本次采集捕获。

events.title_en: WorldRouter becomes a built-in model provider in RAGFlow

The post is marked 1/2; the follow-up was not captured.
key_points_en: WorldRouter is now a built-in model provider in infiniflow's open-source RAGFlow.
With a WorldRouter API key added, RAGFlow lists available models, and one can be picked as the default LLM.
The post is marked 1/2; the follow-up was not captured in this round.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.328 将 Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 自动模式扩展到多云平台
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.328 把 Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 的自动模式（auto mode）扩展到 Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud Agent Platform、Microsoft Foundry 与 Claude 应用网关，无权限模式的交互会话默认进入自动模式。
key_points_zh: auto mode 覆盖 Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud's Agent Platform、Microsoft Foundry 与 Claude 应用网关；无权限模式的交互会话默认以自动模式启动。
mcp_tool hooks 新增 "onFailure": "block"，hook 调用失败时阻止动作（与命令和 HTTP hook 一致）。
当跳过权限提示的会话消息可能被云会话延迟并丢弃时给出警告；/status 与 claude doctor 对缺少 endpoint 的 OpenTelemetry exporter 提示诊断失效。
events.importance_reason_zh: 自动模式扩展到多云平台并成为默认路径，改变企业环境下的权限行为。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.328 extends Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 auto mode across clouds
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.328 extends auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 to Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, and the Claude apps gateway, and interactive sessions without a permission mode now start in auto mode.
key_points_en: Auto mode covers Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, and the Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it.
mcp_tool hooks gain "onFailure": "block", so a hook whose call fails blocks the action, as with command and HTTP hooks.

A warning appears when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session; /status and claude doctor note that an OpenTelemetry exporter without an endpoint disables diagnostics.
events.importance_reason_en: Auto mode reaching multiple cloud platforms and becoming the default path changes permission behavior in enterprise setups.

events.title_zh: Google MaxText 支持 Streaming DiLoCo：跨都会区分布式训练通信量降逾 60 倍
events.summary_zh: Google 介绍 MaxText 中的 Streaming DiLoCo：跨地理分布的 TPU 分片训练大语言模型时，以流式传输参数片段代替每一步同步完整模型，跨分片通信量削减逾 60 倍并消除网络停顿，可在不损害收敛与模型质量的前提下实现多数据中心扩展。
key_points_zh: 以流式参数片段替代每步全模型同步。
跨分片通信量削减超过 60 倍，消除网络停顿。
支持多数据中心扩展且不降低收敛与质量。
events.importance_reason_zh: 60 倍通信削减把跨都会区广域训练从理论可行推向工程可用，改变大模型训练的地理布局成本结构。
events.title_en: Google's MaxText adds Streaming DiLoCo, cutting cross-slice communication over 60x
events.summary_en: Google describes Streaming DiLoCo in MaxText: for training LLMs across geographically distributed TPU slices, it streams parameter fragments instead of synchronizing full models at every step, cutting cross-slice communication volume by over 60x and eliminating network stalls, enabling multi-datacenter scaling without degrading convergence or quality.
key_points_en: Streams parameter fragments instead of synchronizing full models every step.
Cuts cross-slice communication volume by over 60x and eliminates network stalls.
Enables multi-datacenter scaling without degrading convergence or quality.
events.importance_reason_en: A 60x communication cut moves cross-metro wide-area training from theoretical to engineering-practical, changing the cost structure of geographic model-training footprints.

events.title_zh: Google 发布用 Tunix 与 Gemma 4 在 TPU 上训练多轮智能体 RL 的方法
events.summary_zh: Google 工程博客给出在 Cloud TPU 上用 Tunix 与 Gemma 4 训练多轮、可使用工具的 LLM 智能体的完整方法：采用智能体化 GRPO 与异步 vLLM 回放，在交互环境中显著提升复杂推理与工具遵从。
key_points_zh: 面向多轮工具使用智能体的 RL 训练方法，基于 Tunix 与 Gemma 4。
使用智能体化 GRPO 与异步 vLLM 回放。
在交互环境中显著提升复杂推理与工具遵从。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把多轮智能体 RL 的训练栈在 TPU 上工程化并开放方法，降低智能体训练复现门槛。
events.title_en: Google details multi-turn agentic RL training with Tunix and Gemma 4 on TPUs
events.summary_en: Google's engineering blog walks through training a multi-turn, tool-using LLM agent with Tunix and Gemma 4 on Cloud TPUs: agentic Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and asynchronous vLLM rollouts significantly improve complex reasoning and tool compliance in interactive environments.
key_points_en: RL training recipe for multi-turn tool-using agents, built on Tunix and Gemma 4.
Uses agentic GRPO and asynchronous vLLM rollouts.
Substantially improves complex reasoning and tool compliance in interactive environments.
events.importance_reason_en: Engineering the multi-turn agentic RL stack on TPUs and publishing the method lowers the reproduction barrier for agent training.

events.title_zh: Kiro 推出 VS Code 扩展并纳入所有套餐
events.summary_zh: Kiro for VS Code 已可在 Visual Studio Marketplace 安装，支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux，登录后即可使用。该扩展包含在每个 Kiro 套餐中，使用既有账号登录，套餐与计费不变。
key_points_zh: Kiro for VS Code 已上架 Visual Studio Marketplace。
支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux。
包含在每个 Kiro 套餐中，账号与计费不变。
events.importance_reason_zh: 进入 VS Code 生态把 Kiro 从独立 IDE 扩展为主流编辑器内的可选代理层，显著扩大可触达用户面。
events.title_en: Kiro ships a VS Code extension included in every plan
events.summary_en: Kiro for VS Code is available from the Visual Studio Marketplace on macOS, Windows, and Linux, ready after sign-in. The extension is included in every Kiro plan: sign in with your existing account, with no change to plans or billing.
key_points_en: Kiro for VS Code is available on the Visual Studio Marketplace.
It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
It is included in every Kiro plan, with no change to accounts or billing.
events.importance_reason_en: Entering the VS Code ecosystem extends Kiro beyond its standalone IDE into an optional agent layer in mainstream editors, substantially widening reach.

events.title_zh: Kiro Crew 0.13.0 向所有标准构建开放 Conductor 模式并支持随处回复
events.summary_zh: Kiro Crew 0.13.0 在每个标准构建中启用原 Ultra 模式更名为 Conductor 模式的功能；用户可从侧边栏或自己的聊天应用回复需要介入的会话，可提前看到下一次更新，并可重开、分叉与优化会话。Files 与 Git 面板优先显示代理改动，Bot 可自选运行底座。
key_points_zh: 原 Ultra 模式以 Conductor 模式名义在所有标准构建开放。
可从侧边栏或自己的聊天应用回复待介入会话。
可提前查看下一次更新，重开、分叉与优化会话。
Files 与 Git 面板优先展示代理改动；Bot 可自选 harness。
events.importance_reason_zh: Conductor 模式从高级档位下放到全部标准构建并打通站外回复入口，改变 Crew 多会话编排的日常使用方式。
events.title_en: Kiro Crew 0.13.0 opens Conductor Mode to everyone and adds replies from anywhere
events.summary_en: Kiro Crew 0.13.0 turns on Conductor Mode, formerly Ultra Mode, in every standard build. You can answer a session that needs you from the sidebar or your own chat app, see the next update before it arrives, and reopen, fork, and optimize chats. The Files and Git panels lead with what the agent changed, and Bots choose their own harness.
key_points_en: Conductor Mode, formerly Ultra Mode, is now on in every standard build.
Sessions needing input can be answered from the sidebar or your own chat app.
The next update can be previewed before it arrives, and chats can be reopened, forked, and optimized.
Files and Git panels lead with agent changes; Bots choose their own harness.
events.importance_reason_en: Moving Conductor Mode from a premium tier into all standard builds, plus out-of-app replies, changes day-to-day multi-session orchestration in Crew.

events.title_zh: Kiro 云会话可接入组织 Amazon VPC 私有资源
events.summary_zh: Kiro 组织可将云会话连接到 Amazon VPC 中的私有资源：管理员在 Kiro 控制台创建连接，再在 Controls 中设为 profile 默认；新云会话沿用 VPC 的网络控制，团队无需把资源公开即可让 Kiro 访问。
key_points_zh: 云会话可连接 Amazon VPC 内的私有资源。
管理员在 Kiro 控制台创建连接并在 Controls 设为 profile 默认。
新云会话沿用 VPC 网络控制，资源无需公开。
events.importance_reason_zh: VPC 直连解决企业把 Kiro 接入内网数据与服务的合规前提，是云会话走向企业内网的关键能力。
events.title_en: Kiro cloud sessions can connect to your organization's Amazon VPC
events.summary_en: Kiro organizations can connect cloud sessions to private resources in an Amazon VPC: administrators create the connection in the Kiro console, then set it as the profile default in Controls. New cloud sessions use the VPC's network controls, so teams can give Kiro access without making those resources public.
key_points_en: Cloud sessions can connect to private resources inside an Amazon VPC.
Administrators create the connection in the Kiro console and set it as the profile default in Controls.
New cloud sessions follow the VPC's network controls, with no need to expose resources publicly.
events.importance_reason_en: Direct VPC connectivity addresses the compliance prerequisite for putting Kiro on internal data and services, a key capability for enterprise adoption of cloud sessions.

events.title_zh: Qoder 0.5.16 支持跨网络设备控制与加密 Office 文档
events.summary_zh: Qoder 0.5.16 允许同一账号设备跨不同网络建立 Remote Control，并将选定对话与输出文件分享到讨论或项目 Issue。Agent Teams 可分配和重新分配 Issue，密码保护的 Word／Excel 文档可编辑并保留加密，PAC 代理支持 URL 或本地文件。
key_points_zh: 同一账号设备可跨网络远程控制，目标设备需开启 Allow control。
可把选定对话和输出文件保存到本机、发送到讨论或项目 Issue。
Agent Teams 支持 Issue 分配、改派和人工介入状态查看。
支持打开、编辑并保留密码加密的 Word 与 Excel 文件。
PAC 代理支持 URL 或本地文件；远程工作区在托管 SSH 断线后可继续已接收任务。
events.importance_reason_zh: 更新扩大跨设备协作、企业代理与敏感文档处理能力。
events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.16 adds cross-network device control and encrypted Office documents
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.16 lets devices on the same account use Remote Control across different networks and share selected conversations and output files to discussions or project Issues. Agent Teams can assign and reassign Issues, password-protected Word and Excel files remain encrypted after editing, and PAC proxies accept a URL or local file.
key_points_en: Devices on one account can use Remote Control across networks when the target enables Allow control.
Selected conversations and output files can be saved locally or sent to discussions or project Issues.
Agent Teams supports Issue assignment, reassignment and visibility into runs needing human intervention.
Password-protected Word and Excel files can be edited while retaining encryption.
PAC proxies accept a URL or local file; managed SSH remote workspaces can continue accepted tasks after disconnection.
events.importance_reason_en: The update broadens cross-device collaboration, enterprise proxy support and sensitive-document handling.

events.title_zh: Devin 推出可持续执行的 Devin Bots
events.summary_zh: Devin Bots 是拥有独立身份、记忆和权限的常驻 Devin，可把目标拆解并在各自云机器上并行运行会话，持续到 PR 可合并。用户可从 QA、代码审查或值班工程师模板开始，并通过网页、Slack、短信、电话或群聊交互。
key_points_zh: Devin Bots 拥有独立身份、记忆和权限，可持续执行目标。
Bot 可并行启动多个云机器会话，推进工作直到 PR 可合并。
支持 QA、代码审查、值班工程师模板或自定义目标。
可通过网页、Slack、短信、电话和群聊发送消息。
同版还支持按组织或预算结算仓库 Review，以及通过 API 关联代码扫描发现与现有会话。
events.importance_reason_zh: Bots 将 Devin 从单次会话推进到常驻、并行和可持续跟进的 Agent 形态。
events.title_en: Devin launches always-on Devin Bots
events.summary_en: Devin Bots are always-on Devins with their own identity, memory and permissions. They break down goals, run sessions in parallel on separate cloud machines and keep work moving until a pull request is ready to merge. Users can start from QA, code-review or on-call templates and interact through the web app, Slack, text, calls or group chats.
key_points_en: Devin Bots have independent identity, memory and permissions and can pursue goals continuously.
Bots run multiple cloud-machine sessions in parallel until a pull request is ready to merge.
QA, code-review and on-call templates are available, or users can describe a custom outcome.
Users can message Bots through the web app, Slack, text, calls and group chats.
The same update adds organization/budget Review billing and API linking of code-scan findings to existing sessions.
events.importance_reason_en: Bots move Devin from single sessions toward persistent, parallel Agents that can follow work through to merge readiness.

events.title_zh: 袁进辉：推理算力供需紧张或持续两三年
events.summary_zh: 在《中国证券报》专访中，硅基流动创始人兼 CEO 袁进辉将训练算力比作有边界的泳池、推理算力比作持续奔流的河流，并判断供不应求可能维持两三年。他预计长期 Token 价格会随供给充分而下降，认为异构算力编排和推理效率是平台价值；文中平台规模数据为公司披露。
key_points_zh: 袁进辉判断推理需求随模型日常使用持续增长，供需紧张可能维持两三年。
他引用国家数据局数据称，2026 年 3 月我国日均 Token 调用量突破 140 万亿，较 2024 年初增长超千倍。
硅基流动披露截至 2026 年 4 月注册用户 1,028 万、日均吞吐 5,785 亿、单日峰值超万亿；公有云付费开发者 71.6 万，专属实例企业客户 49 家。
他认为国产芯片受制造与软件生态制约，异构混布可缓解访存速度等短板。
他预计长期供给充分后 Token 价格下降，平台价值将来自效率提升。
events.importance_reason_zh: 创始人对推理需求、国产算力和 Token 定价的一手行业判断，包含可核查供需数据；预测属于个人观点。
events.title_en: Yuan Jinhui sees inference compute shortages lasting another two to three years
events.summary_en: In a China Securities News interview, SiliconFlow founder and CEO Yuan Jinhui compared bounded training compute to a swimming pool and continuously growing inference demand to a river, saying the shortage could last another two to three years. He expects Token prices to fall as supply catches up and sees heterogeneous scheduling and inference efficiency as platform value; the scale figures in the article are company disclosures.
key_points_en: Yuan expects inference demand to keep growing with everyday model use and says the supply-demand imbalance could last another two to three years.
Citing National Data Administration figures, he says China averaged more than 140 trillion daily Token calls in March 2026, over 1,000 times the level in early 2024.

SiliconFlow reported 10.28 million registered users, 578.5 billion average daily tokens and a peak above one trillion as of April 2026, plus 716,000 paid public-cloud developers and 49 dedicated-instance enterprise customers.
He says domestic chips face manufacturing and software-ecosystem constraints, while heterogeneous placement can mitigate memory-bandwidth and related bottlenecks.
He expects Token prices to decline once long-term supply is sufficient, leaving platform value in efficiency gains.
events.importance_reason_en: The founder's first-hand view on inference demand, domestic compute and Token pricing includes concrete supply-demand data, but its forecasts remain personal opinions.

events.title_zh: Tibo 称 GPT-6.2 Astra 在最难任务上独一档并回应沟通风格反馈
events.summary_zh: Codex 负责人 Tibo（Thibault Sottiaux）称 GPT-6.2 Astra 擅长最难的任务，团队分享了 AMD 与 Jalapeño 芯片优化结果；同时表示已收到对其沟通风格的反馈，团队正在改进。
key_points_zh: 称 Astra 在"世界上最难的任务"上表现出独一档的水平。
表示已收到沟通风格反馈，团队正在改进。
提及团队分享了 AMD 与 Jalapeño 芯片优化结果。
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人一手评价与改进承诺，反映 Astra 的实际使用边界。
events.title_en: Tibo calls GPT-6.2 Astra in a league of its own on hardest tasks, responds to style feedback
events.summary_en: Codex lead Tibo (Thibault Sottiaux) says GPT-6.2 Astra is good at hard things, that the team shared AMD and Jalapeño chip optimization results, and that he has received feedback on its communication style and the team is working on it.
key_points_en: He says Astra seems to be in a league of its own for "really the hardest tasks in the world."
He says he has received feedback on its communication style and the team is working on that.
He notes the team shared results on AMD and Jalapeño chip optimizations.
events.importance_reason_en: First-party assessment and improvement commitment from the product lead.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon
events.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon：DeepMind 负责人 Demis Hassabis 称其具备前沿级智能与快速任务完成能力，Pro 与 Ultra 用户现已可用；模型同日进入 GitHub Copilot 各端与 Google Antigravity。
key_points_zh: Demis Hassabis 宣布 Gemini 4 Neon 上线，称具备前沿级智能与快速任务完成，Pro 与 Ultra 用户现已可用。
Gemini 4 Neon 在 GitHub Copilot 面向 Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 用户开放，覆盖 VS Code、Copilot CLI、编码代理与应用等入口。
GitHub 引用 Google 数据称 Neon 质量接近 Gemini 4 Carbon、单任务 token 成本更低，且更少做出无依据的代码或工具结果声明。
Gemini 4 Neon 同步进入 Google Antigravity。
events.importance_reason_zh: 新一代旗舰模型上线直接改变多个编码智能体平台的可选模型与成本结构。
events.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon
events.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Neon: Demis Hassabis describes frontier-level intelligence and fast task completion, available now to Pro and Ultra users; the model also shipped to GitHub Copilot surfaces and Google Antigravity the same day.
key_points_en: Demis Hassabis announced Gemini 4 Neon with frontier-level intelligence and super-fast task completion, available now to Pro and Ultra users.
Gemini 4 Neon is available in GitHub Copilot to Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users across VS Code, Copilot CLI, the coding agent, apps, and more.
Citing Google, GitHub reports Neon delivers quality close to Gemini 4 Carbon at lower token cost per task and is less likely to make unsupported claims about code, tools, or test results.
Gemini 4 Neon is also available in Google Antigravity.
events.importance_reason_en: A new flagship model immediately changes available models and cost structures across multiple coding agent platforms.

events.title_zh: Genie 4 面向符合条件的 Ultra 订阅用户开放
events.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 现已可用，符合条件的 Ultra 订阅用户可在 Project Genie 中试用；该实时世界模型此前于 2026 年 10 月 27 日以研究预览形式发布。
key_points_zh: 官方博客确认 Genie 4 现已可用。
Demis Hassabis 称符合条件的 Ultra 订阅用户可在 Project Genie 中试用，并附官方博客链接。
events.importance_reason_zh: Genie 4 从研究预览进入消费级订阅可用，扩大该世界模型的真实用户覆盖。
events.title_en: Genie 4 opens to eligible Ultra subscribers
events.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 is now available, with eligible Ultra subscribers able to try it in Project Genie; the realtime world model was previously released as a research preview on October 27, 2026.
key_points_en: The official blog confirms Genie 4 is now available.
Demis Hassabis says eligible Ultra subscribers can try it in Project Genie and links the official blog.
events.importance_reason_en: Genie 4 moves from research preview to consumer subscription availability, widening real-user coverage of the world model.

events.title_zh: Tibo 征询用户对 6.2 Sol 的使用反馈
events.summary_zh: Tibo 发帖询问"6.2 Sol 今天用起来如何"，原帖未附具体数据或范围说明。
key_points_zh: 原帖仅征询用户对 6.2 Sol 的当日使用感受。
未提供数据、范围或后续回复内容。
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人对上线模型的反馈征集，按负责人账号宽标准保留。
events.title_en: Tibo asks how 6.2 Sol is treating users
events.summary_en: Tibo posted "How is 6.2 Sol treating you today?" without further data or scope in the captured text.
key_points_en: The post only asks users how 6.2 Sol is treating them today.
No data, scope, or follow-up replies are included in the captured text.
events.importance_reason_en: A feedback request from the product lead on the launched model, kept under the wider owner-account standard.

events.title_zh: Kilo 支持 Claude Platform 组织关联计费（beta）
events.summary_zh: Kilo 上线关联计费（linked billing）beta：管理员将 Claude Platform 组织与 Kilo 关联一次后，Claude API 用量按现有条款直接计入该组织，替代手动创建与轮换 Claude API key 的方式。
key_points_zh: 管理员一次性关联 Claude Platform 组织，Claude API 用量直接由 Anthropic 按现有条款计入该组织。
替代此前在 Kilo 中创建、粘贴并轮换 Claude API key 的方式。
events.importance_reason_zh: 计费整合降低团队使用 Claude 的管理成本，是计费方式变化。
events.title_en: Kilo adds linked billing with Claude Platform (beta)
events.summary_en: Kilo launched linked billing in beta: an admin links the Claude Platform organization to Kilo once, and Anthropic bills Claude API usage in Kilo directly to that organization on existing terms, replacing manual Claude API key creation and rotation.
key_points_en: An admin links the Claude Platform organization once, and Anthropic bills Claude API usage directly to that organization on existing terms.
This replaces creating, pasting, and rotating a Claude API key inside Kilo as teams change.
events.importance_reason_en: Billing integration cuts the administrative cost of using Claude for teams, a change in how usage is billed.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA RTX Spark 迷你桌面主机上市：华硕、戴尔、微星同步出货
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布华硕、戴尔与微星的 RTX Spark 迷你桌面主机即日起上市，面向本地 AI 智能体、图像与视频生成及模型微调，统一内存最高 128GB。同步扩展的软件生态包括 Adobe 的 Windows on Arm 原生应用、Blender 的 DLSS Ray Reconstruction 与 ComfyUI 本地生成工作流，全部在单台 Windows PC 上运行。
key_points_zh: 华硕、戴尔、微星的 RTX Spark 迷你桌面主机即日上市。
统一内存最高 128GB，可容纳更大本地模型。
面向本地智能体、图像视频生成与模型微调的专用 Windows PC。
软件生态：Adobe Windows on Arm 原生应用、Blender DLSS Ray Reconstruction、ComfyUI 本地生成。
events.importance_reason_zh: 桌面级 128GB 统一内存硬件把本地运行更大模型与常驻智能体变为消费级选择，扩大本地推理生态的硬件基础。
events.title_en: NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops out now from ASUS, Dell, and MSI
events.summary_en: NVIDIA announces that RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell, and MSI are available today, bringing local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning to a dedicated Windows PC with up to 128GB of unified memory. An expanding software ecosystem adds Adobe's native Windows on Arm applications, NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction in Blender, and local generation workflows in ComfyUI, all on one Windows PC.
key_points_en: RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell, and MSI are available now.
Up to 128GB of unified memory leaves room for larger local models.
A dedicated Windows PC built for local agents, image/video generation, and fine-tuning.
Software ecosystem: Adobe native Windows on Arm apps, DLSS Ray Reconstruction in Blender, and ComfyUI local generation workflows.
events.importance_reason_en: Desktop-class 128GB unified-memory hardware makes running larger local models and always-on agents a consumer option, widening the hardware base for local inference.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 介绍 ChatGPT for Accounting
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 的 YouTube 简介称，ChatGPT for Accounting 可减少月末结账事务：从邮件中找出已完成的工作并起草 QuickBooks 发票供用户审核，遇到不明确处会标记；Accounting 插件还支持使用现有电子表格和已连接会计工具对账、处理发票与收据、编制月报。
key_points_zh: 插件可从邮件中找出已完成的工作，并起草 QuickBooks 发票供用户审核。
起草过程中遇到不明确事项会标记出来。
插件支持对账、处理发票与收据，并使用现有电子表格和已连接会计工具编制月报。
依据仅为官方视频标题与简介，未取得字幕或画面，不能确认完整操作流程。
events.importance_reason_zh: 会计插件把邮件、QuickBooks 和会计工具接入月末结账流程，是 ChatGPT 在专业财务工作流中的实质扩展；简介未给出可用地区、套餐或完整自动化边界。
events.title_en: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Accounting
events.summary_en: OpenAI's YouTube description says ChatGPT for Accounting can reduce month-end close busywork by finding completed jobs in email and drafting QuickBooks invoices for user review, flagging anything unclear. The Accounting plugin also reconciles transactions, processes invoices and receipts, and prepares monthly reports using existing spreadsheets and connected accounting tools.
key_points_en: The plugin can find completed jobs in email and draft QuickBooks invoices for user review.
It flags anything unclear during invoice drafting.
It supports transaction reconciliation, invoice and receipt processing, and monthly reports using existing spreadsheets and connected accounting tools.
Evidence is limited to the official video title and description; without subtitles or frames, the complete operating flow cannot be confirmed.
events.importance_reason_en: The Accounting plugin brings email, QuickBooks and accounting tools into the month-end close, a substantive expansion of ChatGPT into professional finance workflows. The description does not specify regions, plans or full automation boundaries.

corrections.reason_zh: 依据同一官方 YouTube 视频的新简介补充月末结账、QuickBooks 发票起草、对账、发票与收据处理及月报功能，并将视频发布时间校正为简介快照中的 2026-11-18T13:01:26-08:00；证据范围仍为 metadata_only。
corrections.reason_en: Used the new description for the same official YouTube video to add month-end close, QuickBooks invoice drafting, reconciliation, invoice and receipt processing, and monthly reporting, and corrected the video publication time to 2026-11-18T13:01:26-08:00 from the description snapshot. Evidence remains metadata_only.

events.title_zh: B.AI 将 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 折扣提升至 50%
events.summary_zh: B.AI 官方账号宣布 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 折扣从 40% 提升至 50%，自帖文发布日起生效；同时可购买 HY4/HY4-Flash 产品。
key_points_zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 折扣从 40% 升至 50%，自发布日起生效。
官方称现可购买 HY4/HY4-Flash 产品。
events.importance_reason_zh: 平台折扣调整直接影响第三方接入 DeepSeek 模型的成本。
events.title_en: B.AI raises the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash discount to 50%
events.summary_en: B.AI's official account announced the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash discount rose from 40% to 50%, effective from the post date, and that HY4/HY4-Flash products can now be purchased.
key_points_en: The DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash discount rose from 40% to 50%, effective from the post date.
HY4/HY4-Flash products can now be purchased, per the post.
events.importance_reason_en: A marketplace discount change that directly cuts third-party access costs to the DeepSeek model.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 报告：编码智能体正在加速 AI 研究，但性能仍不均衡
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布《Research acceleration: The jagged frontier》报告，衡量编码智能体对 AI 研究的加速作用与性能不均之处；官方 X 总结称研究者对 AI 的使用量呈指数级增长、智能助手能完成更长任务、人类在研究中的参与仍至关重要、安全投入时间增加。
key_points_zh: 报告衡量编码智能体如何加速 AI 研究、哪些环节仍不均衡，及其对递归自我改进的信号。
官方总结：研究者对 AI 的使用量呈指数级增长，智能助手能完成更长任务。
官方总结：人类在研究中的参与仍然至关重要；安全性与相关事务的投入时间增加。
events.importance_reason_zh: 厂商关于 AI 自我加速的量化报告，保留归属，是能力演进的重要信号。
events.title_en: OpenAI reports coding agents are accelerating AI research unevenly
events.summary_en: OpenAI published "Research acceleration: The jagged frontier," measuring how coding agents accelerate AI research and where performance remains uneven; its account adds that researchers' AI use is growing exponentially, assistants complete longer tasks, human involvement remains critical, and safety-related time is increasing.
key_points_en: The report measures how coding agents accelerate AI research, where performance stays jagged, and what it signals about recursive self-improvement.
Per OpenAI's summary, researchers' AI usage is growing exponentially and assistants complete longer tasks.
Per OpenAI's summary, human involvement in research remains critical, and time spent on safety and related work is increasing.
events.importance_reason_en: A vendor-attributed quantitative report on AI self-acceleration, an important capability signal.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 说明从训练到部署的前沿 AI 风险管理
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发文说明其在训练到部署全程管理前沿 AI 风险的方法，涵盖模型对齐、沙箱、阻断式防护与监控。
key_points_zh: 文档覆盖模型对齐、沙箱、阻断式防护（blocking safeguards）与监控。
OpenAI 官方 X 同步分享该文档。
events.importance_reason_zh: 前沿安全框架的官方说明，反映头部厂商的安全实践。
events.title_en: OpenAI details frontier AI risk management from training to deployment
events.summary_en: OpenAI explained how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment, covering model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.
key_points_en: The writeup covers model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.
OpenAI's official account shared the document.
events.importance_reason_en: An official account of frontier safety practices at a leading lab.

events.title_zh: Tibo 推荐 Pro 200/500 用户尝试 GPT-6.2 Sol ultrafast
events.summary_zh: Tibo 称向 Pro 200/500 套餐用户推荐尝试 6.2 Sol ultrafast，表示体验"完全不同"，并称会继续把该速度档带给更多用户。
key_points_zh: 向 Pro 200/500 用户推荐 6.2 Sol ultrafast，称使用感受"完全是另一种感觉"。
表示会随时间推移把这类速度带给更多用户。
events.importance_reason_zh: 套餐速度档的第一手使用体验与扩展意向。
events.title_en: Tibo recommends GPT-6.2 Sol ultrafast for Pro 200/500 users
events.summary_en: Tibo recommends that users on Pro 200/500 try 6.2 Sol ultrafast, calling it "quite the blast" and a completely different feel, and says he is excited to keep bringing these speeds to more users over time.
key_points_en: He recommends 6.2 Sol ultrafast to Pro 200/500 users as a completely different feel.
He says he is excited to keep bringing these speeds to more users over time.
events.importance_reason_en: First-hand experience with and intent to expand a plan-tier speed option.

events.title_zh: Tibo 解释 6.2 Sol/Astra 上线日体验差异的原因
events.summary_zh: Tibo 解释上线日影响者与普通用户对 6.2 Sol/Astra 体验评价不同的原因：部分人提前获得访问权，而团队在过去 3-4 天做了大量改动且此后未见重新测试。
key_points_zh: 称部分影响者提前一段时间获得访问权。
称团队在过去 3-4 天做了大量改动。
称这些改动之后未见重新测试。
events.importance_reason_zh: 解释发布日评价分歧的原因，涉及模型迭代节奏的一手信息。
events.title_en: Tibo explains why early impressions of 6.2 Sol/Astra differed
events.summary_en: Tibo explains differing impressions between influencers and the wider crowd on launch day for 6.2 Sol/Astra: a few people had access a while ago, and the team made many changes in the last 3-4 days with no re-testing in that window, as far as he knows.
key_points_en: He says a few influencers got access a while ago.
He says the team made many changes in the last 3-4 days.
He says no re-testing was done within those days, as far as he is aware.
events.importance_reason_en: First-party context on why launch-day impressions diverged, touching release iteration cadence.

events.title_zh: Codex CLI 0.170.0 在 TUI 增加实时语音通话
events.summary_zh: Codex CLI 0.170.0 在终端界面新增基于 WebRTC 协商的实时语音通话，并带有多项实验功能与修复。
key_points_zh: TUI 支持基于 WebRTC 协商的 realtime 语音通话。
OpenTelemetry HTTP exporter 支持自动刷新认证头；实验支持跨环境同名 MCP 服务器。
超大 WebSocket 请求自动回退 HTTP 且不再多余重试；修复 MCP OAuth 凭据在取消、登录、登出时的竞态。
events.importance_reason_zh: 实时语音让终端内的智能体交互多出一条通道，是 Codex CLI 的显著功能扩展。
events.title_en: Codex CLI 0.170.0 adds realtime voice calls in the TUI
events.summary_en: Codex CLI 0.170.0 adds WebRTC-negotiated realtime voice calls in the terminal UI, plus experimental features and fixes.
key_points_en: The TUI supports realtime voice calls with WebRTC negotiation.
OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters gain automatically refreshed authentication headers; identical MCP server names across environments are supported experimentally.
Oversized WebSocket requests fall back to HTTP without unnecessary retries, and MCP OAuth credential races during cancellation, login, and logout are fixed.
events.importance_reason_en: Realtime voice adds a new interaction channel for agents in the terminal, a notable capability expansion for Codex CLI.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.3.2 修复 GPT-6.2 系统提示逐步骤重复计费
events.summary_zh: OpenCode v2.3.2 修复 GPT-6.2 模型的提示缓存问题：此前 Responses 路由中 instructions 字段的系统提示每一步都被按未缓存输入计费，OpenCode 现改为每步发送 leading developer message 使其从第二步起被缓存。
key_points_zh: GPT-6.2 模型的系统提示不再每步按未缓存输入计费；OpenCode 在所有 Responses 路由上改为发送 leading developer message。
覆盖 OpenAI（API key 与 ChatGPT 登录）、GitHub Copilot、Zen、Azure 与 OpenRouter 路由。
官方示例显示 GitHub Copilot gpt-6.2-sol 每步未缓存输入显著下降。
events.importance_reason_zh: 该修复直接降低使用 GPT-6.2 的每步成本，是影响费用的关键修复。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.3.2 fixes GPT-6.2 system prompt re-billing every step
events.summary_en: OpenCode v2.3.2 fixes GPT-6.2 prompt caching: the system prompt sent in the Responses instructions field was re-billed as uncached input on every step, and OpenCode now sends it as a leading developer message so it caches from the second step on.
key_points_en: GPT-6.2 models no longer re-bill the system prompt as uncached input on every step; OpenCode sends it as a leading developer message on every Responses route.
Routes covered include OpenAI (API key and ChatGPT sign-in), GitHub Copilot, Zen, Azure, and OpenRouter.
The release notes show a large drop in uncached input per step on GitHub Copilot gpt-6.2-sol.
events.importance_reason_en: The fix directly cuts per-step cost for GPT-6.2 users, a cost-critical repair.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 模型助力芯片设计：AMD GPU IP 功耗效率五个月提升 14%
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发文介绍其模型在芯片设计上的进展：模型优化了 Jalapeño 定制推理芯片的电路并改进 RISC-V 核心设计；官方 X 称与 AMD 合作中，模型在不到五个月里识别出旗舰 GPU IP 功耗效率 14% 的提升，成果建立在 AMD 工程师多年优化基础上。
key_points_zh: OpenAI 称其模型优化了 Jalapeño 首款定制推理芯片的电路，并改进 RISC-V 核心设计。
与 AMD 合作中，模型在不到五个月里识别出旗舰 GPU IP 功耗效率 14% 的提升；OpenAI 强调成果建立在 AMD 工程师多年优化之上。
官方称同样的方法也用于 Jalapeño，其性能提升已得到验证。
events.importance_reason_zh: 厂商性能与工程宣称（保留归属），显示模型进入芯片设计工作流。
events.title_en: OpenAI models advance chip design: 14% power-efficiency gain on AMD GPU IP in five months
events.summary_en: OpenAI described progress in AI-assisted chip design: its models optimized circuits in the Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC-V core designs; per OpenAI's account, models identified a 14% power-efficiency gain on AMD's flagship GPU IP in under five months, building on years of AMD engineering.
key_points_en: OpenAI says its models optimized circuits in Jalapeño, its first custom inference chip, and improved RISC-V core designs.
With AMD, OpenAI credits models with identifying a 14% power-efficiency gain on flagship GPU IP in under five months, noting the result builds on years of AMD engineering.
OpenAI says the same approach contributed to Jalapeño, whose performance gains are described as verified.
events.importance_reason_en: Vendor-attributed performance claims showing models entering chip design workflows.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 支持从 GitLab 安装技能、权限脚本应答与 MCP 组织单点登录
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 更新支持从 GitLab 安装 powers 与 skills、用脚本应答权限提示，并对组织 MCP 服务器单点登录；同版提供跨会话 Memory 等改进。
key_points_zh: 支持从 GitLab 安装 powers 与 skills。
权限提示可用脚本应答（Permission Request Hooks）。
组织 MCP 服务器一次登录；聊天可在侧栏与编辑器区之间移动，Memories 视图提供记忆设置。
events.importance_reason_zh: GitLab 支持与 MCP 组织登录扩展 Kiro 的平台兼容面。
events.title_en: Kiro IDE adds GitLab installs, scripted permission answers, and organization MCP sign-in
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE can now install powers and skills from GitLab, answer permission prompts with a script, and sign in once to organization MCP servers, alongside cross-session Memory improvements.
key_points_en: Powers and skills can be installed from GitLab.
Permission prompts can be answered by a script (Permission Request Hooks).
Organization MCP servers need one sign-in; chats move between the Side Bar and Editor Area, and the Memories view offers Memory settings.
events.importance_reason_en: GitLab support and organization MCP sign-in widen Kiro's platform compatibility.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 完成首次公开募股定价
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 IPO 定价为每股 83.00 美元，基础发行 9.8 亿股 Class A 普通股，其中 956,351,354 股由 Anthropic 出售。公告当时预计 11 月 19 日开始交易、11 月 20 日完成交割，并授予承销商 30 天内额外购买最多 1.47 亿股的期权。
key_points_zh: IPO 定价为每股 83.00 美元。
基础发行 9.8 亿股 Class A 普通股，其中 956,351,354 股由 Anthropic 出售。
23,648,646 股由现有股东出售，Anthropic 不收取这部分所得。
公告预计 11 月 19 日以 ANT 开始交易、11 月 20 日交割。
承销商拥有 30 天内额外购买最多 1.47 亿股的期权。
events.importance_reason_zh: 完整正文补足定价、基础发行股数、股东出售部分和预期时间表。
events.title_en: Anthropic prices its initial public offering
events.summary_en: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83.00 per share for a base offering of 980 million Class A common shares, including 956,351,354 shares sold by Anthropic. The announcement expected trading to begin on November 19 and closing on November 20, and granted underwriters a 30-day option to buy up to 147 million additional shares.
key_points_en: The IPO was priced at $83.00 per share.
The base offering was 980 million Class A common shares, including 956,351,354 sold by Anthropic.
Selling stockholders sold 23,648,646 shares, from which Anthropic received no proceeds.
The announcement expected trading as ANT on November 19 and closing on November 20.
Underwriters had a 30-day option to buy up to 147 million additional shares.
events.importance_reason_en: The full text adds the price, base share count, selling-stockholder portion and expected timetable.

corrections.reason_zh: 用完整公告替换“细节待补”的占位摘要，补录定价、股数和预期交易／交割时间。
corrections.reason_en: Replaced the placeholder summary with full offering price, share counts and expected trading/closing dates.

events.title_zh: Devin 加强私有会话与 MCP 访问提示
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 18 日更新让新会话可默认仅自己可见，并在扩大共享范围、使用共享插件或公开结果前显示谁会获得访问权限。组织附件跟随会话可见性，MCP 连接与安装界面也明确显示所用 Google 账号、个人或共享访问以及安装层级。
key_points_zh: 新会话可选择 Only you，设置中也可默认仅自己可见。
私有会话扩大共享范围或使用共享资源前会显示受影响人员并要求确认。
组织附件只能由可读取关联会话的人打开。
MCP 界面显示 Google 登录账号、Personal/Shared access 和安装层级。
Slack 无权限回复与 Teams 消息编辑等协作行为得到改进。
events.importance_reason_zh: 更新把共享副作用和身份权限前置到操作确认中，降低企业数据意外暴露风险。
events.title_en: Devin strengthens private-session and MCP access warnings
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 18 update lets new sessions default to Only you and warns who will gain access before widening sharing, using shared resources or publishing results. Organization attachments follow session visibility, while MCP screens identify the Google account, personal/shared access and installation scope.
key_points_en: New sessions can be Only you, including a default preference.
Private sessions confirm who will gain access before sharing widens or shared resources are used.
Organization attachments are readable only by people who can read an associated session.
MCP screens show the Google account, personal/shared access and installation scope.
Slack replies without session access and Teams message editing also improve.
events.importance_reason_en: The update surfaces sharing side effects and identity permissions before actions, reducing accidental enterprise-data exposure.

events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 上线 MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash
events.summary_zh: 微软在 GitHub Copilot 推出新一代 MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash 编码模型，官方称该家族从轻量编码辅助扩展到复杂智能体软件工程；Kilo 博客同步预告 MAI 编码模型即将接入 Kilo。
key_points_zh: MAI Code 2 面向通用编码，覆盖深度调试、多文件实现、重构与仓库级推理。
MAI Code 2 Flash 为轻量低成本模型，适合代码解释、定向编辑、常规修复与快速迭代。
两款模型均面向智能体编码工作流设计。
Kilo 宣布微软 MAI 编码模型即将进入 Kilo。
events.importance_reason_zh: 微软自研编码模型进入 Copilot 并扩散到第三方工具，改变供应商模型布局。
events.title_en: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash arrive in GitHub Copilot
events.summary_en: Microsoft shipped its next-generation MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash coding models in GitHub Copilot, expanding the family from lightweight assistance to complex agentic software engineering; Kilo also announced the MAI coding models are coming to Kilo.
key_points_en: MAI Code 2 is a general-purpose coding model for deep debugging, multi-file implementation, refactoring, and repository-wide reasoning.
MAI Code 2 Flash is a lightweight, cost-efficient model for code explanations, targeted edits, routine fixes, and rapid iteration.
Both models are designed for agentic coding workflows.
Kilo announced Microsoft's new MAI coding models are coming to Kilo.
events.importance_reason_en: Microsoft's in-house coding models landing in Copilot and third-party tools reshape the model supply for coding agents.

events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot Ignite 更新：应用支持 Azure DevOps，代码审查自适应深度，JetBrains 云沙箱
events.summary_zh: GitHub 在 Ignite 2026 期间发布多项 Copilot 更新：应用支持 Azure DevOps 仓库与已登录浏览器，代码审查引入自适应深度与暴露密钥检测，JetBrains 平台获得云沙箱、设备端语音听写与浏览器使用控制（GitHub Enterprise Server 应用支持此前已单独上线）。
key_points_zh: Copilot 应用支持 Azure DevOps 仓库，智能体可创建分支、改代码并开 PR；GitHub Enterprise Server 应用支持此前已于 11 月 13 日上线。
Copilot 代码审查（公开预览）按变更风险自适应审查深度，可引用相关仓库并在合入主干前标记暴露的密钥。
JetBrains 平台新增云沙箱（公开预览，GitHub 托管的隔离环境）、设备端语音听写与浏览器使用控制。
events.importance_reason_zh: Ignite 批量更新扩展 Copilot 的平台覆盖与审查能力，影响企业工作流接入。
events.title_en: GitHub Copilot Ignite updates: Azure DevOps in app, adaptive code review, JetBrains cloud sandbox
events.summary_en: GitHub shipped multiple Copilot updates around Ignite 2026: the app supports Azure DevOps repositories and your signed-in browser, code review gains adaptive depth and secret detection, and Copilot for JetBrains adds a cloud sandbox, on-device voice dictation, and browser use controls (GitHub Enterprise Server app support shipped separately on November 13).
key_points_en: The Copilot app works with Azure DevOps repositories, where an agent can create branches, change code, and open PRs; GitHub Enterprise Server app support shipped separately on November 13.
Copilot code review (public preview) matches review depth to each pull request, can draw on related repositories, and flags exposed secrets before they reach your main branch.
Copilot for JetBrains adds a cloud sandbox (public preview, a GitHub-hosted isolated environment), on-device voice dictation, and browser use controls.
events.importance_reason_en: The Ignite batch expands Copilot platform coverage and review capability, affecting enterprise workflow integration.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 GPT-6.2 Sol
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 GPT-6.2 Sol，官方介绍主打专业产出、编程、计算机操作与更低成本，覆盖 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 API；两款模型同步进入 GitHub Copilot，Codex 团队还将 GPT-6.2 Sol ultrafast 速度档扩展到 Pro 200 套餐。
key_points_zh: 两款模型面向智能体编程与代码审查，官方称在代码审查中捕获的真实问题显著多于此前 GPT-6 系列且 token 消耗更低。
GitHub 称 GPT-6.2 Sol 在代码审查中捕获的真实问题约为 GPT-6.1 Sol 的两倍，同时保持结论准确。
两款模型已在 GitHub Copilot 面向相关套餐开放，按供应商标价用量计费。
Codex 负责人 Tibo 称 Sol ultrafast 已扩展到 Pro 200 套餐，并表示这是其日常首选模型。
OpenAI 官方账号称 GPT-6.2 Astra 在专业工作与科研评测中创下新高，单任务成本低于 GPT-6 Astra 的三分之一。
events.importance_reason_zh: 双模型发布与套餐速度档扩展直接影响编码智能体的模型选择、代码审查质量与 token 成本。
events.title_en: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol
events.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, focused on professional outputs, coding, computer use, and lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API; both models are now in GitHub Copilot, and the Codex team extended the Sol ultrafast speed tier to Pro 200 plans.
key_points_en: Both models target agentic coding and code review; per official notes, they catch significantly more real issues than earlier GPT-6 models while using fewer tokens.
GitHub states GPT-6.2 Sol caught nearly twice as many real code review issues as GPT-6.1 Sol while keeping findings accurate.
Both models are generally available in GitHub Copilot for eligible plans, billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.
Codex lead Tibo said Sol ultrafast is now extended to Pro 200 plans and that it is his go-to model for daily work.
The official OpenAI account says GPT-6.2 Astra sets new highs on professional-work and scientific-research evals at less than a third of GPT-6 Astra cost per task.
events.importance_reason_en: The release and the plan-tier speed expansion directly affect model choice, code review quality, and token cost for coding agents.

events.title_zh: Kilo Desktop 正式版发布
events.summary_zh: Kilo Desktop 从测试转入正式可用（GA），官方称其为从想法到合并 PR 的最快路径，支持并行多智能体、跨仓库工作与逐个 diff 审查，并将 notebook 集成进同一应用。
key_points_zh: Kilo Desktop 结束测试正式可用。
支持同时运行多个智能体、跨多个仓库工作并逐个审查 diff。
集成 notebook 用于研究、数据科学与把结论转化为改进。
events.importance_reason_zh: Kilo Desktop 覆盖其桌面端产品的正式发布节点。
events.title_en: Kilo Desktop is generally available
events.summary_en: Kilo Desktop moved from beta to general availability, described by Kilo as the fastest path from idea to merged PR with several agents at once, work across repositories, and eyes on every diff, plus integrated notebooks for research and data science.
key_points_en: Kilo Desktop is now generally available after its beta period.
It supports running several agents at once, working across more than one repository, and reviewing each diff.
Notebooks are integrated for exploring datasets, testing hypotheses, and turning findings into better decisions.
events.importance_reason_en: This marks the general availability milestone for Kilo's desktop product.

events.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 宣布 Isomorphic Labs 获得 50 亿美元融资
events.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 宣布 Isomorphic Labs 获得 50 亿美元融资支持，以加速其利用 AI 从基础原理重新设计药物、应对“解决所有疾病”使命的研发。他同时提及 Greenoaks、Sequoia、Andreessen Horowitz 等新投资者及现有投资者；帖子未披露估值、资金用途拆分或具体临床时间表。
key_points_zh: Isomorphic Labs 获得 50 亿美元融资支持。
资金用于加速 AI 药物设计及“解决所有疾病”的研发使命。
Demis Hassabis 提及 Greenoaks、Sequoia、Andreessen Horowitz 等投资者。
现有材料未给出估值、资金分配、管线里程碑或临床结果。
events.importance_reason_zh: 大规模融资为 AI 原生药物研发提供资源信号，但研发目标和实际临床进展仍需区分。

key_points_en: Google describes Hydrogen as built specifically for robotics, emphasizing spatial and embodied reasoning.
The Antigravity Robotics plugin supports rapid hardware bring-up, MuJoCo simulation, and closed-loop control.
The google-genai SDKs have day-one support; Google says developers can go from an unboxed robot arm to a real-to-sim-to-real application in an afternoon with natural language prompts.

events.title_zh: Google 开源 ABFS，加速大型 Git 仓库构建

key_points_zh: ABFS、CASFS 和 Ninja-go 已开源，支持按需加载与共享构建缓存。
Android 17 AOSP 包含 1,084 个 Git 项目、约 162 万文件和约 300 GB 构建工作区。
官方基准报告检出约 36 分钟降至 8 秒以内、完整构建约 80 分钟降至约 2 分钟。
测试条件为 64 vCPU、256 GB 内存的 GCE n2d-standard-64，且 ABFS 服务端与客户端位于同一云网络。
支持单机并行挂载多个 Android 分支；Android 17 之前版本需要部分补丁。
events.importance_reason_zh: ABFS 直接针对 Agent 并行工作区的冷启动和重复构建成本，对大型代码库开发影响显著。
events.title_en: Google open-sources ABFS to accelerate massive Git repositories
events.summary_en: Google open-sourced Another Build File Service (ABFS), which uses the content-addressable CASFS to load source on demand and Ninja-go two-phase caching to reuse build outputs. In an Android 17 benchmark on a 64-vCPU, 256-GB GCE VM with the server in the same cloud network, Google reports checkout falling from about 36 minutes to under 8 seconds and a full build from about 80 minutes to just over 2 minutes.
key_points_en: ABFS, CASFS and Ninja-go are open source, providing on-demand loading and shared build caching.
Android 17 AOSP contains 1,084 Git projects, about 1.62 million files and a roughly 300-GB built workspace.
Official benchmarks report checkout falling from about 36 minutes to under 8 seconds and a full build from about 80 minutes to just over 2 minutes.
The test used a 64-vCPU, 256-GB GCE n2d-standard-64 VM with the ABFS server in the same cloud network.
Multiple Android branches can be mounted in parallel; releases before Android 17 require some patching.
events.importance_reason_en: ABFS directly targets cold-start and repeated-build costs for parallel Agent workspaces, with significant implications for large repositories.

events.summary_en: Google AI Studio uses Gemini 4 Carbon and Hydrogen to generate full-stack Kotlin Android apps with persistence, sign-in and AI features. The workflow provisions Cloud Firestore with Security Rules, Google Sign-In, Firebase AI Logic and App Check, and can publish to a personal Google Play library. HD emulators with audio, one-click screenshots, custom fonts and Android CLI integration are also rolling out.
key_points_en: AI Studio Build generates full-stack Kotlin Android apps and provisions Firestore, Google Sign-In and Security Rules.
Firebase AI Logic and App Check protect Gemini API calls without embedding API keys in the APK.
Apps can be built, signed and published to a personal Google Play library for phone installation.
Adds HD emulators with live audio, one-click screenshots for Agents, custom fonts and Android CLI integration.
Features are rolling out and require selecting Android in AI Studio Build.

events.title_zh: 袁进辉：推理算力供给远远不够，行业面临洗牌机会

key_points_zh: 2026 年推理首次超过训练成为算力消耗主体。
袁进辉判断当前算力供给远远不够。
训练算力有上界，推理 token 需求无理论上限；部分头部服务商单日处理超 100 万亿 token。
推理可分散部署、混合异构芯片，带来行业洗牌机会。
开源模型能力终将追平闭源，企业倾向基于开源构建自主智能。

events.title_en: Yuan Jinhui: inference compute supply falls far short, reshuffle ahead
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow founder and CEO Yuan Jinhui said at the November 12 Caixin Summit roundtable that in 2026 inference overtook training for the first time as the main consumer of compute, and current supply is "far from enough". He argued training compute has an upper bound (a full training run of the most advanced models is around 100 trillion tokens) while inference has no theoretical ceiling as calls continue, with some leading model providers already processing over 100 trillion tokens per day; inference can be deployed in distributed clusters mixing heterogeneous chips by workload, opening reshuffle opportunities for new players beyond the vendors that dominate training. He also expects open-source models to eventually match closed-source capability, with enterprises increasingly building autonomous, secure and controllable intelligence on open source. These are his personal views.
key_points_en: In 2026 inference overtook training as the main compute consumer for the first time.
Yuan Jinhui judges current compute supply far from enough.
Training compute has an upper bound; inference token demand has no theoretical ceiling, with some leaders processing over 100 trillion tokens daily.
Inference supports distributed deployment and heterogeneous chip mixing, creating reshuffle opportunities.
Open-source capability will eventually match closed source; enterprises lean toward building autonomous intelligence on open source.
events.importance_reason_en: A first-hand view on compute supply-demand and open-source trends from a leading AI Infra founder shapes industry expectations.

It adds direct deployment and lifecycle management for HTML artifacts, detects Python, Node.js, Java and Go runtimes in the Agent window, and expands browser previews to several iPhone profiles. The release also improves recovery after network or process failures and fixes /plan and SSH first-message issues.
key_points_en: The personal edition can drag one or more folders into the local project picker or editor while retaining workspace-trust confirmation and multi-root workspaces.
HTML artifacts support direct deployment with progress, resumable deployment, redeployment and site-detail management.
Agent Window detects Python, Node.js, Java and Go runtimes and guides installation or configuration. Browser preview adds iPhone 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max, 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max profiles.
Recovery after network or process failures improves, alongside fixes for lost /plan or @ references, preview restoration and the SSH first-message deletion flow.
events.importance_reason_en: The release changes project organization, frontend delivery, remote development and runtime setup while adding important session-continuity fixes.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 DGX Spark HPC 开发者套件：四节点桌面集群

合计 512GB 内存、20TB NVMe 存储。
NVFP4 下本地可部署最高 700B 参数模型，如 DeepSeek V4.1。
HPC SDK 安装手册即将推出。

events.title_en: NVIDIA introduces the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit: a four-node desk cluster
events.summary_en: At SC26 NVIDIA introduced the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit: four DGX Spark systems connected directly in a ring over ConnectX-7 with no network switch, providing 512GB of combined memory and 20TB of NVMe storage; with NVFP4, researchers can locally deploy models up to 700B parameters such as DeepSeek V4.1. An NVIDIA HPC SDK installation playbook is coming soon, letting multi-node scientific workloads, AI models and agents run at the desk while unpublished results and proprietary datasets stay on premises.
key_points_en: Four DGX Spark nodes ring-connected over ConnectX-7, no network switch needed.
512GB combined memory and 20TB NVMe storage.
With NVFP4, local deployment of models up to 700B parameters such as DeepSeek V4.1.
NVIDIA HPC SDK installation playbook coming soon.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.326 支持团队模式下的 Code Mode 并收紧沙箱权限
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.326 允许在启用 agent teams 时开启 Code Mode，已开启者的团队会话直接以 Code Mode 启动。未设置模式且组织策略未加载的终端与 VS Code 会话默认以 auto 模式启动，Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA 配置组织同样默认 auto，可用 disableAutoMode 关闭。沙箱与权限多处收紧：macOS、Linux、WSL 的沙箱命令默认不再写入部分敏感主目录，文件工具拒绝写入 .credentials.json 等登录文件，worktree 隔离的子代理拒绝可能改写共享分支的 git 命令，hook 的 block 决定在更多情况下生效。
key_points_zh: agent teams 启用时可开启 Code Mode，已开启者的团队会话以 Code Mode 启动。
未设置模式且组织策略未加载的会话默认 auto；HIPAA 配置组织默认 auto，可用 disableAutoMode 关闭。
沙箱命令在 macOS、Linux、WSL 默认不再写入部分敏感主目录，可用 sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite 放行。
文件工具拒绝写入 .credentials.json 等登录文件，部分 cp/mv 命令需先确认。
worktree 隔离的子代理拒绝可能改写共享分支的 git 命令；ExitWorktree 在后台任务仍运行时拒绝移除 worktree。
hook 的 "decision": "block" 在更多情况下生效；新增 OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST 与 VS Code claudeCode.promptSuggestions 设置。
events.importance_reason_zh: 默认权限与沙箱行为变化直接影响现有会话与自动化流程，团队模式与 Code Mode 的组合扩展了多代理用法。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.326 enables Code Mode with agent teams and tightens sandbox permissions
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.326 lets you turn on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode if it was already enabled. Terminal and VS Code sessions with no mode set start in auto mode when the organization policy has not loaded, and organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration also default to auto mode, which disableAutoMode turns off. Sandbox and permission behavior tightens in several places: sandboxed commands on macOS, Linux and WSL no longer write to some sensitive home folders by default, file tools refuse writes to sign-in files such as .credentials.json, subagents isolated in a worktree refuse git commands that can rewrite shared branches, and a hook's block decision holds in more cases.
key_points_en: Code Mode can be enabled with agent teams on; already-enabled setups start team sessions in Code Mode.
Sessions with no mode set default to auto when org policy has not loaded; HIPAA-configured orgs default to auto, disableAutoMode turns it off.
Sandboxed commands on macOS, Linux and WSL no longer write to some sensitive home folders by default; sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite can allow them.
File tools refuse writes to sign-in files such as .credentials.json; some cp and mv commands ask first.
Worktree-isolated subagents refuse git commands that can rewrite shared branches; ExitWorktree refuses removal while background work may still run.
A hook's "decision": "block" holds in more cases; adds OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST and the VS Code claudeCode.promptSuggestions setting.
events.importance_reason_en: Default permission and sandbox changes directly affect existing sessions and automation, while Code Mode with teams expands multi-agent usage.

key_points_zh: VS Code Agents 窗口新增 Inbox 模式，跨工作区优先显示需要注意的会话（实验性）。
Compare Models 开启后，代理可查找可用模型、发起对比并读取结果总结（实验性）。

events.title_en: Copilot weekly: VS Code session Inbox and model-comparison agents, minute-level app automations
events.summary_en: GitHub Copilot's November 9 weekly roundup brings several new features: the Agents window in VS Code 1.146 adds Inbox mode, surfacing sessions that need attention first across workspaces; with Compare Models enabled, agents can find available models, launch comparisons and summarize the results (experimental). The Copilot app can hand cloud and Codespace sessions to GitHub Mobile via QR code, re-sign-in to MCP servers inside the conversation, schedule Project automations down to the minute or with custom cron, and dictate in more languages after downloading the multilingual voice model. The roundup also recaps previously announced capabilities such as Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon and GHES repository access.
key_points_en: Inbox mode in the VS Code Agents window prioritizes sessions needing attention across workspaces (experimental).
With Compare Models enabled, agents can find models, run comparisons and read results to summarize findings (experimental).
The Copilot app hands cloud and Codespace sessions to GitHub Mobile via QR code.
MCP servers needing re-authentication can be connected in place without leaving the conversation.
Project automations support minute-level scheduling and custom cron such as weekdays at 9:30.
After downloading the multilingual voice model in settings, dictation works in French, Spanish and other languages.
events.importance_reason_en: Agent-driven session management and model comparison change multi-session workflows; app scheduling and mobile handoff broaden usage.

events.title_zh: Copilot 正式停用 Opus 4.8、Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Terra
events.summary_zh: 按 10 月 15 日预告，GitHub Copilot 自 2026 年 11 月 16 日起在大多数体验（Copilot Chat、内联编辑、ask 与 agent 模式、代码补全）中停用 Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Terra。年付个人订阅者仍可使用 Opus 4.8；Opus 5 从模型选择器移除，但经现有授权保留为运行时拒绝回退。官方建议替代为 Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 或 GPT-6 Luna；默认启用策略下，Business 与 Enterprise 客户自动启用替代模型，除非管理员关闭全局默认或显式禁用。
key_points_zh: 11 月 16 日起大多数 Copilot 体验停用 Opus 4.8、Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Terra。
年付个人订阅者仍可使用 Claude Opus 4.8。
Opus 5 移出模型选择器，仍作为运行时拒绝回退保留。
建议替代：Opus 4.8/5 换 Opus 5.5；GPT-5.6 Terra 换 GPT-6.1 Sol 或 GPT-6 Luna。
默认启用策略下 Business/Enterprise 自动启用替代模型，管理员关闭全局默认或显式禁用时除外。
events.importance_reason_zh: 模型下线直接影响现有工作流与集成，用户需按替代建议迁移。
events.title_en: Copilot deprecates Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra
events.summary_en: As announced on October 15, GitHub Copilot deprecated Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra across most experiences (Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, code completions) as of November 16, 2026. Claude Opus 4.8 remains available to individual subscribers on annual plans; Opus 5 is removed from the model picker but stays available for runtime refusal fallback through existing authorized access. Suggested alternatives are Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Luna; under default model enablement, alternatives are automatically enabled for Business and Enterprise customers unless an administrator turned off the global default or explicitly disabled the model.
key_points_en: Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra deprecated across most Copilot experiences as of November 16.
Claude Opus 4.8 remains available to individual subscribers on annual plans.
Opus 5 leaves the model picker but remains for runtime refusal fallback.
Suggested alternatives: Opus 4.8/5 to Opus 5.5; GPT-5.6 Terra to GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Luna.
Alternatives auto-enable for Business/Enterprise under default enablement unless admins turned off the global default or disabled the model.
events.importance_reason_en: Model retirement directly affects existing workflows and integrations; users need to migrate to the suggested alternatives.

events.title_zh: Copilot 企业可强制自定义项仅来自插件或托管设置
events.summary_zh: GitHub Copilot 新增托管设置 strictPluginOnlyCustomization，企业管理员可要求技能、自定义代理、hooks、MCP 服务器与可执行 Copilot 扩展这五类自定义项只能来自合规插件或托管设置，阻止用户与项目级独立配置，可按类别单独启用。该设置不是市场白名单，需与 strictKnownMarketplaces 等市场策略配合使用；适用于 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上由企业或其组织发放 Copilot Business/Enterprise 许可的成员。
key_points_zh: strictPluginOnlyCustomization 阻止用户与项目来源的独立自定义项。
覆盖技能、自定义代理、hooks、MCP 服务器、可执行 Copilot 扩展五类，可逐类选择。
合规插件与托管设置仍可用，受其他策略约束。
需与 strictKnownMarketplaces 配合限制市场来源；本身不是市场白名单。
适用于 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 的 Copilot Business/Enterprise 成员。
events.importance_reason_zh: 企业可在不整体禁用能力的前提下统一分发受批准的 MCP 工具与扩展，收紧配置管控。
events.title_en: Copilot enterprises can require customizations to come from plugins or managed settings
events.summary_en: GitHub Copilot adds the managed setting strictPluginOnlyCustomization, letting enterprise administrators require five customization categories — skills, custom agents, hooks, MCP servers and executable Copilot extensions — to come from eligible plugins or managed settings rather than standalone user or project configuration, with per-category selection. The setting is not a marketplace allowlist and pairs with marketplace policies such as strictKnownMarketplaces; it applies on GitHub Enterprise Cloud to members with Copilot Business or Enterprise licenses issued by the enterprise or one of its organizations.
key_points_en: strictPluginOnlyCustomization blocks standalone customizations from user and project sources.
Covers skills, custom agents, hooks, MCP servers and executable Copilot extensions, selectable per category.
Eligible plugins and managed settings remain allowed, subject to other policies.
Pairs with strictKnownMarketplaces to restrict marketplace sources; not itself a marketplace allowlist.
Applies to Copilot Business/Enterprise members on GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
events.importance_reason_en: Enterprises can distribute approved MCP tools and extensions through a shared plugin library without disabling the capabilities entirely.

events.title_zh: VS Code 弃用 Local harness，2027 年 2 月移除
events.summary_zh: VS Code 1.146 弃用协调 Copilot 代理会话的旧 Local harness，并将于 2027 年 2 月移除。替代的 Microsoft Copilot harness 已内置于 VS Code，自 1.143 起为新会话默认；它基于 Copilot SDK，与 Copilot CLI 和 Copilot 应用共享代理运行时，支持 Fusion 选模、协助权限、连接器（预览）与画布（预览），选择它不会把文件移到云端。三个月过渡期内 Local harness 在组织策略允许时仍可用，但新功能只投向 Copilot harness；切换不会自动转换自定义项，需在移除前检查兼容性。
key_points_zh: VS Code 1.146 弃用 Local harness，2027 年 2 月移除。
Copilot harness 自 1.143 起为新会话默认，与 CLI、应用共享代理运行时。
支持 Fusion 选模、协助权限、连接器与画布（后两者预览）。
现有 Copilot 套餐（含 Free）可继续使用；功能取决于套餐、设置与组织策略。
管理员可强制托管运行时权限与沙箱限制；选择 harness 本身不启用沙箱。
切换不自动转换自定义项，需在 2027 年 2 月前检查兼容性。
events.importance_reason_zh: 明确的移除时间表要求仍用 Local harness 的用户与管理员迁移并验证自定义项。
events.title_en: VS Code deprecates the Local harness, removal in February 2027
events.summary_en: VS Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness, the older software coordinating model, context and tools for Copilot agent sessions, and will remove it in February 2027. Its replacement, the Microsoft Copilot harness, is built into VS Code and has been the default for new sessions since 1.143; built on the Copilot SDK, it shares the coding-agent runtime with Copilot CLI and the Copilot app, supports Fusion model selection, assisted permissions, connectors (preview) and canvases (preview), and does not move files to the cloud. During the three-month transition the Local harness remains available where organization policy permits, but new features focus on the Copilot harness; switching does not automatically convert customizations, which need a compatibility review before removal.
key_points_en: VS Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness; removal in February 2027.
The Copilot harness has been default for new sessions since 1.143 and shares the agent runtime with CLI and the app.
Supports Fusion model selection, assisted permissions, connectors and canvases (the latter two in preview).
Existing Copilot plans, including Free, keep working; features depend on plan, settings and org policy.
Admins can enforce managed runtime permissions and sandbox restrictions; selecting the harness does not enable sandboxing.
Switching does not auto-convert customizations; review compatibility before February 2027.
events.importance_reason_en: A firm removal date requires users and admins still on the Local harness to migrate and validate customizations.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 向 20 万名科研人员免费开放前沿模型
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 扩展 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 计划，向全球 20 万名研究人员免费开放其前沿模型。公告摘要未说明申请方式与期限细节。
key_points_zh: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 计划扩展。
覆盖全球 200,000 名研究人员。
免费使用 OpenAI 前沿模型。
events.importance_reason_zh: 大规模免费科研访问改变学术用户的可用性与成本。
events.title_en: OpenAI expands free frontier-model access to 200,000 researchers
events.summary_en: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models. The announcement summary does not detail application steps or program duration.
key_points_en: Expansion of the ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program.
Covers 200,000 researchers worldwide.
Free access to OpenAI frontier models.
events.importance_reason_en: Large-scale free research access changes availability and cost for academic users.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出打击在线儿童性虐待的新工具与合作
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布新工具、实用指南与合作伙伴计划，用于预防、检测和应对在线儿童性剥削与虐待。公告摘要未列出具体工具名称与上线范围。
key_points_zh: 发布新工具、实用指南与合作计划。
目标：预防、检测、应对在线儿童性剥削与虐待。
摘要未列出具体工具与上线范围。
events.importance_reason_zh: 平台安全能力与行业协作的实质投入，影响内容治理生态。
events.title_en: OpenAI adds tools and partnerships against online child sexual abuse
events.summary_en: OpenAI announced new tools, practical guidance and partnerships to help prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse. The announcement summary does not name the specific tools or their rollout scope.
key_points_en: New tools, practical guidance and partnership plans.
Goal: prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse.
The summary does not list specific tools or rollout scope.
events.importance_reason_en: Substantive investment in platform safety capabilities and industry collaboration affects the content-governance ecosystem.

events.title_zh: Vera Rubin 首次 MLPerf 亮相：包揽 Training v6.1，代理推理能效提升逾 10 倍
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 称 Vera Rubin 平台在 MLPerf 首秀中包揽 Training v6.1 全部基准，是唯一在所有基准提交结果的平台；首次 MLPerf Endpoints 提交中，代理 AI 每瓦吞吐较上代提升超过 10 倍。Vera Rubin NVL72 每 GPU 性能最高达高度优化的 GB300 NVL72 的 2 倍。NVIDIA 表示性能将随 CUDA 软件栈持续优化而提升。以上为厂商宣称，结果来自 MLCommons 11 月 16 日公布的条目。
key_points_zh: 包揽 MLPerf Training v6.1 全部基准，唯一全项提交的平台。
首次 Endpoints 提交：代理 AI 每瓦吞吐代际提升超 10 倍。
Vera Rubin NVL72 每 GPU 性能最高为 GB300 NVL72 的 2 倍。
NVIDIA 称性能将随软件优化继续提升。
events.importance_reason_zh: 新一代平台的官方基准首秀，为训练与代理推理基础设施选型提供参考。
events.title_en: Vera Rubin debuts in MLPerf: sweeps Training v6.1, over 10x agentic efficiency gain
events.summary_en: NVIDIA says the Vera Rubin platform swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark in its debut and was the only platform with results on every benchmark; in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission it delivered more than 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI. Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 2x more performance per GPU than the highly optimized GB300 NVL72. NVIDIA says performance will keep climbing through CUDA software-stack optimization. These are vendor claims, based on results released by MLCommons on November 16.
key_points_en: Swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark; the only platform with results on all benchmarks.
First Endpoints submission: over 10x generational throughput-per-watt gain for agentic AI.
Vera Rubin NVL72 up to 2x performance per GPU versus GB300 NVL72.
NVIDIA says performance will keep improving with software optimization.
events.importance_reason_en: The next-generation platform's official benchmark debut informs training and agentic-inference infrastructure choices.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Rubin HPC GPU：面向科学与工程代理的仿真加速
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在 SC26 宣布 Vera Rubin 平台新成员 Rubin HPC GPU，面向科学、工程与分析工作流的仿真与数据处理。单 GPU CUDA 核心数超过 50,000，创纪录；配备稀疏数据加速能力与第七代 NVLink 互连。NVIDIA 称其将加速代理用于验证想法的仿真，缩短从探索到科学发现与工业设计的路径。
key_points_zh: Rubin HPC 属于 Vera Rubin 平台，面向仿真与数据处理。
单 GPU CUDA 核心超 50,000，创纪录。
稀疏数据加速与第七代 NVLink 互连。
定位：加速科学/工程代理的仿真循环。
events.importance_reason_zh: 面向 AI 代理科研负载的专用 GPU，扩展 Vera Rubin 平台产品线。
events.title_en: NVIDIA announces Rubin HPC, a GPU for science and engineering agents
events.summary_en: At SC26 NVIDIA announced Rubin HPC, a new GPU in the Vera Rubin platform designed to accelerate simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics workflows. It features a record number of CUDA cores — more than 50,000 on a single GPU — sparse data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink interconnect. NVIDIA says it will accelerate the simulations agents use to test ideas, shortening the path from exploration to scientific discovery and industrial design.
key_points_en: Rubin HPC joins the Vera Rubin platform, targeting simulation and data processing.
Record CUDA core count: more than 50,000 on a single GPU.
Sparse data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink.
Positioned to accelerate the simulation loop of science/engineering agents.
events.importance_reason_en: A dedicated GPU for AI-agent scientific workloads extends the Vera Rubin platform lineup.

events.title_zh: Qwen 发布 Qwen4-Max：2.4T 稀疏 MoE，主打长程任务与专业交付
events.summary_zh: 阿里 Qwen 团队发布 Qwen4-Max，称其为可全天候协作的 AI “新同事”。模型采用 Qwen4 系列新架构，拥有 2.4 万亿主干参数、每 token 激活 71B，另有 328B N-gram Embedding 参数，支持原生视觉与 100 万 token 上下文。官方称 Work360 行业基准得分为 52.69，高于 Qwen3.8-Max 的 47.74；相较上一代全面下调 API 价格，Work360 单个任务平均费用从 26.58 元降至 11.16 元，降幅 58%。文章页显示日期为 8 月 3 日，但订阅源给出的发布时间为 2026-11-16，本事件采用订阅源时间。
key_points_zh: 2.4T 主干参数，每 token 激活 71B，另有 328B N-gram Embedding 参数。
原生视觉能力，支持 100 万 token 上下文。
Work360 得分 52.69，上一代 Qwen3.8-Max 为 47.74。
全面下调 API 价格，Work360 单任务平均成本下降 58%。
同步开源 Qwen-Live-Delivery-Plugin，支持长程任务分阶段交付。
events.importance_reason_zh: 旗舰模型换代同时改变架构、上下文长度与 API 价格，专业工作流的选型和成本测算都需要重做。
events.title_en: Qwen releases Qwen4-Max: a 2.4T sparse MoE built for long-running professional work
events.summary_en: Alibaba’s Qwen team released Qwen4-Max, pitched as an always-on AI “new colleague.” It uses a new Qwen4-series architecture with a 2.4-trillion-parameter backbone, 71B parameters activated per token and another 328B of N-gram embedding parameters, plus native vision and a 1M-token context. Qwen reports a Work360 industry benchmark score of 52.69 versus 47.74 for Qwen3.8-Max, and says API prices fell across the board, cutting the average Work360 task cost from 26.58 yuan to 11.16 yuan, a 58% drop. The article page shows August 3, but the feed dates the post to November 16, 2026; this event follows the feed date.
key_points_en: 2.4T-parameter backbone with 71B activated per token and 328B of N-gram embedding parameters.
Native vision and a 1M-token context window.
Work360 score of 52.69, up from 47.74 for Qwen3.8-Max.
API prices cut across the board, with average Work360 task cost down 58%.
The Qwen-Live-Delivery-Plugin is open-sourced for staged long-running delivery.
events.importance_reason_en: A flagship refresh changes the architecture, context window and API prices at once, so teams must redo model selection and cost planning.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 启动嵌入式评估：外部机构独立评测对齐与 safeguards
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布嵌入式评估（embedded assessments）第一阶段，与 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce 和 Goodfire 合作，独立评估模型对齐、safeguards 与监控系统。公告摘要未给出评估时间表与结果发布方式。
key_points_zh: 嵌入式评估进入第一阶段。
合作方：Apollo Research、METR、Transluce、Goodfire。
独立评估模型对齐、safeguards 与监控系统。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把外部评估嵌入模型开发流程，改变安全评测的独立性与深度。
events.title_en: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with external evaluators
events.summary_en: OpenAI begins the first phase of embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards and monitoring systems. The announcement summary does not give an assessment timeline or how results will be published.
key_points_en: First phase of embedded assessments underway.
Partners: Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire.
Independent evaluation of model alignment, safeguards and monitoring systems.
events.importance_reason_en: Embedding external evaluation into model development changes the independence and depth of safety assessments.

events.title_zh: ChatGPT for Healthcare 引入计算机操作代理与医疗插件
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 扩展 ChatGPT for Healthcare：引入计算机操作（computer-use）代理、改进临床回答，并新增可在医疗软件间完成实际工作的医疗插件。官方同日发布面向医疗团队的 computer-use 代理专文；公告摘要未披露具体软件集成与可用范围。
key_points_zh: 引入 computer-use 代理。
临床回答能力改进。
新增跨医疗软件完成实际工作的医疗插件。
同日发布面向医疗团队的 computer-use 代理专文。
events.importance_reason_zh: 医疗场景从问答走向跨软件操作，是垂直行业代理的重要落地。
events.title_en: ChatGPT for Healthcare adds computer-use agents and healthcare plugins
events.summary_en: OpenAI expands ChatGPT for Healthcare with computer-use agents, improved clinical answers and new healthcare plugins that work across healthcare software to get real work done. A companion article on advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams was published the same day; the announcement summaries do not disclose specific software integrations or availability scope.
key_points_en: Introduces computer-use agents.
Improved clinical answers.
New healthcare plugins that work across healthcare software.
Companion article on computer-use agents for healthcare teams published the same day.
events.importance_reason_en: Healthcare use moves from question-answering to cross-software operation, a significant vertical-agent deployment.

events.title_zh: OpenRouter 为 Hugging Face Inference Providers 提供路由
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face Inference Providers 上的聊天模型现经 OpenRouter 路由运行；OpenRouter 还可把 traces 发送到 Hugging Face Storage Bucket。公告摘要未说明计费与可用模型范围。
key_points_zh: HF Inference Providers 聊天模型改经 OpenRouter 路由。
OpenRouter traces 可写入 Hugging Face Storage Bucket。
摘要未说明计费与模型范围。
events.importance_reason_zh: 两大平台打通推理路由与数据链路，影响 Hugging Face 用户的模型访问方式。
events.title_en: OpenRouter now powers inference on Hugging Face
events.summary_en: Chat models on Hugging Face Inference Providers now run through OpenRouter's routing, and OpenRouter can send traces to a Hugging Face Storage Bucket. The announcement summary does not detail pricing or the available model scope.
key_points_en: HF Inference Providers chat models now route through OpenRouter.
OpenRouter traces can be sent to a Hugging Face Storage Bucket.
The summary does not detail pricing or model scope.
events.importance_reason_en: Connecting the two platforms' inference routing and data paths changes model access for Hugging Face users.

events.title_zh: Google 在 TPU 上实现训练-推理零位差，稳定 on-policy RL
events.summary_zh: Google 介绍如何在 64 片 Cloud TPU v5p 上消除 on-policy LLM 强化学习中训练与推理的对数概率浮点漂移，实现 bitwise-zero 的训练-推理一致性，并给出基于 JAX 与 Pallas、可在 Tunix 中复用的四部分通用配方。
key_points_zh: 消除 on-policy RL 的训练-推理 logprob 浮点漂移。
在 64 片 Cloud TPU v5p 上验证。
四部分 JAX/Pallas 配方，已在 Tunix 中提供。
events.importance_reason_zh: 训练-推理不一致是 RL 稳定性的核心难题，零位差配方直接影响后训练质量。
events.title_en: Google achieves bitwise-zero train-inference mismatch for on-policy RL on TPU
events.summary_en: Google describes how it eliminated floating-point train-inference logprob drift for on-policy LLM reinforcement learning across 64 Cloud TPU v5p chips, achieving bitwise-zero train-inference consistency, and provides a generalizable four-part JAX and Pallas recipe available in Tunix.
key_points_en: Eliminates train-inference logprob floating-point drift for on-policy RL.
Validated across 64 Cloud TPU v5p chips.
A four-part JAX/Pallas recipe provided in Tunix.
events.importance_reason_en: Train-inference mismatch is a core RL stability problem; a bitwise-zero recipe directly affects post-training quality.

sources.url: https://docs.siliconflow.cn/docs/release-notes/overview#功能更新动态限流上线限流值随模型负载自动调整

events.title_zh: 硅基流动上线动态限流：按模型负载自动调整配额
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动上线按模型分批开启的动态限流。启用模型的固定限流阈值被取消，系统根据实时负载放宽或收紧限流，把闲置资源优先供给真实业务请求；模型广场可筛选已启用模型，模型详情页的 Rate Limits 板块展示实时限流值与规则。启用动态限流的模型不再沿用 L0–L5 用量等级分层限流，对应已发放且未过期的等级权益自动失效；暂未接入的模型保持原有限流逻辑。
key_points_zh: 动态限流按模型分批开启，替换固定阈值。
