系统根据实时负载自动放宽或收紧限流。
模型详情页 Rate Limits 板块可查看实时限流值与规则。
启用模型的 L0–L5 用量等级权益自动失效。
未接入动态限流的模型继续按用量等级执行。
events.importance_reason_zh: 配额从固定等级改为随负载浮动，直接影响 API 容量规划与已购等级权益的价值判断。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow launches load-based dynamic rate limits
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow introduced dynamic rate limiting, enabled model by model in batches. For participating models, fixed thresholds are replaced by limits that widen or tighten with real-time load so idle capacity goes to live business traffic; the model catalog can filter for enabled models, and each model’s Rate Limits panel shows the current limit and rules. Participating models no longer use the L0–L5 usage-tier limits, so issued and unexpired tier entitlements for those models lapse automatically. Models not yet covered keep the existing logic.
key_points_en: Dynamic limits roll out model by model and replace fixed thresholds.
Limits widen or tighten automatically with real-time load.
The model detail page shows current limits and rules under Rate Limits.
L0–L5 usage-tier entitlements lapse for participating models.
Models without dynamic limits keep tier-based limits.
events.importance_reason_en: Quotas now float with load instead of following fixed tiers, changing API capacity planning and the value of purchased tier entitlements.

events.title_zh: Kiro Web 支持在会话工作区内运行终端
events.summary_zh: Kiro Web 新增终端：可在会话工作区内直接运行命令，终端可置于对话旁边或下方，用于运行构建与测试、查看输出或手动尝试命令。
key_points_zh: Kiro Web 会话工作区内可运行命令。
终端可放在对话旁边或下方。
支持构建、测试与手动命令。
events.importance_reason_zh: Web 端补齐本地执行能力，减少在 IDE 与浏览器间切换。
events.title_en: Kiro Web adds a terminal in the session workspace
events.summary_en: Kiro Web now lets you run commands in your session's workspace: open a terminal beside the conversation or below it to run builds and tests, check output, or try a command yourself.
key_points_en: Run commands inside the Kiro Web session workspace.
Terminal can sit beside or below the conversation.
Supports builds, tests and manual commands.
events.importance_reason_en: Adds local execution to the web experience, reducing switching between IDE and browser.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI 3.4 新增可改写工具输入与应答权限提示的 Hook
events.summary_zh: Kiro CLI 3.4 新增 hook：可在工具调用运行前改写其输入，或代答权限提示，让脚本把团队规则应用到 V3 会话的每次工具调用，而不必逐次人工批准。同时提供四个 /memories 选项，在更多位置恢复与列出云会话，并修复 headless、上下文窗口、MCP、搜索、/tangent、/rewind 与显示问题。
key_points_zh: Hook 可在工具运行前改写其输入。
Hook 可代答权限提示，按团队规则自动处理 V3 会话工具调用。
新增四个 /memories 选项。
更多位置支持恢复与列出云会话。
修复 headless、上下文窗口、MCP、搜索、/tangent、/rewind 与显示问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 权限审批可编程化，直接改变团队级代理治理与无人值守流程。
events.title_en: Kiro CLI 3.4 adds hooks that rewrite tool inputs and answer permission prompts
events.summary_en: Kiro CLI 3.4 adds hooks that rewrite a tool call's inputs before it runs or answer its permission prompt, so a script can apply team rules to every tool call in V3 sessions instead of waiting for manual approval. It also offers four /memories choices, resumes and lists cloud sessions in more places, and fixes headless, context window, MCP, search, /tangent, /rewind and display issues.
key_points_en: Hooks can rewrite a tool call's inputs before it runs.
Hooks can answer permission prompts, applying team rules to every V3 tool call.
Adds four /memories choices.
Cloud sessions can be resumed and listed in more places.
Fixes headless, context window, MCP, search, /tangent, /rewind and display issues.
events.importance_reason_en: Programmable permission approval changes team-level agent governance and unattended workflows.

events.title_zh: Kiro 企业版支持实时遥测事件与私有连接
events.summary_zh: Kiro 企业管理员可将每次 LLM 请求与完成的工具调用作为实时 OpenTelemetry 事件流式发送到可观测性工具，或使用每日 CSV 报告与 OpenTelemetry 指标核对趋势；可跟踪 credits、模型、对话、响应时间、工具结果、客户端版本与代理模式。实时事件与私有连接目前适用于 US East（北弗吉尼亚）与 Europe（法兰克福）区域的 Kiro profile。
key_points_zh: 每次 LLM 请求与完成的工具调用可实时流式输出为 OTel 事件。
提供每日 CSV 报告与 OpenTelemetry 指标。
跟踪 credits、模型、对话、响应时间、工具结果、客户端版本、代理模式。
实时事件与私有连接限于 US East（北弗吉尼亚）与 Europe（法兰克福）。
events.importance_reason_zh: 企业获得细粒度代理审计与成本观测能力，区域限制需纳入部署规划。
events.title_en: Kiro Enterprise adds real-time telemetry events and private connectivity
events.summary_en: Kiro Enterprise administrators can stream each LLM request and completed tool call as a real-time OpenTelemetry event to their observability tools, or use daily CSV reports and OpenTelemetry metrics for reconciled trends, tracking credits, models, conversations, response times, tool outcomes, client versions and agent modes. Real-time events and private connectivity are available for Kiro profiles in US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Frankfurt).
key_points_en: Each LLM request and completed tool call can stream as a real-time OTel event.
Daily CSV reports and OpenTelemetry metrics are available.
Tracks credits, models, conversations, response times, tool outcomes, client versions and agent modes.
Real-time events and private connectivity are limited to US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Frankfurt).
events.importance_reason_en: Enterprises gain fine-grained agent auditing and cost observability; region limits factor into deployment planning.

events.title_zh: Qoder 0.5.13 修复子代理配置阻断会话与压缩恢复问题
events.summary_zh: Qoder 0.5.13 集中修复日常使用问题：部分子代理的无效模型设置或配置不再阻止主对话启动或继续；频繁切换任务、后台通知爆发或会话内容加载失败后任务无法打开的问题得到修复；部分模型的上下文超限错误可被正确识别并通过压缩恢复；切换模型或更改上下文窗口后用量计算不再沿用旧设置；压缩对话分叉或恢复到指定消息时的错误消息链接被修复；部分用户收不到活动权益领取通知的问题也已修复。
key_points_zh: 子代理无效模型配置不再阻断主对话启动或继续。
修复频繁切换任务等场景下任务无法打开。
上下文超限错误可正确识别并经压缩恢复。
切换模型/上下文窗口后用量计算使用新设置。
修复压缩对话分叉或恢复时的消息链接。
修复部分用户收不到活动权益领取通知。
events.importance_reason_zh: 多处阻断性缺陷修复，直接恢复会话可用性与压缩恢复路径。
events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.13 fixes subagent config blocking sessions and compaction recovery
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.13 focuses on everyday fixes: invalid model settings in some subagents no longer prevent the main conversation from starting or continuing; tasks failing to open after frequent task switching, bursts of background notifications or content-load failures are fixed; context-limit errors from some models are now recognized correctly so compaction recovery works; context usage calculations no longer retain outdated settings after switching models or changing the context window; incorrect links between retained messages when forking or restoring a compacted conversation are fixed; and some users not receiving campaign-benefit notifications is fixed.
key_points_en: Invalid subagent model settings no longer block the main conversation.
Fixes tasks failing to open after frequent switching and similar scenarios.
Context-limit errors are recognized correctly and recover through compaction.
Context usage uses current settings after model or context-window changes.
Fixes message links when forking or restoring compacted conversations.
Fixes missing campaign-benefit claim notifications for some users.
events.importance_reason_en: Several blocking defects are fixed, restoring session usability and the compaction recovery path.

events.title_zh: Devin 更新：跨服务身份簿、Mark done 与安全发现导出
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 16 日更新引入 Phonebook：为成员维护跨 Devin、Slack、Microsoft Teams、git 服务商、Jira、Linear 与 Pylon 的关联身份，在 Devin 中提及某人会同时在 Slack 中标记本人。侧边栏显示已订阅会话，Mark done 取代 Archive，把会话移入 Done 文件夹但保持运行，不影响其他订阅者。云会话输入框输入 # 可选择 Slack 频道，分享时可导入 Slack 联系人；Security Findings 支持 CSV 导出，Security > Configure 更名 Customize，可按 profile 管理扫描路径、包含/排除规则与威胁模型适用仓库。旧 Slack 线程中提及 Devin 会新开会话而非失败，!ultrafast 成为 !fastultra 的别名。
key_points_zh: Phonebook 关联成员跨服务身份，Devin 提及同步标记 Slack。
Mark done 取代 Archive：会话移入 Done 但继续运行。
云会话输入 # 选择 Slack 频道；分享时可导入 Slack 联系人。
Security Findings 支持 CSV 导出；Configure 更名 Customize。
企业知识管理员可维护迁移的技能；Customize 新增 Skills 层级页。
旧 Slack 线程提及 Devin 改为新开会话；!ultrafast 作为 !fastultra 别名。
events.importance_reason_zh: 跨服务身份与协作流程改进影响团队日常使用，安全导出与策略管理增强企业能力。
events.title_en: Devin update: cross-service phonebook, Mark done and security findings export
events.summary_en: Devin's November 16 update introduces Phonebook, keeping each member's linked identities across Devin, Slack, Microsoft Teams, git providers, Jira, Linear and Pylon; a mention in Devin now tags the person in Devin and Slack at the same time. The sidebar shows subscribed sessions, and Mark done replaces Archive, moving a session to the Done folder while it keeps running for other subscribers. Typing # in a cloud session composer picks a Slack channel, and the Share dialog can import Slack contacts; Security Findings can be exported to CSV, Security > Configure is renamed Customize with per-profile scan paths, include/exclude globs and threat-model repository scope. Tagging Devin in an old Slack thread starts a new session instead of failing, and !ultrafast is accepted as an alias of !fastultra.
key_points_en: Phonebook links member identities across services; Devin mentions also tag the person in Slack.
Mark done replaces Archive: sessions move to Done but keep running.
Type # in cloud composers to pick Slack channels; Share can import Slack contacts.
Security Findings export to CSV; Configure renamed Customize.
Enterprise Knowledge managers can maintain migrated skills; Customize adds a Skills layers page.
Tagging Devin in old Slack threads starts a new session; !ultrafast aliases !fastultra.
events.importance_reason_en: Cross-service identity and collaboration changes affect daily team use; security export and policy management strengthen enterprise capabilities.

events.title_zh: DeepTutor 1.7.3 改进 PDF 阅读、书籍编辑与搜索接入
events.summary_zh: DeepTutor 发布 1.7.3，PDF 阅读器增加连续缩放、文本适配和图片查看器；书籍编辑支持先审阅 diff 再应用结构改动，并可撤销最近一次未改动编辑。搜索新增 DeepSeek、SpecStream 与 SearchApi（含网页、新闻、学术模式），Web Fetch 可选 DeepSeek 后端，配置好的 ACP 进程可作为本地子代理。该版本还改进推理强度选择、Docling 结构化解析、模型流恢复与桌面升级回滚。
key_points_zh: PDF 阅读器增加连续缩放、文本适配与图片查看器。
书籍结构改动先展示可审阅 diff，再应用并可撤销。
搜索新增 DeepSeek、SpecStream 与 SearchApi。
Web Fetch 可选 DeepSeek 后端，ACP 进程可作为本地子代理。
改进 Docling 解析、模型流恢复与桌面升级回滚。
events.importance_reason_zh: 阅读、编辑与检索多条学习链路同时增强，并接入更多模型与搜索后端，适合需要本地知识工作流的用户升级。
events.title_en: DeepTutor 1.7.3 improves PDF reading, book editing and search integrations
events.summary_en: DeepTutor 1.7.3 adds continuous zoom, text-fit controls and an image viewer to its PDF reader. Book editing now shows a reviewable diff before structural changes are applied and can undo the most recent unchanged edit. Search adds DeepSeek, SpecStream and SearchApi, including web, news and scholar modes; Web Fetch gains a selectable DeepSeek backend, and a configured ACP process can act as a local subagent. The release also improves reasoning-effort selection, Docling structured parsing, model-stream recovery and desktop upgrade rollback.
key_points_en: Continuous zoom, text-fit controls and an image viewer in the PDF reader.
Book structure changes show a reviewable diff and can be undone.
Search adds DeepSeek, SpecStream and SearchApi.
Web Fetch offers a DeepSeek backend, and ACP processes can serve as local subagents.
Improves Docling parsing, model-stream recovery and desktop upgrade rollback.
events.importance_reason_en: Reading, editing and retrieval all improve at once, with more model and search backends for local knowledge workflows.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动加入广东词元交易平台并介绍 AI 网关运营能力
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动公告称，公司参与全国首个省级词元交易平台“湾数·元启”的发布与聚合服务商入驻签约。其 AI 智能网关提供多模型统一代理、六种协同路由策略、租户／项目／成员治理、调用链观测与计量计费，并可与异构算力纳管、推理框架和 MaaS 平台组合。
key_points_zh: “湾数·元启”于 11 月 11 日在广州发布，硅基流动参与聚合服务商入驻签约。
AI 网关支持多模型统一代理、API 统一管理和六种协同智能路由策略。
网关提供租户、项目、成员层级治理，以及模型性能、调用链和计量计费能力。
联合运营主张先用外部模型供给验证交付、计费与回款，再按真实需求建设自建产能。
events.importance_reason_zh: 省级 Token 交易平台和可计量网关为算力资源转向 Token 服务运营提供了具体落地路径。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow joins Guangdong Token platform and details AI gateway operations
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow says it participated in the launch of “Bay Data · Yuanqi,” described as China’s first provincial Token trading platform, and signed on as an aggregation service provider. Its AI gateway offers unified multi-model proxying, six coordinated routing strategies, tenant/project/member governance, trace observability and metering, and can be combined with heterogeneous compute management, inference engines and MaaS platforms.
key_points_en: Bay Data · Yuanqi launched in Guangzhou on November 11, with SiliconFlow joining the aggregation-provider signup.
The AI gateway provides unified multi-model proxying, API management and six coordinated routing strategies.
It offers tenant, project and member governance plus model-performance, trace and metering/billing visibility.
The joint-operation approach validates delivery, billing and collection with external model supply before building dedicated capacity around real demand.
events.importance_reason_en: The provincial Token platform and metered gateway provide a concrete path for converting compute resources into operable Token services.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.325 收紧沙箱 Bash 与技能运行权限
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.325 默认让沙箱内的 Bash 命令走常规权限流程，需设置 sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true 才继续免提示；沙箱拒绝写入外部目录中的 .claude 设置、技能、代理、命令与 Hook；定时任务与 /loop 运行声明 allowed-tools 或 hooks 的技能前需要确认。VS Code 增加提示建议与不生成 API Key 的控制台登录。
key_points_zh: 沙箱内 Bash 默认走常规权限流程。
外部目录中的 .claude 配置、技能与 Hook 拒绝写入。
运行带 allowed-tools 或 hooks 的技能前需确认。
events.importance_reason_zh: 免提示范围收窄会改变既有无人值守流程的行为，升级前需要补充显式允许规则。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.325 tightens sandbox Bash and skill permissions
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.325 makes sandboxed Bash commands follow the normal permission flow by default; sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true restores prompt-free runs. The sandbox now refuses writes to .claude settings, skills, agents, commands and hooks in added directories, and scheduled tasks or /loop ask before running a skill that declares allowed-tools or hooks. VS Code gains prompt suggestions and a console sign-in that creates no API key.
key_points_en: Sandboxed Bash now follows the normal permission flow by default.
Writes to .claude config, skills and hooks in added directories are refused.
Skills declaring allowed-tools or hooks need confirmation before unattended runs.
events.importance_reason_en: Narrower prompt-free scope changes existing unattended flows, so explicit allow rules are needed before upgrading.

events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 将于 12 月 14 日下线六款模型
events.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布 2026 年 12 月 14 日在所有 Copilot 体验（含聊天、内联编辑、ask 与 agent 模式、代码补全）下线 Claude Fable 5、Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 4 Argon、Grok 4.6 与 Kimi K3，并给出替代模型，Kimi K3 的替代尚未公布。Claude Haiku 4.5 对年度订阅的个人用户继续可用；企业管理员需确认替代模型已启用。
key_points_zh: 六款模型统一在 2026 年 12 月 14 日下线。
替代方案为 Fable 5.2、Haiku 5.5、Gemini 4 Hydrogen、Gemini 4 Carbon 与 Grok 4.7。
Kimi K3 的替代模型尚未公布。
Claude Haiku 4.5 对年度订阅个人用户保留。
events.importance_reason_zh: 固定的下线日期要求团队在 12 月中旬前完成模型与工作流迁移，并检查企业策略是否自动启用替代模型。
events.title_en: GitHub Copilot will retire six models on December 14
events.summary_en: GitHub will retire Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6 and Kimi K3 across all Copilot experiences, including chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes and code completions, on December 14, 2026. It names successor models except for Kimi K3. Claude Haiku 4.5 stays available to individual subscribers on annual plans, and enterprise administrators must confirm that the successors are enabled.
key_points_en: All six models retire on December 14, 2026.
Suggested successors are Fable 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon and Grok 4.7.
No successor is announced for Kimi K3.
Claude Haiku 4.5 remains for individual annual subscribers.
events.importance_reason_en: A fixed retirement date forces teams to migrate models and workflows before mid-December and to check whether enterprise policies auto-enable the successors.

events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 应用正式支持 GitHub Enterprise Server
events.summary_zh: GitHub Copilot 应用的 GHES 支持结束预览转为正式可用：用户可添加 GHES 账号以处理远程仓库、议题与拉取请求，需先登录 GitHub.com 或 GHE.com。该功能要求应用 1.2.0 及以上版本，GHES 不支持云会话。
key_points_zh: GHES 支持由预览转为正式可用。
需先登录 GitHub.com 或 GHE.com 账号。
要求 1.2.0 及以上版本，且不支持云会话。
events.importance_reason_zh: 自托管 GitHub 的企业可以统一在 Copilot 应用内工作，但云会话仍不可用，需保留本地执行路径。
events.title_en: GitHub Copilot app supports GitHub Enterprise Server
events.summary_en: GitHub Enterprise Server support in the GitHub Copilot app moved from an opt-in preview to general availability: users can add a GHES account to work with remote repositories, issues and pull requests after signing in with a GitHub.com or GHE.com account. It requires app version 1.2.0 or later, and cloud sessions are not available for GHES.
key_points_en: GHES support moved from preview to general availability.
Requires a GitHub.com or GHE.com sign-in first.
Needs app 1.2.0+; cloud sessions are unavailable for GHES.
events.importance_reason_en: Enterprises on self-hosted GitHub can consolidate work in the Copilot app, but without cloud sessions they still need a local execution path.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code 2.6.2 增加自定义搜索地址并修复长会话加载
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code 2.6.1 与 2.6.2 修复长会话重新打开时的数秒加载延迟，以及工具结果含注记、错误或耗时头时以空回复卡住的压缩问题。2.6.2 允许自定义注册表（api.json）提供方配置 search_url 与 feedback_url，供 WebSearch 与 /feedback 使用，并停止接受纯文本 /feedback 提交。
key_points_zh: 修复长会话重开时的数秒加载延迟。
修复含注记的工具结果导致压缩失效、回复为空。
自定义注册表可配置 search_url 与 feedback_url。
events.importance_reason_zh: 长会话卡死直接影响日常使用，自定义搜索地址则让私有部署可以接入自有检索服务。
events.title_en: Kimi Code 2.6.2 adds custom search URLs and fixes long-session loading
events.summary_en: Kimi Code 2.6.1 and 2.6.2 fix multi-second loading delays when reopening long sessions and a stall where sessions with tool result notes, errors or timing headers returned empty replies instead of compacting. 2.6.2 also lets custom registry (api.json) providers set search_url and feedback_url for WebSearch and /feedback, and stops accepting text-only /feedback submissions.
key_points_en: Long sessions no longer take seconds to reopen.
Tool result notes no longer break compaction into empty replies.
Custom registries can set search_url and feedback_url.
events.importance_reason_en: Session stalls hit daily use, and custom search URLs let private deployments point at their own retrieval service.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，让智能体在批准后付款
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，让 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 dots 中的智能体在用户批准后完成购买，并沿用现有银行卡保护。官方摘要未说明支持地区、单笔限额或可用商户范围。
key_points_zh: 覆盖 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 dots 中的智能体。
每笔付款需要用户批准。
沿用现有卡片保护机制。
未公布地区、限额与商户范围。
events.importance_reason_zh: 代理从给出建议走向完成交易，支付授权与风控边界会成为企业采用时的核心考量。
events.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases with user approval
events.summary_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections. The summary does not name supported regions, per-purchase limits or which merchants work.
key_points_en: Covers agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots.
Every purchase requires user approval.
Existing card protections still apply.
Regions, limits and merchant coverage were not disclosed.
events.importance_reason_en: Agents moving from advice to completed transactions makes authorization and fraud boundaries the central adoption question.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Daybreak Red Team 与 Daybreak Defense Factory
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Codex Security 生态发布 Daybreak Red Team 与 Daybreak Defense Factory（视频标题级证据；Daybreak Red 此前已上线 AWS GovCloud）。
key_points_zh: 官方视频介绍 Daybreak Red Team 与 Daybreak Defense Factory 两个新组件。
Daybreak Red 此前已宣布在 AWS GovCloud（美国东部）上线，本条为其扩展组件。
events.importance_reason_zh: Codex Security 产品线扩展，面向漏洞研究与防御工厂场景。
events.title_en: OpenAI introduces Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory in the Codex Security ecosystem (title-level video evidence; Daybreak Red previously shipped on AWS GovCloud).
key_points_en: Official video introduces the new Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory components.
Daybreak Red previously shipped on AWS GovCloud (US East); this entry covers its expanded components.
events.importance_reason_en: An expansion of the Codex Security product line toward vulnerability research and defense factory scenarios.

events.title_zh: Kilo 的 Sign in with ChatGPT 支持 Business 套餐
events.summary_zh: Kilo by Anaconda 的 Sign in with ChatGPT 现支持 ChatGPT Business 套餐，团队可在 Kilo Desktop、IDE 扩展、Cloud Agents 与 CLI 中直接使用已有 ChatGPT 额度，无需管理单独的 API Key。此前该功能已支持 Plus 与 Pro 账户。
key_points_zh: 支持 ChatGPT Business 套餐登录。
覆盖 Desktop、IDE 扩展、Cloud Agents 与 CLI。
沿用已有 ChatGPT 额度，无需单独 API Key。
events.importance_reason_zh: 组织级订阅接入减少了团队分发 API Key 的运维与安全负担。
events.title_en: Kilo's Sign in with ChatGPT supports Business plans
events.summary_en: Sign in with ChatGPT in Kilo by Anaconda now supports ChatGPT Business plans, so teams can use existing ChatGPT allowances in Kilo Desktop, IDE extensions, Cloud Agents and the CLI without separate API keys. The feature previously supported Plus and Pro accounts.
key_points_en: Supports signing in with ChatGPT Business plans.
Works in Desktop, IDE extensions, Cloud Agents and the CLI.
Uses existing ChatGPT allowances instead of separate API keys.
events.importance_reason_en: Organization-level subscription access reduces the operational and security burden of distributing API keys.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.111 用正则配置企业权限规则
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.111 为企业托管的 Shell、Bash 与 PowerShell 权限规则加入正则表达式支持，并新增 --host-allow-session-creation，让远程客户端在一次启动中创建会话而不改动已保存设置；同时修复 MCP OAuth 重复重连、取消授权后仍显示 needs-auth 等问题。
key_points_zh: 企业托管权限规则支持正则表达式。
--host-allow-session-creation 仅对本次启动生效。
修复 MCP OAuth 重复重连与授权取消后的状态。
events.importance_reason_zh: 正则规则让企业能用少量策略覆盖大量命令，但也要求更谨慎的规则审查。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.111 adds regex enterprise permission rules
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.111 adds regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash and PowerShell permission rules, and adds --host-allow-session-creation so remote clients can create sessions for one launch without changing saved settings. It also fixes duplicate MCP OAuth reconnects and servers staying in needs-auth after a canceled authorization.
key_points_en: Regex support in enterprise-managed permission rules.
--host-allow-session-creation applies only to the current launch.
Fixes duplicate MCP OAuth reconnects and post-cancel auth state.
events.importance_reason_en: Regex rules let enterprises cover many commands with few policies, but raise the stakes on rule review.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.3.0 让子代理默认在后台运行
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 2.3.0 让子代理始终在后台运行，立即返回会话 ID 并在空闲时向父会话汇报，父会话可继续工作的同时并发运行多个子代理；TUI 默认把连续工具调用与思考折叠为一行活动记录，可通过 session.verbosity 恢复。还增加实验性 MCP 事件、shell 超时转后台、Windows 本地命令走 process daemon 与提供方双向 TLS 客户端证书。
key_points_zh: 子代理默认后台运行并立即返回会话 ID。
TUI 默认折叠工具调用与思考为活动行。
新增实验性 MCP 事件与 shell 超时转后台开关。
events.importance_reason_zh: 并发子代理成为默认行为，改变了长任务的等待方式，也提高了并行会话的资源占用。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.3.0 runs subagents in the background by default
events.summary_en: OpenCode 2.3.0 makes subagents always run in the background: they return a session ID immediately, report back when idle, and several can run while the parent session keeps working. The TUI now folds each run of tool calls and thoughts into one activity row by default, restorable through session.verbosity. It also adds experimental MCP events, a flag to move timed-out shell commands to the background, Windows local commands through the process daemon, and mutual-TLS client certificates for providers.
key_points_en: Subagents run in the background and return their session ID immediately.
The TUI folds tool calls and thoughts into one activity row by default.
Experimental MCP events and a shell-timeout background flag.
events.importance_reason_en: Background subagents by default change how long tasks are awaited and raise the resource cost of parallel sessions.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.169.0 支持多侧聊标签、旧任务搜索与终端自定义提供方
events.summary_zh: Codex 0.169.0 的终端工作区支持多个侧聊标签，可在键盘或鼠标间切换，并在重启后恢复已保存的本地侧聊。Agent 命令中心可按名称、提示预览或工作目录搜索旧任务；全屏记录可折叠每轮已完成活动，同时保留答案与工具输出搜索。终端内可新增或编辑自定义模型提供方，并支持 SSH 或无浏览器环境的设备码登录；未信任目录默认禁用项目配置与 MCP。
key_points_zh: 终端工作区支持多个侧聊标签，重启后可恢复。
可按名称、提示预览或工作目录搜索旧任务。
全屏记录可折叠每轮已完成活动。
终端内可新增或编辑自定义模型提供方，支持设备码登录。
未信任目录默认禁用项目配置与 MCP，需显式 --trust。
events.importance_reason_zh: 多侧聊与旧任务检索改善了长会话管理，自定义提供方和设备码登录则扩大了可用模型与远程环境范围。
events.title_en: Codex 0.169.0 adds multiple side-chat tabs, older-task search and terminal provider setup
events.summary_en: The Codex 0.169.0 terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs, switchable by keyboard or mouse and restored after restart. The agent command center can search older tasks by name, prompt preview or working directory, and the full-screen transcript can collapse completed activity while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. Custom model providers can be added or edited from the terminal, with device-code sign-in for SSH or browserless environments. Untrusted directories keep project configuration and MCP disabled by default.
key_points_en: Multiple side-chat tabs in the terminal workspace, restored after restart.
Search older tasks by name, prompt preview or working directory.
Collapse completed activity in the full-screen transcript.
Add or edit custom providers in the terminal, with device-code sign-in.
Untrusted directories disable project config and MCP by default; use --trust explicitly.
events.importance_reason_en: Multiple side chats and older-task search improve long-session management, while custom providers and device-code login widen model and remote-environment options.

events.title_zh: MiMo Code 0.1.17 取消按模型名推断参数
events.summary_zh: MiMo Code 0.1.17 移除按模型名推断行为的策略：上下文与输出上限、推理档位改从 models.dev 与用户配置读取，默认不再发送 temperature/top_p；GPT 模型不再自动切换到 Codex 风格提示词与工具集（可用 MIMOCODE_CODEX_MODE=true 开启），内置联网搜索改为通过 MIMOCODE_ENABLE_EXA=1 启用。另支持小米 API Key 与 Token Plan Key 同时登录，记忆检索支持中文子串。
key_points_zh: 上下文、输出上限与推理档位改由 models.dev 与配置决定。
默认不再发送 temperature 与 top_p。
Codex 模式与内置搜索都改为显式开启。
events.importance_reason_zh: 默认行为整体收窄，现有工作流若依赖自动推断的档位或搜索，需要在配置中显式补回。
events.title_en: MiMo Code 0.1.17 stops inferring settings from model names
events.summary_en: MiMo Code 0.1.17 removes model-name heuristics: context and output limits and reasoning levels now come from models.dev and user config, and temperature/top_p are no longer sent by default. GPT models no longer switch to a Codex-style prompt and toolset automatically (set MIMOCODE_CODEX_MODE=true to opt in), and built-in web search is now opt-in via MIMOCODE_ENABLE_EXA=1. Xiaomi API and Token Plan keys can be signed in together, and memory search recalls Chinese substrings.
key_points_en: Limits and reasoning levels come from models.dev and config.
temperature and top_p are no longer sent by default.
Codex mode and built-in search are now explicit opt-ins.
events.importance_reason_en: Defaults narrow overall, so workflows relying on inferred levels or search must set them explicitly.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2 rc 增加工作树审阅与 AgentTeam
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.2 与 rc.3 新增按分支、提交和文件类型审阅 Git worktree 改动并直接处理 GitHub 评审、子代理具名与多层协作（AgentTeam 可按会话开启）、桌面端切换正式版/开发版更新渠道；rc.3 增加实验性 DeepSeek 会话导入插件，并修复 Windows 桌面版应用内更新失败后无法自动重开的问题。
key_points_zh: Git worktree 支持按分支、提交与文件类型审阅改动。
AgentTeam 按会话开启多层子代理协作。
rc.3 增加实验性 DeepSeek 会话导入插件。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把评审流程与多层子代理纳入桌面客户端，候选版行为仍可能变化，适合先在小范围试点。
events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2 release candidates add worktree review and AgentTeam
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.2 and rc.3 add reviewing Git worktree changes by branch, commit and file type with direct handling of GitHub reviews, named multilayer subagents with AgentTeam enabled per session, and a desktop switch between stable and development update channels. rc.3 adds an experimental DeepSeek chat import plugin and fixes Windows desktop in-app updates that failed and left the app unable to reopen.
key_points_en: Git worktree changes can be reviewed by branch, commit and file type.
AgentTeam enables multilayer subagent collaboration per session.
rc.3 adds an experimental DeepSeek chat import plugin.
events.importance_reason_en: Bringing review and multilayer subagents into the desktop client is promising, but release-candidate behavior can still change, so pilots should stay small.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.168.0 增加模型提供方浏览、侧边会话与音频附件
events.summary_zh: Codex 0.168.0 可在 Sessions → Model providers 浏览模型提供方，并为新会话选择默认项；启用 tui_workspace 后可在主对话旁打开可调整大小的侧边会话。该版本支持为音频模型附加录音、生成或编辑带帧数与时长控制的 GIF，并新增 osc777 终端通知。修复项包括按登录账户过滤本地历史、旧会话沿用已保存的模型提供方，以及工具调用打断后的 Markdown 渲染与推理摘要恢复。
key_points_zh: 可在 Sessions → Model providers 浏览提供方并设置新会话默认项。
tui_workspace 支持主对话旁的侧边会话与缩放。
音频模型可附加录音，并支持生成或编辑 GIF。
新增 osc777 终端通知方式。
修复本地历史账户隔离与旧会话提供方沿用问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 模型提供方管理与侧边会话改变了多模型、多任务并行的日常用法，账户隔离修复也关系到本地历史隐私。
events.title_en: Codex 0.168.0 adds model-provider browsing, side conversations and audio attachments
events.summary_en: Codex 0.168.0 lets users browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and pick a default for new chats; enabling tui_workspace opens a resizable side conversation beside the main chat. The release supports attaching recordings for audio-capable models, generating or editing GIFs with frame-count and timing controls, and osc777 terminal notifications. Fixes cover scoping local history to the signed-in account, keeping saved providers for existing chats, and restoring Markdown rendering and reasoning summaries after tool-interrupted turns.
key_points_en: Browse providers under Sessions → Model providers and set the default for new chats.
tui_workspace enables a resizable side conversation.
Audio-capable models accept recordings, and GIFs can be generated or edited.
Adds osc777 terminal notifications.
Fixes local-history account scoping and provider retention for existing chats.
events.importance_reason_en: Provider management and side conversations change multi-model, multi-task workflows, while account scoping affects local-history privacy.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.323 试验让 Claude 用 JavaScript 调用工具
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.323 引入实验性 Code Mode：由 Claude 编写 JavaScript 调用工具，需手动开启，也可按组织关闭。插件新增 engines["claude-code"] 版本范围，安装时选择符合范围的最新版本；claude plugin validate 增加 TypeScript Hook 类型检查与 $ 名词校验；长时 Hook 每 30 秒发送一次进度心跳。
key_points_zh: Code Mode 让 Claude 写 JavaScript 调用工具，需手动开启。
插件可声明兼容的 Claude Code 版本范围。
plugin validate 检查 TypeScript Hook 与 $ 名词。
events.importance_reason_zh: 工具调用改由代码编排，可能减少往返轮次，但也把插件与 Hook 的兼容性检查推到发布前。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.323 experiments with Claude writing JavaScript to call tools
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.323 adds experimental Code Mode, in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools. It is opt-in and can be disabled for an organization. Plugins can declare an engines["claude-code"] version range, and install or update picks the newest version that fits. claude plugin validate now type-checks a plugin's TypeScript hooks module and validates the $ nouns a mod adds, and long-running hooks send a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds.
key_points_en: Code Mode lets Claude write JavaScript to call tools, opt-in only.
Plugins can declare a compatible Claude Code version range.
plugin validate checks TypeScript hooks and $ nouns.
events.importance_reason_en: Orchestrating tools from code can cut round trips, but pushes plugin and hook compatibility checks earlier into publishing.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek 开放完整应用 API：搜索、文件、URL 读取与语音能力
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 将 App 中的联网搜索、文件输入、URL 读取、语音交互与安全能力开放给开发者，deepseek-flash 在 Messages、Responses 和 Chat Completions API 中支持对应参数。搜索分为关闭思考的普通联网搜索与开启思考的多步深度搜索；文件输入支持 PDF、Office 文件和图片；URL 读取会自动抓取消息中的链接。底层能力还以独立的 Search/Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS API 提供，官方同时开源了可导入历史记录的演示客户端。
key_points_zh: deepseek-flash 在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions API 中开放应用能力。
联网搜索分普通搜索与多步深度思考搜索，支持引用。
文件输入支持 PDF、Office 文件与图片，URL 读取可自动抓取链接。
Search/Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS 作为独立 API 提供。
开源可导入 DeepSeek 聊天历史的演示客户端。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把消费端 App 的检索、文件与语音能力一次性开放为 API，能显著缩短聊天类应用的搭建周期。
events.title_en: DeepSeek opens its full app capability set as APIs
events.summary_en: DeepSeek opened the web search, file input, URL reading, voice interaction and safety capabilities behind its app to developers. deepseek-flash supports the corresponding parameters across the Messages, Responses and Chat Completions APIs. Search runs either as ordinary web search with thinking off or as multi-step deep-thinking search with thinking on; file input accepts PDFs, Office files and images; URL reading fetches links found in the message. The underlying capabilities are also available as standalone Search/Fetch, OCR, ASR and TTS APIs, and DeepSeek open-sourced a demo client that can import chat history.
key_points_en: deepseek-flash exposes app capabilities across the Messages, Responses and Chat Completions APIs.
Web search comes in ordinary and multi-step deep-thinking modes, with citations.
File input covers PDFs, Office files and images; URL reading fetches links automatically.
Search/Fetch, OCR, ASR and TTS are available as standalone APIs.
An open-source demo client can import DeepSeek chat history.
events.importance_reason_en: Opening the consumer app’s retrieval, file and voice capabilities as APIs shortens the path to building chat-style applications.

events.title_zh: ZCode 3.18.2 增加语音输入、Worktree 与设计检查
events.summary_zh: ZCode 发布 3.18.2，输入框支持实时语音转文字，新增 Worktree 并行任务开发、设计系统检查、日语/俄语/韩语界面与会话管理工具。内置浏览器支持点选页面元素并直接编辑保存、设备尺寸预设及 PNG/PDF 导出；分享可设置有效期并新增管理页。该版本还修复了工作流脚本逃逸沙箱的安全问题，以及安装更新、登录、本地化和内置浏览器键盘输入等问题。
key_points_zh: 输入框支持实时语音输入。
新增 Worktree 并行任务开发与设计系统检查。
内置浏览器可点选元素编辑保存，支持设备预设与 PNG/PDF 导出。
新增日语、俄语、韩语界面。
修复工作流脚本可逃逸沙箱的安全问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 并行任务、设计检查和浏览器内编辑集中在一次更新，同时修补沙箱逃逸漏洞，现有用户需要尽快升级。
events.title_en: ZCode 3.18.2 adds voice input, Worktree and design checks
events.summary_en: ZCode 3.18.2 adds real-time speech-to-text in the input box, Worktree-based parallel task development, design-system checks, Japanese/Russian/Korean interfaces and a session management tool. The built-in browser can select page elements for direct editing and saving, offers device-size presets and exports pages as PNG or PDF; shares can now expire and have a management page. The release also fixes a security issue where workflow scripts could escape the sandbox, along with update installation, login, localization and browser keyboard-input problems.
key_points_en: Real-time voice input in the composer.
Worktree parallel development and design-system checks.
Built-in browser element selection, editing, device presets and PNG/PDF export.
Japanese, Russian and Korean interfaces.
Fixes a sandbox escape in workflow scripts.
events.importance_reason_en: Parallel tasks, design checks and in-browser editing land together with a sandbox-escape fix, so existing users should upgrade promptly.

events.title_zh: Qoder 0.5.11 增加下一步建议、自定义 UI 插件与 Issue 协作
events.summary_zh: Qoder 0.5.11 在输入框空闲且为空时主动给出下一步建议，按 Tab 或右方向键即可插入。该版本新增自定义 UI 插件、Issue 评论/回复/附件与 Agent 指派，以及 Kiro 任务、记忆、Skills、MCP 配置和 Powers 导入。还改进 IM 插件管理、云自动化资源选择、网页上下文引用、知识库增量更新、SOCKS5 代理，并支持 SSH 会话从本机发送文件。
key_points_zh: 输入框空闲时给出下一步建议，Tab 或右方向键插入。
可用 plugin-creator 构建带自定义界面的 UI 插件。
Issue 支持评论、回复、附件、Agent 指派与执行记录。
支持从 Kiro 导入任务、记忆、Skills、MCP 与 Powers。
新增 SOCKS5 代理与 SSH 本机文件发送。
events.importance_reason_zh: 协作与插件能力扩展让 Qoder 从单人编码工具走向团队工作流，迁移用户也获得 Kiro 导入路径。
events.title_en: Qoder 0.5.11 adds next-step suggestions, custom UI plugins and issue collaboration
events.summary_en: Qoder 0.5.11 proactively suggests next steps when the composer is idle and empty; Tab or the right arrow inserts a suggestion. The release adds custom UI plugins, issue comments, replies, attachments and agent assignment, plus imports for Kiro tasks, memory, Skills, MCP configurations and Powers. It also improves IM plugin management, cloud automation resource selection, browser context references, incremental knowledge updates and SOCKS5 proxying, and lets SSH sessions send files from the local machine.
key_points_en: Next-step suggestions appear when the composer is idle and empty; Tab or right arrow inserts one.
The plugin-creator skill builds plugins with custom interfaces.
Issues support comments, replies, attachments, agent assignment and execution records.
Imports tasks, memory, Skills, MCP configurations and Powers from Kiro.
Adds SOCKS5 proxy support and local file sending over SSH.
events.importance_reason_en: Collaboration and plugin additions move Qoder from a single-user coding tool toward team workflows, and Kiro users get a migration path.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动说明 API 交互数据不留存及调试边界
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动在两篇同日文章中称，API 提示词和输出只在当次推理所需期间处理，未获授权时不做持久化存储，推理完成后从计算节点销毁或不可恢复；模型名称、Token 消耗、请求时间和状态码等元数据会保存。平台同时提醒，不留存交互数据会限制内容问题排查，用户需授权并提供复现数据；另有本地部署方案。
key_points_zh: 未获授权时，API 输入提示词与输出不作持久化存储；授权存储时会加密。
网关不保存提示词，KV Cache 与中间状态仅在 GPU 显存流转，推理结束后释放。
模型名称、Token 消耗量、请求时间、状态码等运维与计费元数据会持久化。
无交互数据留存时只能按元数据排查性能或异常；输入错误、输出不符需用户提供 trace_id、时间及复现输入和输出。
本地部署可将交互数据保留在企业内网。
events.importance_reason_zh: 披露 API 数据生命周期、元数据范围及不留存带来的调试限制，关系企业数据治理与安全评估。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow details API interaction-data retention and troubleshooting limits
events.summary_en: In two same-day articles, SiliconFlow says API prompts and outputs are processed only as needed for an inference request and are not persistently stored without authorization; after inference they are destroyed or unrecoverable on compute nodes. Metadata such as model name, Token usage, request time and status code is retained. The platform warns that retaining no interaction data limits content troubleshooting, so users may need to authorize storage and provide reproduction data; local deployment is also available.
key_points_en: Without authorization, API input prompts and outputs are not persistently stored; authorized storage is encrypted.
Gateways do not retain prompts, and KV cache and intermediate states remain in GPU memory and are released after inference.
Operational and billing metadata such as model name, Token usage, request time and status code is retained.
Without retained interaction data, troubleshooting relies on metadata for performance or errors; input or output problems require users to provide a trace_id, time and reproduction input and output.
Local deployment can keep interaction data inside the enterprise intranet.
events.importance_reason_en: The articles disclose the API data lifecycle, metadata scope and troubleshooting trade-offs of not retaining interactions, which matter for enterprise data-governance and security assessments.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动说明 Token 服务数据留存与私有部署边界
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动表示，模型名称、Token 消耗、请求时间和状态码等运维计费元数据会持久化；提示词和输出等交互数据未经授权不会持久化，也不用于预训练、微调或其他商业用途。故障排查可能需要用户主动提供 trace_id 和复现数据；本地部署可让交互数据留在企业内网。
key_points_zh: 运维与计费元数据会持久化，用于计费、安全审计和服务改进。
交互数据未经授权不会持久化，也不用于预训练、微调或其他商业用途；授权存储时会加密。
请求结束后交互数据从计算节点和网关释放；内容相关排错需用户授权并提供复现输入输出。
本地部署支持把推理引擎和算力编排系统放入企业数据中心，交互数据不离开内网。
events.importance_reason_zh: 明确元数据、交互数据和私有部署的处理边界，有助于企业做数据合规与供应商评估。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow details Token-service data retention and private deployment
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow says operational and billing metadata such as model name, Token usage, request time and status code are persisted. Prompts and outputs are not persisted without authorization or used for pretraining, fine-tuning or other commercial purposes, and authorized storage is encrypted. Content-related debugging may require user-provided traces and reproduction data; local deployment keeps interactions inside the enterprise network.
key_points_en: Operational and billing metadata are persisted for billing, security audits and service improvement.
Interaction data is not persisted without authorization or used for pretraining, fine-tuning or other commercial purposes; authorized storage is encrypted.
Interaction data is released from compute nodes and gateways after requests, while content debugging requires authorized reproduction inputs and outputs.
Local deployment places inference engines and compute orchestration in the enterprise data center so interactions remain on the internal network.
events.importance_reason_en: Clear boundaries for metadata, interaction data and private deployment support enterprise compliance and vendor assessment.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.110 可在屏蔽对话框中回答密码提示
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.110 实验性支持在屏蔽对话框中回答代理命令触发的 git、ssh 与 sudo 密码提示（需 /experimental on）；为屏幕阅读器补充当前会话与空闲状态播报；/mcp add 或 /mcp edit 遇到无效配置时保留原有配置并报错，/rewind 不再把后续轮次已恢复的文件计为已恢复。
key_points_zh: 实验性支持在屏蔽对话框回答 git、ssh、sudo 密码提示。
屏幕阅读器可识别当前会话与需要关注的会话。
无效 MCP 配置不再覆盖已有配置。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把密码提示纳入代理流程会扩大自动化范围，同时把凭据暴露面集中到一个受控对话框。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.110 answers password prompts in a masked dialog
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.110 experimentally answers git, ssh and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog, enabled with /experimental on. Screen readers now identify the current session and announce sessions that need attention or are idle. /mcp add or /mcp edit keeps the existing configuration when the file is invalid, and /rewind stops counting files that later turns already restored.
key_points_en: Experimental masked dialog for git, ssh and sudo password prompts.
Screen readers announce the current session and attention states.
Invalid MCP configuration no longer overwrites the existing one.
events.importance_reason_en: Bringing password prompts into the agent flow widens automation while concentrating credential exposure in one controlled dialog.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，主打智能体编程
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen。GitHub 同日说明称这是 Google 最新的 Flash 模型，面向快速、高效的智能体编程、工具调用与多步工作流，指令遵循能力较 Gemini 3.8 Flash 有所提升。该模型当天在 GitHub Copilot 面向 Pro、Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 用户开放，按供应商标价计费；Google Antigravity 也发布了题为“Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator”的公告。
key_points_zh: GitHub 称其为 Google 最新 Flash 模型，面向智能体编程、工具调用与多步工作流。
指令遵循优于 Gemini 3.8 Flash。
Copilot 面向 Pro、Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 开放，按用量计费。
Antigravity 同日发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 与 Orchestrator 公告。
events.importance_reason_zh: Flash 档位更新直接影响高频代理与工具调用任务的成本，Copilot 也把它列为 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的替代模型。
events.title_en: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its latest Flash model
events.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen. In its same-day post, GitHub describes it as Google's latest Flash model, designed for fast, efficient agentic coding, tool use and multistep workflows, with improved instruction following over Gemini 3.8 Flash. It became generally available in GitHub Copilot that day for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users, billed at provider list pricing, and Google Antigravity published a post titled "Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator".
key_points_en: GitHub calls it Google's latest Flash model, aimed at agentic coding, tool use and multistep workflows.
Improved instruction following over Gemini 3.8 Flash.
Available in Copilot to Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise under usage-based billing.
Antigravity published a same-day Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator post.
events.importance_reason_en: A Flash-tier update changes the cost of high-volume agent and tool-calling work, and Copilot names it the replacement for Gemini 3.8 Flash.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code 2.6.0 折叠工具调用并调整服务端接口
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code 2.6.0 在全新界面中把连续工具调用与思考折叠为摘要行，可在 /settings 或 tui.toml 中选择折叠粒度；活动栏显示当前轮次与上一轮耗时；服务端 API 会话创建时携带代理配置、模型与思考等级，prompts 不再接受 profile。破坏性变更包括移除 transcript 相关 WebSocket 帧与 GET /sessions/{id}/transcript 端点。
key_points_zh: 连续工具调用与思考折叠为摘要行，可选粒度。
活动栏显示当前轮次与上一轮耗时。
服务端 API 改用 turns 帧，移除 transcript 端点。
events.importance_reason_zh: 服务端接口移除旧 transcript 帧与端点，自建客户端的集成需要按新帧格式改造。
events.title_en: Kimi Code 2.6.0 folds tool calls and reshapes server APIs
events.summary_en: Kimi Code 2.6.0 folds consecutive tool calls and thinking into summary lines in the fullscreen UI, with folding density configurable in /settings or tui.toml. The activity bar shows how long the current turn has run and how long the last turn took. Server API sessions now carry their agent profile, model and thinking level at creation, and prompts no longer accept profile. Breaking changes remove the transcript WebSocket frames and the GET /sessions/{id}/transcript endpoints.
key_points_en: Consecutive tool calls and thinking fold into summary lines with configurable density.
The activity bar shows current and previous turn durations.
Server APIs now stream turns frames; transcript endpoints are gone.
events.importance_reason_en: Removing the old transcript frames and endpoints means self-built clients must migrate to the new frame format.

events.title_zh: Google 介绍 Agent Anomaly Detection：在五个公开基准上捕获 87% 有害指令
events.summary_zh: Google 开发者博客介绍 Agent Anomaly Detection（AAD），它通过分析 OpenTelemetry 轨迹与日志，异步、低延迟地标记 AI Agent 的目标劫持和工具误用。官方称在五个并非自建的公开安全基准上，AAD 捕获了 87% 由 Agent 实际执行的有害指令，且不增加运行时延迟。开发者可将 AAD 与语义治理、严格工具权限一起使用，作为纵深防御的一部分。
key_points_zh: 分析 OpenTelemetry 轨迹与日志，异步标记目标劫持和工具误用。
在五个公开安全基准上捕获 87% 由 Agent 执行的有害指令。
官方称不增加运行时延迟。
建议与语义治理和严格工具权限组合使用。
events.importance_reason_zh: Agent 安全监控从原则走向可量化测试，为部署自主 Agent 的团队提供了可接入的检测层。
events.title_en: Google details Agent Anomaly Detection, catching 87% of harmful agent actions on five public benchmarks
events.summary_en: Google’s developer blog details Agent Anomaly Detection (AAD), which analyzes OpenTelemetry traces and logs to flag goal hijacks and tool misuse asynchronously and with low latency. Google says AAD caught 87% of harmful instructions actually carried out by agents across five public security benchmarks it did not author, without adding runtime latency. Developers can pair AAD with semantic governance and strict tool limits as part of defense in depth.
key_points_en: Analyzes OpenTelemetry traces and logs to flag goal hijacks and tool misuse asynchronously.
Caught 87% of harmful agent-executed instructions across five public benchmarks.
Google says it adds no runtime latency.
Recommended alongside semantic governance and strict tool limits.
events.importance_reason_en: Agent security monitoring moves from principle to measurable testing, giving teams deploying autonomous agents a detection layer they can integrate.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
corrections.reason_en: The RSSHub entry supplies only a date, so the original event wrongly used a 00:00 time. It now uses date precision to avoid implying an exact time.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 1.4.178 可跟随工作流运行并重载技能
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 1.4.178 可在 Workflow 标签页逐步跟随工作流运行；会话压缩后代理会重新加载用户指定的技能与 steering 文件；聊天中的大型 Mermaid 图表保持可读。修复包括权限变更后冻结、大文件写入前卡住，以及 Windows 网络驱动器上修改配置后未重载。
key_points_zh: Workflow 标签页可逐步跟随运行。
压缩后重新加载技能与 steering 文件。
大型 Mermaid 图表在聊天中保持可读。
events.importance_reason_zh: 压缩后仍保留技能与 steering，减少长会话中行为漂移与重复配置。
events.title_en: Kiro IDE 1.4.178 follows workflow runs and reloads skills after compaction
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE 1.4.178 lets users follow a workflow run step by step from its Workflow tab, reloads the skills and steering files a user asked for after a conversation compacts, and keeps large Mermaid diagrams readable in chat. Fixes cover freezes after a permissions change, stalls before large file writes, and missed reloads after editing configuration on a Windows network drive.
key_points_en: Workflow runs can be followed step by step.
Skills and steering files reload after compaction.
Large Mermaid diagrams stay readable in chat.
events.importance_reason_en: Keeping skills and steering after compaction reduces behavior drift and repeated setup in long sessions.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI 支持复制历史回复并自选压缩时机
events.summary_zh: Kiro CLI 新增 /copy N 与 /copy last N，可复制较早的回复或最近几条消息，并允许选择触发自动压缩的上下文用量；代理监视器显示每个子代理的任务，/model 的搜索、排序与编辑控件移到 Up；从 V2 升级到 V3 时，V2 代理的允许规则不再被放宽。
key_points_zh: /copy N 与 /copy last N 复制历史回复。
可选择自动压缩的上下文阈值。
V2 升级 V3 时不再放宽允许规则。
events.importance_reason_zh: 自选压缩时机让长会话在可控点上整理上下文，减少中途压缩导致的信息损失。
events.title_en: Kiro CLI copies earlier replies and lets users choose when compaction starts
events.summary_en: Kiro CLI adds /copy N and /copy last N to copy an earlier response or the last few messages, and lets users choose the context usage at which automatic compaction starts. The agent monitor shows each sub-agent's task, /model search, sort and edit controls move to Up, and upgrading a V2 agent to V3 no longer widens its allow rules.
key_points_en: /copy N and /copy last N copy earlier replies.
The automatic compaction threshold is configurable.
V2 to V3 upgrades no longer widen allow rules.
events.importance_reason_en: Choosing when compaction starts lets long sessions tidy context at a controlled point instead of losing information mid-task.

events.title_zh: Kiro 把 MCP 工具调用记录到 AWS CloudTrail
events.summary_zh: Kiro 开始在 us-east-1 与 eu-central-1 的配置文件中，把对 Kiro 服务 MCP 工具的调用记录到 AWS CloudTrail。安全与审计团队可查看请求者、被调用的工具、调用时间以及是否完成。
key_points_zh: 覆盖 us-east-1 与 eu-central-1 的配置文件。
记录请求者、工具、时间与完成状态。
仅针对 Kiro 服务的 MCP 工具调用。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把代理工具调用纳入既有云审计链路，满足安全团队对可追溯性的要求。
events.title_en: Kiro logs MCP tool calls to AWS CloudTrail
events.summary_en: Kiro now records calls to Kiro service MCP tools in AWS CloudTrail for Kiro profiles in US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Frankfurt). Security and audit teams can see who made a request, which tool was called, when it ran and whether it completed.
key_points_en: Covers profiles in us-east-1 and eu-central-1.
Records requester, tool, time and completion.
Limited to Kiro service MCP tool calls.
events.importance_reason_en: Feeding agent tool calls into existing cloud audit trails meets security teams' traceability requirements.

events.title_zh: Kiro 上线 Android 版移动应用
events.summary_zh: Kiro Mobile 上架 Google Play，可在 Android 手机上继续 Kiro 云会话，无需保持笔记本开机；登录 Kiro 账号后即可看到会话、已连接仓库与模型选择。该应用要求 Pro、Pro+、Pro Max 或 Power 套餐。
key_points_zh: 已在 Google Play 上架。
可继续云会话，无需保持笔记本开机。
要求 Pro、Pro+、Pro Max 或 Power 套餐。
events.importance_reason_zh: 移动端接入让云会话不必依赖桌面常开，扩大了代理在不间断任务中的使用场景。
events.title_en: Kiro Mobile arrives on Android
events.summary_en: Kiro Mobile is available on Google Play, so users can work in Kiro cloud sessions from an Android phone without keeping a laptop on. After signing in with a Kiro account, sessions, connected repositories and model choices are already there. The app requires a Pro, Pro+, Pro Max or Power plan.
key_points_en: Available on Google Play.
Cloud sessions work without keeping a laptop on.
Requires Pro, Pro+, Pro Max or Power.
events.importance_reason_en: Mobile access decouples cloud sessions from an always-on desktop, widening use for continuous agent work.

events.title_zh: Devin 重做 Review 页面并增加自动修复开关
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 12 日更新向所有组织开放重设计的 Devin Review 页面：合并控制、操作菜单和 diff 大小移至顶栏，侧边栏可收起，发现项改用新卡片与面板。新增独立的“自动修复 Devin Review 发现项”设置，与“响应机器人”分开。安全扫描可同步到多个连接，发现项状态变更可撤销，并新增 Veracode 与 Black Duck 发现项来源（封闭测试）。
key_points_zh: 重设计的 Devin Review 页面向所有组织开放。
自动修复发现项成为独立设置，与响应机器人分开。
安全扫描可同步到多个外部连接。
发现项驳回或标记已审阅后可用 Undo 撤销。
新增 Veracode 与 Black Duck 发现项来源（封闭测试）。
events.importance_reason_zh: 审查界面与自动修复开关同时调整，改变了 PR 审查的默认自动化程度和团队配置方式。
events.title_en: Devin redesigns Review and adds a separate auto-fix setting
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 12 update makes the redesigned Devin Review page available to all organizations: merge controls, the actions menu and the diff-size pill move to the top bar, the sidebar collapses, and findings use new cards and panels. A new “Automatically fix Devin Review findings” setting is separate from “Responding to bots.” Security scans can sync to multiple connections, finding status changes can be undone, and Veracode and Black Duck finding sources arrive in closed beta.
key_points_en: The redesigned Devin Review page is available to all organizations.
Auto-fixing findings is now a separate setting from responding to bots.
Security scans can sync to multiple external connections.
Dismissing or reviewing a finding can be undone.
Adds Veracode and Black Duck finding sources in closed beta.
events.importance_reason_en: The review UI and auto-fix switch change the default automation level and how teams configure pull-request review.

events.title_zh: TRAE 3.4.19–3.4.20 持久化会话草稿并修复终端与 SSH 环境
events.summary_zh: TRAE 3.4.19–3.4.20 在 Agent Window 持续保存输入草稿和处理中图片，切换会话或重启后可继续；项目与任务归档恢复和置顶处于灰度。更新还修复终端未继承扩展 PATH 与 Node 环境、远程 SSH 客户端服务版本不兼容导致重复安装，以及附件缩略图和输入状态问题。
key_points_zh: 项目与任务的归档、恢复和置顶处于灰度，可按本地或远程环境筛选。
Agent Window 的输入草稿和处理中图片可在切换会话、重新启动 IDE 或更新后继续保留。
终端支持继承扩展 PATH 与 Node 环境；SSH 远程开发在服务版本不兼容时提示升级，避免重复安装。
修复加粗快捷键与斜杠命令触发冲突、图片草稿恢复与清除、附件缩略图等输入和显示问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 会话持久化和终端环境修复关系到日常开发连续性，灰度归档与置顶则改善多项目工作流。
events.title_en: TRAE 3.4.19–3.4.20 persists session drafts and fixes terminal and SSH environments
events.summary_en: TRAE 3.4.19–3.4.20 continuously preserves Agent Window drafts and in-progress images across session changes, IDE restarts and updates. Project and task archiving, restoration and pinning are in grayscale. The releases also fix terminals that failed to inherit extension PATH and Node settings, repeated SSH remote-service installations caused by version incompatibility, and attachment-thumbnail and input-state issues.
key_points_en: Project and task archiving, restoration and pinning are in grayscale, with filtering by local or remote environment.
Agent Window input drafts and in-progress images survive session changes, IDE restarts and updates.
The terminal inherits extension PATH and Node settings; SSH remote development prompts for an upgrade when service versions are incompatible, avoiding repeated installation.
Fixes conflicts between bold shortcuts and slash-command triggers, image-draft restoration and clearing, attachment thumbnails, and other input or display issues.
events.importance_reason_en: Session persistence and terminal-environment fixes protect everyday development continuity, while grayscale archiving and pinning improve multi-project workflows.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 AlphaGenome 2 基因组模型
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 AlphaGenome 2，称其可预测 DNA 序列及其变异如何影响特定人类细胞类型与疾病。官方摘要未给出模型规模、评测数字或访问方式。
key_points_zh: 预测 DNA 序列与变异的影响。
区分特定人类细胞类型。
面向疾病相关研究，未公布访问方式。
events.importance_reason_zh: 基因组模型的预测粒度影响致病机制与靶点研究的工作方式，但本次公告缺少可比数据。
events.title_en: Google releases AlphaGenome 2
events.summary_en: Google released AlphaGenome 2, which it says predicts how DNA sequences and their variations affect specific human cell types and disease. The summary gives no model size, benchmark numbers or access details.
key_points_en: Predicts the impact of DNA sequences and variants.
Resolves effects by specific human cell type.
Aimed at disease research; access details were not disclosed.
events.importance_reason_en: Finer-grained genomic prediction shapes how disease mechanisms and targets are studied, though this announcement lacks comparable data.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 称逾 2 万名退伍军人领取一年免费 ChatGPT Plus
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已有超过 2 万名退伍军人与即将退役的军人领取一年免费 ChatGPT Plus，并介绍了他们用该服务准备转业的过程。官方摘要未说明资格审核方式与活动截止时间。
key_points_zh: 面向退伍军人与即将退役的军人。
提供一年免费 ChatGPT Plus。
官方称已超过 2 万人领取。
events.importance_reason_zh: 这是面向特定人群的订阅权益扩展，对计划采购的教育与转业培训项目有直接参考价值。
events.title_en: OpenAI says more than 20,000 veterans claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus
events.summary_en: OpenAI said more than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus, and described how they use it to prepare for civilian careers. The summary does not explain eligibility checks or when the offer ends.
key_points_en: Targeted at veterans and transitioning service members.
Provides a free year of ChatGPT Plus.
OpenAI says more than 20,000 people have claimed it.
events.importance_reason_en: A subscription benefit aimed at a specific group matters for training and transition programs planning tool budgets.

events.title_zh: GitHub App 可管理企业级 Copilot 席位
events.summary_zh: 企业级 GitHub App 现可调用企业级 Copilot 席位管理 API，控制哪些用户与企业团队获得 Copilot 席位。该能力通过新增的“Enterprise Copilot license management”细粒度权限授予。
key_points_zh: 企业级 GitHub App 可调用席位管理 API。
可管理机构内用户与团队的席位分配。
需新增的企业级细粒度权限。
events.importance_reason_zh: 席位分配可编程后，企业能把 Copilot 授权接入现有的身份与采购自动化。
events.title_en: GitHub Apps can manage enterprise Copilot seats
events.summary_en: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats. Access comes through a new enterprise fine-grained permission, Enterprise Copilot license management.
key_points_en: Enterprise GitHub Apps can call the seat management APIs.
Assignments can be managed for users and enterprise teams.
Requires the new enterprise fine-grained permission.
events.importance_reason_en: Programmable seat assignment lets enterprises wire Copilot licensing into existing identity and procurement automation.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 A2UI 1.0：面向 Agent 的生成式 UI 开放协议
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 A2UI 1.0，这是一个用于生成式 UI 的开放协议，让 AI Agent 在 Web、移动和桌面应用中渲染可交互的原生界面。项目提供 React、Angular、Lit、Flutter、SwiftUI 与 Jetpack Compose 渲染器 SDK，以及 Python、TypeScript、Dart 的 Agent SDK。1.0 版本引入双向函数调用、可替换的推理格式和安全数据绑定，方便团队把生成式 UI 接入现有产品栈。
key_points_zh: 开放协议，让 Agent 渲染 Web、移动与桌面的原生交互界面。
提供 React、Angular、Lit、Flutter、SwiftUI、Jetpack Compose 渲染器 SDK。
提供 Python、TypeScript、Dart 的 Agent SDK。
1.0 增加双向函数调用、可替换推理格式与安全数据绑定。
events.importance_reason_zh: 生成式 UI 从各家私有实现走向开放协议与多框架 SDK，会降低 Agent 前端集成的迁移成本。
events.title_en: Google releases A2UI 1.0, an open protocol for agent-generated interfaces
events.summary_en: Google released A2UI 1.0, an open protocol for generative UI that lets AI agents render interactive native screens across web, mobile and desktop apps. It provides renderer SDKs for React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose, plus agent SDKs for Python, TypeScript and Dart. Version 1.0 adds bidirectional function calls, swappable inference formats and secure data binding for integrating generative UI into existing product stacks.
key_points_en: An open protocol for agents to render native interactive screens on web, mobile and desktop.
Renderer SDKs for React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
Agent SDKs for Python, TypeScript and Dart.
1.0 adds bidirectional function calls, swappable inference formats and secure data binding.
events.importance_reason_en: Generative UI moves from proprietary implementations toward an open protocol with multi-framework SDKs, lowering migration costs for agent frontends.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
corrections.reason_en: The RSSHub entry supplies only a date, so the original event wrongly used a 00:00 time. It now uses date precision to avoid implying an exact time.

events.title_zh: MiniMax 发布开源图像模型 H3-Image：4K 生成进入 10 秒级
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布基于 H3 的开源权重图像生成模型 H3-Image，支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑。官方称可在 10 秒内生成 4096×4096 的 4K 图像，速度最高为主流方案的 5 倍，并能理解最多 16 张参考图。模型同时通过 MiniMax API、MiniMax Code 和 Hailuo AI 提供，定价为主流同类方案的 50%–70%，发布周 4K 及以上分辨率请求再打五折。
key_points_zh: 开源权重，支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑。
10 秒内生成 4096×4096 图像，最高 5 倍于主流方案。
最多支持 16 张参考图。
可通过 MiniMax API、MiniMax Code 与 Hailuo AI 使用。
定价为主流方案的 50%–70%，发布周 4K 及以上请求五折。
events.importance_reason_zh: 开源权重的高分辨率图像模型把 4K 生成的速度和价格同时拉低，会直接影响创作者与 API 用户的模型选择。
events.title_en: MiniMax releases open-weight H3-Image, bringing 4K generation under 10 seconds
events.summary_en: MiniMax released H3-Image, an open-weight image generation model built on H3 that supports text-to-image, reference-based generation and image editing. MiniMax says it can produce a 4096×4096 image in under 10 seconds, up to 5× faster than mainstream alternatives, and can work with up to 16 reference images. It is available through the MiniMax API, MiniMax Code and Hailuo AI; pricing is 50–70% of comparable mainstream offerings, with a further 50% off 4K-and-above requests during launch week.
key_points_en: Open weights with text-to-image, reference-based generation and editing.
A 4096×4096 image in under 10 seconds, up to 5× faster than mainstream options.
Support for up to 16 reference images.
Available through the MiniMax API, MiniMax Code and Hailuo AI.
Priced at 50–70% of mainstream alternatives, with 50% off 4K-and-above requests in launch week.
events.importance_reason_en: An open-weight high-resolution image model lowers both latency and price for 4K generation, directly affecting creator and API model choices.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动上线 MiniMax H3：0.5 元/秒生成带立体声视频
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动上线 MiniMax 开源的 MiniMax H3（FL2VA），开发者可通过 API 生成带原生立体声音的视频，并支持输入首帧、尾帧或首尾双帧控制关键画面。模型采用 33B 单流 H3-Omni Transformer 联合预测视频与音频，并重构 H3-VAE 以降低训练与推理成本。硅基流动定价 0.5 元/秒，支持生成 5–15 秒、480P 或 768P 的带音轨视频。
key_points_zh: 支持文生视频与首帧、尾帧、首尾双帧控制。
原生立体声音视频同步生成。
33B 单流 H3-Omni Transformer 联合预测视频与音频。
硅基流动定价 0.5 元/秒。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把带原生音频的视频生成接入国内 API 并按秒计价，为广告、电商与游戏内容生产提供了可直接核算成本的方案。
events.title_en: SiliconFlow adds MiniMax H3 with native-stereo video at ¥0.5 per second
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow added MiniMax’s open-source MiniMax H3 (FL2VA), letting developers generate video with native stereo audio through its API and control key frames with a first frame, last frame or both. The model uses a 33B single-stream H3-Omni Transformer to predict video and audio jointly and a rebuilt H3-VAE to cut training and inference costs. SiliconFlow prices it at ¥0.5 per second for 5–15 second clips at 480P or 768P with an audio track.
key_points_en: Text-to-video plus first-frame, last-frame and first/last-frame control.
Native stereo audio generated together with video.
A 33B single-stream H3-Omni Transformer predicts video and audio jointly.
Priced at ¥0.5 per second on SiliconFlow.
Supports 5–15 second clips at 480P or 768P.
events.importance_reason_en: Native-audio video generation with per-second pricing gives advertising, e-commerce and game teams a directly costable production option.

events.title_zh: Devin 增加 Design Mode、服务用户筛选与堆叠 PR 视图
events.summary_zh: Devin 11 月 11 日更新加入 Design Mode：选中页面元素后打开紧凑提示栏，可按属性编辑，绘制五种颜色的聚光灯框或铅笔标注，并把带注释的页面图连同说明发送；支持取色器和页面 CSS 变量搜索。会话列表的“创建者”筛选纳入服务用户，堆叠 PR 增加可见性与顺序偏好，相邻仓库设置建议可批量批准，Devin 也能给自己设置未来提醒。
key_points_zh: Design Mode 支持逐属性编辑、五种颜色标注与页面图发送。
支持取色器与页面 CSS 变量搜索。
会话列表可按服务用户筛选。
堆叠 PR 增加可见性与顺序偏好。
仓库设置建议可批量批准，Devin 可自我提醒。
events.importance_reason_zh: Design Mode 把视觉修改与自然语言说明合并到同一反馈回路，减少前端任务的往返沟通。
events.title_en: Devin adds Design Mode, service-user filtering and stacked-PR visibility
events.summary_en: Devin’s November 11 update adds Design Mode: selecting a page element opens a compact prompt bar with per-property editing, spotlight boxes or pencil annotations in five colors, and the option to send the annotated page image with a note, plus an eyedropper and page CSS-variable search. The sessions list can filter by service user, stacked PRs gain visibility and order preferences, adjacent repository setup suggestions can be approved together, and Devin can set itself future reminders.
key_points_en: Design Mode offers per-property editing, five annotation colors and annotated-page sending.
Includes an eyedropper and page CSS-variable search.
Session lists can filter by service user.
Stacked PRs gain visibility and stack-order preferences.
Repository setup suggestions can be batch-approved, and Devin can set its own reminders.
events.importance_reason_en: Design Mode folds visual edits and natural-language notes into one feedback loop, cutting back-and-forth on frontend tasks.

events.title_zh: xAI 发布 Grok Bot 1.0
events.summary_zh: xAI 发布 Grok Bot 1.0：自 beta 以来新增三人协作、主动承担与能力提升三方面改进，Bot 可共享并接入 Slack、Microsoft Teams 与视频通话，能识别待办工作并跟进任务。
key_points_zh: Grok Bot 结束 beta 发布 1.0 版。
多人协作：Bot 可共享并带入 Slack、Microsoft Teams 与视频通话，从共事者身上学习并持续改进。
主动性：Bot 可识别需要完成的工作并主动承担，跟进未完成任务，并在需要人类判断时引入人。
events.importance_reason_zh: Grok Bot 正式版明确其产品形态与团队协作能力，属产品正式发布节点。
events.title_en: xAI launches Grok Bot 1.0
events.summary_en: xAI launched Grok Bot 1.0 with three major improvements since beta: multiplayer teammates, proactive teammates, and more capable teammates; Bots can be shared, brought into Slack, Microsoft Teams, and video calls, recognize work that needs doing, and follow up on unfinished tasks.
key_points_en: Grok Bot 1.0 ends the beta period as a major update.
Multiplayer teammates: Bots can be shared and brought into Slack, Microsoft Teams, and video calls, learning from everyone they work with.
Proactive teammates: Bots recognize work that needs to be done, offer to take it on, follow up on unfinished tasks, and bring people in when a decision requires their judgment.
events.importance_reason_en: The 1.0 release defines the product form and team-collaboration capabilities of Grok Bot.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 增加扩展校验命令
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 增加扩展校验命令与相应评测测试，修复终端宽度变化后的内联历史重绘、Windows 路径大小写判断、回填搜索前导斜杠导致的自动补全问题，以及在加载指示器中显示 429 限流冷却倒计时；开启动态模型配置且关闭预览时，/model 会列出 Auto。
key_points_zh: 新增扩展校验命令与评测测试。
修复终端宽度变化后的历史重绘。
429 限流时在加载指示器显示冷却倒计时。
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展校验让第三方扩展在发布前发现问题，限流倒计时则减少盲目重试。
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 adds an extension validation command
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 adds an extension validation command with evaluation tests, fixes inline history re-rendering after terminal width changes, case-insensitive path handling on Windows, leading-slash normalization in file search autocomplete, and surfaces 429 rate-limit cool-downs with a countdown in the loading indicator. /model now lists Auto when dynamic model configuration is on and preview access is off.
key_points_en: Adds an extension validation command and evaluation tests.
Fixes history re-rendering after terminal width changes.
Shows a 429 cool-down countdown in the loading indicator.
events.importance_reason_en: Extension validation catches problems before publishing, and the countdown reduces blind retries.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 的 C++ 语言服务器自动配置 MSBuild
events.summary_zh: 微软 C++ 语言服务器为 Copilot CLI 内置 MSBuild 编译命令提取器，并在打开项目时自动调用，代理无需再查找并运行配置技能即可生成 compilation database。官方称这减少了准备步骤与 token 消耗；CMake 与自定义构建系统仍需自行提供或生成 compile_commands.json。
key_points_zh: 内置 MSBuild 编译命令提取器并自动调用。
无需代理先运行配置技能即可获得代码智能。
CMake 与自定义构建系统仍需自行生成 compile_commands.json。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把编译数据库生成内置化，减少了大型 C++ 项目首次索引的准备时间与 token 开销。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI's C++ language server configures MSBuild automatically
events.summary_en: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile-commands extractor and invokes it on project open, so an agent no longer needs to discover and run a configuration skill before generating a compilation database. Microsoft says this makes setup deterministic and uses fewer tokens; CMake and custom build systems still need their own compile_commands.json.
key_points_en: The MSBuild extractor is bundled and invoked automatically.
Agents get code intelligence without a separate setup skill.
CMake and custom build systems still supply their own compilation database.
events.importance_reason_en: Building the compilation database in reduces setup time and token spend for first-time indexing of large C++ projects.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 支持 Fable 5.2 与 CIDR 沙箱规则
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 在模型选择器中加入 Claude Fable 5.2，并让沙箱主机允许/拒绝规则支持 IPv4 与 IPv6 CIDR；并行文件操作选择“不再询问”后会批准全部覆盖请求，/compact 完成后页脚的 AI credits 立即更新。
key_points_zh: 模型选择器新增 Claude Fable 5.2。
沙箱主机规则支持 IPv4/IPv6 CIDR。
并行文件操作的“不再询问”一次覆盖全部请求。
events.importance_reason_zh: CIDR 规则让企业可以按网段配置沙箱出口，而不必逐条列出主机。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 adds Claude Fable 5.2 and CIDR sandbox rules
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.109 adds Claude Fable 5.2 to the model picker and supports IPv4/IPv6 CIDR in sandbox host allow and deny rules. Choosing "don't ask again" for parallel file operations now approves all covered requests, and the footer's AI credits update as soon as /compact finishes.
key_points_en: Claude Fable 5.2 appears in the model picker.
Sandbox host rules accept IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges.
"Don't ask again" covers all parallel file operation requests.
events.importance_reason_en: CIDR rules let enterprises pin sandbox egress by network range instead of listing hosts one by one.

events.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 正式可用，Copilot 与 Antigravity 同步接入
events.summary_zh: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 正式可用。GitHub 同日说明称该模型面向复杂编码、智能体与推理任务，侧重安全代码生成与安全工作，在 Copilot 中面向 Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 用户提供并按下标价计费；Google Antigravity 也发布“Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm”公告。该模型此前于 10 月 28 日以受限方式发布。
key_points_zh: 10 月 28 日的受限发布转为正式可用。
定位复杂编码、智能体与推理任务，侧重安全代码生成。
Copilot 向 Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise 开放，按用量计费。
Antigravity 同日发布 Gemini 4 Carbon 与 /swarm 公告。
events.importance_reason_zh: 从受限开放转为全面可用，意味着团队可以把这一前沿模型放进常规编码与安全工作流。
events.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon reaches general availability in Copilot and Antigravity
events.summary_en: Google announced that Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available. In its same-day post, GitHub describes the model as built for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks with a focus on secure code generation and security work, and offers it in Copilot to Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users at provider list pricing. Google Antigravity also published a "Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm" post. The model had launched on October 28 with limited access.
key_points_en: The October 28 limited release becomes generally available.
Positioned for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks with a security focus.
Copilot access for Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise under usage-based billing.
Antigravity published a same-day Gemini 4 Carbon and /swarm post.
events.importance_reason_en: Moving from restricted access to general availability lets teams place this frontier model in everyday coding and security workflows.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 AlphaProof Code，用 Lean 验证 Signal 核心加密
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 AlphaProof Code，称其在深度验证复杂软件方面取得突破：由智能体在 Lean 中编写约 300 万行证明，用于验证 Signal 的核心加密实现。官方摘要未说明耗时、成本或对外开放方式。
key_points_zh: 面向复杂软件的形式化验证。
智能体在 Lean 中编写约 300 万行证明。
验证对象为 Signal 的核心加密实现。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把形式化验证推进到真实生产级加密代码，是判断 AI 能否参与安全关键软件工程的重要案例。
events.title_en: Google introduces AlphaProof Code, verifying Signal's core encryption in Lean
events.summary_en: Google introduced AlphaProof Code, claiming a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth: agents wrote about three million lines of Lean proofs to verify Signal's core encryption. The summary does not give runtime, cost or how outside teams can use it.
key_points_en: Targets formal verification of complex software.
Agents wrote roughly three million lines of Lean proofs.
The verification target was Signal's core encryption.
events.importance_reason_en: Pushing formal verification into real production cryptography is a key test of whether AI can join safety-critical software work.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 2.2.7 支持 Copilot Auto 与标记未读
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 2.2.7 在模型选择器中支持 GitHub Copilot Auto，由 Copilot 路由按 Auto 折扣为每个会话选模型，路由失败时回退到账户默认模型；新增侧栏标签快捷键、会话标记未读、read 工具负偏移与文件名近似建议，shell 结果附带退出码。破坏性变更包括移除 @opencode/ai 的 ImageResponse.image，以及部分 SDK 端点不再等待插件加载。
key_points_zh: 模型选择器可选 Copilot Auto，按 Auto 折扣计费。
read 支持负偏移，找不到文件时给出近似路径。
SDK 部分端点不再等待插件加载，需要监听 *.updated 事件。
events.importance_reason_zh: 接入 Copilot Auto 把模型路由交给供应商，同时 SDK 行为变化要求集成方调整刷新逻辑。
events.title_en: OpenCode 2.2.7 adds Copilot Auto and unread markers
events.summary_en: OpenCode 2.2.7 lets you pick GitHub Copilot Auto in the model picker, so Copilot's router chooses a model per session at the Auto discount and falls back to the account default if routing fails. It adds side-panel tab shortcuts, marking sessions unread, a negative read offset with close-name suggestions, and exit codes on shell results. Breaking changes include removing ImageResponse.image from @opencode/ai and SDK endpoints that no longer wait for plugins to load.
key_points_en: Copilot Auto is selectable and billed at the Auto discount.
read accepts negative offsets and suggests close file names.
Some SDK endpoints no longer wait for plugins; listen for *.updated events.
events.importance_reason_en: Copilot Auto hands model routing to the provider, while the SDK change forces integrations to refresh on events.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 内推出商家资料管理
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Businesses in ChatGPT，让商家在 ChatGPT 内管理企业信息、查看自身在 ChatGPT 中的展示情况，并把用户关注转化为行动。官方摘要未披露适用地区、收费方式或上线时间。
key_points_zh: 商家可在 ChatGPT 内管理企业信息。
可查看自身在 ChatGPT 中的展示情况。
目标是把握用户关注并转化为行动。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把商家资料纳入 ChatGPT，意味着对话入口开始承载本地商家与转化链路。
events.title_en: OpenAI introduces Businesses in ChatGPT
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Businesses in ChatGPT so businesses can manage their information, see how they show up in ChatGPT and turn interest into action inside ChatGPT. The summary does not disclose regions, pricing or launch timing.
key_points_en: Businesses can manage their company information inside ChatGPT.
They can see how the business appears in ChatGPT.
The goal is turning user interest into action.
events.importance_reason_en: Putting business profiles inside ChatGPT shows the chat entry point starting to carry merchant discovery and conversion.

events.title_zh: 美团以 MIT 协议开源 LongCat-2.5
events.summary_zh: 美团以 MIT 协议开源 LongCat-2.5，允许商用推理部署与二次训练，无需额外授权。模型总参数 1.6 万亿、每 token 激活约 480 亿，支持一百万上下文。官方称可在单卡显存不足 80GB 的国产加速器上完成长序列训练与微调，长序列 SFT 的单卡吞吐较 DDP 基线提升 86%。
key_points_zh: MIT 协议开源，允许商用推理部署与二次训练。
总参数 1.6 万亿，每 token 激活约 480 亿，支持 100 万上下文。
单卡显存不足 80GB 的国产加速器可承载长序列训练。
长序列 SFT 单卡吞吐较 DDP 基线提升 86%。
events.importance_reason_zh: 开放权重与国产算力适配一起降低了万亿级 MoE 的自部署门槛，也给出可复现的长序列训练配置。
events.title_en: Meituan open-sources LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license
events.summary_en: Meituan open-sourced LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license, allowing commercial inference deployment and further training without extra permission. The model has 1.6T total parameters with about 48B activated per token and a one-million-token context. Meituan says long-context training and fine-tuning run on domestic accelerators with under 80GB of memory per card, and that its FSDP configuration reached 86% higher per-card throughput than a DDP baseline on long-sequence SFT.
key_points_en: MIT-licensed, permitting commercial inference and further training.
1.6T total parameters, about 48B active per token, 1M-token context.
Long-sequence training fits domestic accelerators with under 80GB per card.
Long-sequence SFT throughput is 86% higher than a DDP baseline.
events.importance_reason_en: Open weights plus domestic-accelerator tuning lower the barrier to self-hosting a trillion-parameter MoE and give a reproducible long-context training setup.

events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 修复插件目录被静默回退
events.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 为补丁版本，汇总自 0.23.0 以来的约 618 个 PR。主要修复是：线上插件目录 JSON 超过客户端 2 MiB 上限，导致每次安装都静默回退到随版本发布的旧目录；本次把上限提高到 16 MiB。仍停留在 0.23.0 及更早版本的安装会继续回退。发行说明另提到 TUI Esc 回溯、跨机群聊与网关连接共享等未在此文档化的变更。
key_points_zh: 插件目录超过 2 MiB 上限导致安装回退到旧目录。
上限提高到 16 MiB，恢复使用线上目录。
0.23.0 及更早版本在升级前仍会回退。
events.importance_reason_zh: 未升级的实例拿不到新插件且没有报错，属于容易被忽略的功能性故障。
events.title_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 fixes a silent plugin catalog fallback
events.summary_en: Hermes Agent 0.23.1 is a patch release rolling up about 618 PRs merged since 0.23.0. Its main fix: the live plugin catalog exceeded the 2 MiB cap clients accept, so every install silently fell back to the catalog shipped with the release. This release raises the cap to 16 MiB. Installs still on 0.23.0 or older keep falling back. The notes also mention TUI Esc backtrack, cross-machine group chats and shared gateway connections without full documentation.
key_points_en: The catalog outgrew the 2 MiB cap and installs fell back to the bundled copy.
The cap rises to 16 MiB so the live catalog is used again.
Installs on 0.23.0 or older keep falling back until updated.
events.importance_reason_en: Un-upgraded instances quietly miss new plugins without an error, which is easy to overlook.

events.title_zh: OpenRouter 推出 Extractions API
events.summary_zh: OpenRouter 发布 Extractions API，用于从文档与图片中提取带类型的字段：指定字段后返回取值、位置与置信度。上线时由三个模型提供该能力；在 Cloudflare 的 Clairic 上，同一请求可读取文本与图片并返回数字、日期、列表、估算与预测。
key_points_zh: 按字段名提取取值、位置与置信度。
上线时由三个模型提供。
同一请求可同时处理文本与图片。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把结构化抽取做成独立 API，减少为每类文档维护提示词与后处理的工作量。
events.title_en: OpenRouter introduces the Extractions API
events.summary_en: OpenRouter introduced the Extractions API for pulling typed fields out of documents and images: name the fields and get values, spans and confidence back. Three models serve it at launch. On Cloudflare's Clairic, a single request reads text and images and returns numbers, dates, lists, estimates and forecasts.
key_points_en: Returns values, spans and confidence for named fields.
Three models serve it at launch.
One request can read both text and images.
events.importance_reason_en: A dedicated extraction API cuts the work of maintaining prompts and post-processing for each document type.

events.title_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 增加端侧离线语音识别与合成
events.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 新增端侧、离线的自动语音识别（ASR）与文本转语音（TTS）能力，面向语音应用开发。Android 可使用 ML Kit 获得优化性能，跨平台则可通过 MediaPipe Tasks 与 LiteRT 集成开放权重模型。该本地管线可与 Gemini Nano、Gemma 4 等端侧小模型配合，实现实时流式转写和低延迟语音合成。
key_points_zh: 新增端侧离线 ASR 与 TTS。
Android 可通过 ML Kit 使用优化实现。
跨平台可通过 MediaPipe Tasks 与 LiteRT 集成开放权重模型。
可与 Gemini Nano、Gemma 4 等端侧小模型组合。
events.importance_reason_zh: 离线语音链路补齐了端侧 Agent 的输入输出能力，减少对云端的依赖。
events.title_en: Google AI Edge Gallery adds on-device offline speech recognition and synthesis
events.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery now supports on-device, offline automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech for voice applications. Android can use ML Kit for optimized performance, while cross-platform apps can integrate open-weight models through MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT. The local pipeline can pair with on-device small models such as Gemini Nano and Gemma 4 for real-time streaming transcription and low-latency synthesis.
key_points_en: Adds on-device, offline ASR and TTS.
Android can use ML Kit for an optimized implementation.
Cross-platform apps can use MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT with open-weight models.
Works with on-device models such as Gemini Nano and Gemma 4.
events.importance_reason_en: An offline speech pipeline completes on-device agent input and output, reducing cloud dependence.

corrections.reason_zh: RSSHub 条目只提供日期，原事件误用了 00:00 时间；改为日期精度，避免伪造具体时刻。
corrections.reason_en: The RSSHub entry supplies only a date, so the original event wrongly used a 00:00 time. It now uses date precision to avoid implying an exact time.

events.title_zh: Kiro 实验支持 Grok 4.7，200K 内按 2.7 倍 credits 计费
events.summary_zh: Grok 4.7 以实验性支持上线 Kiro IDE、CLI、Crew 与 Web，面向 Pro、Pro+、Pro Max 与 Power 用户，提供 50 万 token 上下文。20 万 token 以内的请求按 2.7 倍 credits 计费，超过 20 万 token 按 5.4 倍计费；需重启 IDE/CLI、运行 kirocrew restart 或刷新 Web 以加载最新模型列表。
key_points_zh: 覆盖 IDE、CLI、Crew 与 Web，定位实验性支持。
上下文窗口 50 万 token。
20 万 token 内 2.7 倍 credits，超出部分按 5.4 倍计费。
events.importance_reason_zh: 上下文超过 20 万 token 时 credits 翻倍，长会话的实际成本需要按 token 区间核算。
events.title_en: Kiro adds experimental Grok 4.7 with tiered credit pricing
events.summary_en: Grok 4.7 is available with experimental support in Kiro IDE, CLI, Crew and Web for Pro, Pro+, Pro Max and Power customers, with a 500K-token context window. Requests up to 200K tokens carry a 2.7x credit multiplier; requests beyond that are billed at 5.4x. Users must restart the IDE or CLI, run kirocrew restart, or refresh Web to load the latest model list.
key_points_en: Covers IDE, CLI, Crew and Web as experimental support.
500K-token context window.
2.7x credits up to 200K tokens and 5.4x beyond that.
events.importance_reason_en: Credits double past 200K tokens, so long sessions need to be costed by token band.

events.title_zh: Kiro 预览企业统一策略管理
events.summary_zh: Kiro Enterprise Management 进入预览，仅对 us-east-1 新建的 Kiro 配置文件开放，既有配置文件与欧洲区域后续支持。管理员在 AWS 控制台编写一份策略即可下发到 Kiro IDE、CLI、Web 与 Crew LTS（IDE 需 1.4.154 及以上，CLI 需 3.1.0 及以上）；策略包含模型、命令、文件、联网与 MCP 的允许/拒绝/询问规则，默认模型与日志设置，以及分发的 steering 文件、Skills 与 Powers，可按全员、组或个人生效，身份源支持 IAM Identity Center、Okta 与 Microsoft Entra ID。
key_points_zh: 单一策略覆盖 IDE、CLI、Web 与 Crew LTS。
规则可对模型、命令、文件、联网与 MCP 调用生效。
仅限 us-east-1 新建配置文件，既有配置待支持。
events.importance_reason_zh: 把权限、默认设置与 Skills 统一下发，降低了多客户端团队的一致性与合规成本。
events.title_en: Kiro previews one enterprise policy across every client
